jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
We're partnering with a rapidly scaling US gaming and consumer technology company to hire a Senior Product Manager who will play a key role in shaping and scaling its product experience through its next phase of growth.

The business operates a high-monetization consumer platform combining sports prediction gaming, social competition and mobile game mechanics. Its experiences bring together sports fandom, competitive gameplay and progression systems, creating new ways for fans to engage, compete and win through their sports knowledge.

This is an opportunity to join an ambitious, fast-growing business and work closely with its founders and cross-functional teams, driving product development, user engagement and monetization across its core gaming experiences.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and drive the product roadmap across multiple gameplay verticals.

• Translate user insights, player feedback, and market trends into clear product requirements.

• Lead cross-functional collaboration with engineering, design, data, and operations.

• Drive experimentation and iteration through A/B testing and product analytics.

• Optimize core product metrics including DAU, retention, conversion, ARPU, and LTV.

• Ensure cohesion across free-to-play progression systems, fantasy gameplay, and sweepstakes mechanics.

• Monitor competitors across DFS, social casino, and sports gaming to identify opportunities for differentiation.

• Partner with legal and compliance teams to ensure alignment with U.S. sweepstakes and gaming regulations.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in product management for mobile games, consumer apps, or sports/gaming platforms.

• Proven track record of shipping and scaling impactful mobile features.

• Strong analytical and data-driven mindset.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate business objectives into clear product direction.

• Deep user empathy and passion for building engaging consumer experiences.

• Ability to balance short-term growth opportunities with long-term product development.

• Interest in sports, competition, and social gaming.

Nice to Have

• Experience with F2P economies, progression systems, or live-ops mechanics.

• Exposure to fantasy sports, sweepstakes models, or real-money gaming ecosystems.

• Hands-on experience with A/B testing and retention optimization.

• Understanding of game design mechanics around prediction, rewards, and competition.

Why This Opportunity
You'll be joining at a pivotal stage of growth, contributing directly to the evolution of a product that brings together sports fandom, social competition, and mobile gaming progression. With major sports partnerships and a scalable sweepstakes model already in place, this is an opportunity to take ownership of meaningful product challenges and help build a category-defining platform.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Pass)
jobs.description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right . Since then, we've built the world's largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar — tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives.

We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top :1% of applicants. Our 700+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Check our open-source projects here.

The ID Team

The ID team owns three of Proton's most strategically important products: Proton Pass (password manager), Proton Authenticator , and SimpleLogin (alias and identity protection) — serving millions of users from individuals to businesses managing credentials at scale.

We're looking for a Senior PM to lead the next stage of these products. Product at Proton sits at the intersection of Engineering, Growth, Data, and Design — your job is to grow engagement and retention by shipping experiences users love, while driving the freemium model that sits at the heart of how we grow. You'll set direction across Pass, Authenticator, and SimpleLogin, not execute someone else's roadmap.

What You'll Own

• Define and drive the product roadmap for Pass, Authenticator, and SimpleLogin — from strategic vision through delivery — in close collaboration with senior leadership.

• Own the metrics that matter: active usage, user engagement, retention, revenue, and B2B conversion. Set the bar, track it, and course-correct fast.

• Identify and ship novel product features that expand the value proposition to new user segments and deepen defensibility against well-resourced competitors.

• Lead cross-functional execution across engineering, design, growth, and marketing — remove blockers, maintain velocity, and keep teams aligned on priorities.

• Anticipate growth ceilings before they hit. Define scaling strategies that go beyond pure product work — including infrastructure, tooling, and customer engagement platforms.

• Drive market research, competitive analysis, and direct customer feedback loops to ensure product decisions are grounded in real user needs.

Who You Are

• 6–10 years of product management experience in B2C or B2B SaaS, with a track record of successful product and major feature launches.

• Analytically rigorous: you define success in numbers, run structured experiments, and make data-informed decisions without losing sight of user intuition.

• Experienced in product-led growth and freemium business models — you understand the mechanics of conversion, retention, and expansion revenue.

• A sharp eye for UX — you can tell good design from bad, and you won't ship experiences that fall short.

• Able to go deep with engineers: you understand technical trade-offs, participate meaningfully in architecture discussions, and earn credibility through substance, not title.

• Demonstrated experience building or scaling B2B product lines — you know what enterprise buyers need and how that differs from consumer.

Nice to Have

• Experience in online privacy, security, or identity products.

• Familiarity with cryptographic concepts relevant to user data protection.

• Prior experience with a freemium model scaling into mid-market or enterprise.

What We Offer

• Office First: Collaboration is easier and more effective in person, which is why we have offices in Geneva, Zurich, Prague, Barcelona, Paris, London, Vilnius, Skopje, and Taipei. You can also enjoy working from home up to 30% of the time, while enjoying great company during our three core days in the office.

• Technology: We provide all the devices and software you need to excel in your role, ensuring you have the best tools at your disposal to achieve your goals.

• Food: Lunch and snacks are provided by Proton every day at our offices.

• Transport: We will always support our employees with transport costs through subsidizing public transport, bike allowances, or parking spaces based on your office location.

• Stock Options: At Proton, we are all owners of the company and you get stock options when you join us.

• Flexible Working: You can define your own working hours as long as it works with team meetings.

• Learning and Development: We are committed to your professional growth. Proton offers various learning opportunities, including training programs, conferences and events, and continual learning.

• Employee Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance plans, competitive retirement savings options, generous vacation and leave policies, and wellness programs.

• Work that Matters: Proton is a community-first organization, started with the support of a crowdfunding campaign and built with community input. To this day, Proton’s only source of revenue is user subscriptions. Over 100 million people trust and support Proton, and we put our users and community first in everything we do. Read more about our impact here.

• Compensation range: Paris/Barcelona: 60,000 - 95,000 EUR gross annually*

• Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. We strive to create equal opportunities, promote open dialogue, and support continuous learning to ensure every voice is heard and respected.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

Candidate Privacy Notice

When you apply for a position, refer a candidate, or are considered for a role at Proton Technologies AG (Proton, we, us, or our), your information is stored in Greenhouse, in accordance with their Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position. We also retain this information for consideration for future roles that you may apply for or that we believe may align with your background and skills.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. Should you have any inquiries about how we use or manage your information, or if you wish to access, correct, or delete your data, please contact our privacy team at careers@proton.ch.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Amenitiz is the all-in-one software behind 15,000 independent hotels in Spain, Portugal, France and Italy. In 2026 we shipped more than ever: POS, Ami and Conversations, fiscal compliance in five countries, and integrations with OTAs, revenue management systems and POS providers.

Our product surface grew faster than three PMs can carry. You'll be the fourth, and you'll own a part of it end to end: from the opportunity, to the code, to hotels using it and paying for it.

How PMs work here

Our PMs open the repo. They prototype with Claude Code in days, ship fixes and small changes themselves, and bring engineers the hard problems with a working prototype in hand.

They spend hours every week with hoteliers: on calls, on visits, in the Care queue. They read their own data in SQL and Mixpanel. And a release is only the start: a feature is done when hotels use it and we can see it in the numbers.

What you'll own

• One initiative from our 18-month product plan, from idea to adopted, measured hotel by hotel

• The adoption number for everything you ship

• A set of hotels you know by name, and the partnerships your initiatives need

• Launch enablement for Care, Onboarding, Account Management, Sales and Marketing

Your first year

• Month 3: your own changes in production, and a prototype in front of real hotels

• Month 6: your first major release live, with an activation target set before launch and tracked from day one

• Month 12: an initiative that measurably moved revenue for a set of hotels, and the next 6-month roadmap for your area, written by you

You have

• 5+ years as a PM in B2B SaaS, including an initiative you built from scratch and the adoption or retention number it moved

• Software you built and shipped yourself: prototypes with Claude Code or similar, and fixes merged to production. You can show us something real users used

• Real time with customers, especially small-business owners, and the instinct to bring back what they'd pay for

• Experience defining activation, reading the funnel yourself and fixing drop-off in the product

• Full professional English

• A base in Barcelona, or the will to move here: we work office-first from Plaça de Catalunya

Bonus points

• A background in hospitality, travel, payments or compliance

• Spanish, French, Italian or Portuguese

• LLM or agent features in production

• Experience running a big product surface with a small team

Why join

• Own a chapter of an 18-month plan, at 15,000 hotels in four countries

• Build with AI the way most PMs only read about

• Join a team of four PMs where every one of them ships

• Work with a direct line to our CPO and CEO

• Live and work in Barcelona

Our process

• A 30-minute call with Talent Acquisition

• 60 minutes with Marco Riedl, our CPO

• A 90-minute working session where you build: you get a real initiative 48 hours ahead (prep takes under 4 hours), prototype part of it live with Claude Code, and show how you'd measure its adoption

• 45 minutes with the team

• 45 minutes with our CEO

You'll hear from us after every step, whatever the outcome.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission As a Senior Product Manager at Bitpanda, you will take end-to-end ownership of key product areas and strategic pillars, scaling our offerings for financial institutions, banks, and strategic partners. Operating in a high-impact, complex, and regulated environment, you will define product strategy, shape the roadmap, and act as a key sparring partner to Product Leadership.
You will work closely within a collaborative structure, allowing you to focus deeply on product architecture, scalability, and technical execution while leveraging client-facing insights to inform your roadmap. This is a global, fast-paced role requiring seamless context-switching across markets, products, and evolving regulatory frameworks.
What you'll do
• Take end-to-end ownership of core product pillars, defining the long-term vision, strategy, and execution roadmap in close alignment with Product Leadership.

• Partner with Engineering to translate complex market and partner needs into clear, actionable, and scalable technical capabilities.

• Work closely with Client Solution Leads—and engage directly with external partners when needed—to weigh client-specific requests against long-term platform scalability and strategic priorities.

• Proactively integrate fintech and financial services regulatory requirements into the product lifecycle, collaborating closely with Compliance and Legal to ensure every launch meets global standards.

• Act as a central connector across Engineering, Sales, Client Solutions, Legal, and Compliance, managing senior stakeholders and driving clarity amid ambiguity and shifting priorities.

Who you are
• Proven track record managing B2B and/or B2B2C products within finance, banking, fintech, or crypto.

• Demonstrated experience operating as a Senior Product Manager or Lead Product Manager, with end-to-end ownership of complex products.

• Solid understanding of regulatory requirements in fintech or financial services, with hands-on experience shipping compliant products in highly regulated environments.

• Ability to partner effectively with engineering teams, break down technical trade-offs, and build scalable, platform-level solutions rather than one-off customisations.

• Comfortable thinking globally, switching contexts rapidly across multiple product pillars, and navigating evolving priorities in a dynamic environment.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to align senior internal stakeholders and engage credibly with institutional partners when required.

What’s in it for you
• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.

• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.

• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.

• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.

• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.

• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.

• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.

• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.

• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.

• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.

• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

.…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.
Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. * These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Platform & Ecosystem
jobs.description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

About the Role:

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike’s Work Intelligence Unit is building the foundation for a work delivery platform for humans and agents. MCP gives AI assistants secure, permission-aware access to Wrike, Skills help them use that access effectively and GraphQL provides a structured foundation for retrieving and acting on work data.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the product direction for Wrike’s AI Platform & Ecosystem, including MCP, Skills and GraphQL. You will make Wrike easier for AI assistants and agents to understand, use and extend.

This is a platform role with broad leverage. You will lead the core MCP team, help other Wrike teams create their own MCP tools and Skills where they hold domain expertise and give the GraphQL engineering team clear product direction on how its capabilities and tools should evolve. You will also own the publishing and ongoing quality of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant AI marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.

Role Scope:

You will own the strategy and roadmap for Wrike’s agent-facing platform, working closely with the core MCP and GraphQL engineering teams complemented by Architecture, Security, customer-facing and product teams across Wrike.

MCP, Skills and GraphQL Strategy:

• Lead the core MCP team and define the roadmap for how external AI assistants and agents securely interact with Wrike.

• Define MCP standards and enable other Wrike teams to create high-quality tools for the domains where they have expertise.

• Lead the discovery and creation of Skills that help agents and AI assistants use Wrike effectively, while establishing standards that other teams can follow.

• Set the product direction for GraphQL and the tools built on top of it, ensuring its evolution improves the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core.

Ecosystem, Quality and Distribution:

• Own the publishing, maintenance and evolution of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.

• Create a clear approach to MCP quality, reliability, governance, documentation and developer experience.

• Work with customers, partners and internal teams to identify the highest-value agent workflows and improve them through feedback and usage data.

• Translate technical trade-offs into clear product decisions; hands-on coding is not required.

What You Will Help Shape:

• A scalable MCP and Skills ecosystem that lets AI assistants and agents securely understand and act on work in Wrike, while enabling Wrike teams to contribute their domain expertise.

• GraphQL capabilities and tools that broaden the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core for MCP, Skills, and future agent experiences.

• A strong marketplace presence and high-quality plugin experience across the AI assistants where customers want to use Wrike.

Your Impact:

• Make Wrike a trusted, useful system of action for AI assistants and agents working across customers’ existing ecosystems.

• Give customers reliable, permission-aware ways to let AI assistants retrieve context and take action in Wrike.

• Turn customer needs, ecosystem signals and technical constraints into a focused roadmap for MCP, Skills and GraphQL.

• Enable other teams across Wrike to contribute agent-ready tools and Skills while maintaining shared standards for quality and governance.

Your Qualifications:

• 5+ years of PM experience in technical, platform, AI, developer, or enterprise software.

• Experience with MCP and Skills, including how agents use tools and guidance to act effectively.

• Technical fluency in AI agents, MCP, Skills, permissions, reliability, and developer experience; hands-on engineering is not required. GraphQL experience and an understanding of structured product data is a major advantage.

• Use customer research, adoption data, experiments, and feedback to set priorities and improve outcomes.

• Explain complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.

• Proactive and can-do: take ownership, solve problems, and adapt as you learn.

Why This Role Is Unique:

• You will help define how Wrike becomes a trusted platform for AI assistants and agents, not just a destination where work is stored.

• You will work at the intersection of agentic AI, developer experience, enterprise permissions, platform strategy and customer value.

• The role is remote across the European Union, with a preference for Prague, Czech Republic and Cyprus.

What’s Next?

• Introduction Call with a Recruiter

• Conversation with the AI Product Director

• Interview with Product and Engineering, Architecture representatives

• Final interview with CPO and HRBP

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.

Who Is Wrike And Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

Hybrid work mode

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.

While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Roadmap) - Star Trek Fleet Command
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Star Trek™ Fleet Command team in Barcelona on a hybrid basis.

Star Trek Fleet Command's ongoing success goes from strength to strength. Our in-house developed 4X MMO was launched in 2018 and continues to evolve, being consistently one of the top grossing Massive Multiplayer Strategy games on the market.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What You Will Do

As the Senior Product Manager , you will be the product owner for key monetisation and engagement initiatives across the live game. This includes driving the roadmap and execution of our monthly content releases, ensuring they are cohesive, compelling, and highly performant. You will work cross-functionally with Game Design, Product Marketing, Product Ops, Economy Design, and Data Science teams to define, prioritise, and deliver exceptional player experiences that meet business and player goals.

• Own the content and performance strategy for our monthly releases, aligning them to player motivations, economic balance, and business KPIs

• Define and manage the monthly content calendar, collaborating with Design, Production, and Engineering to deliver high-quality, on-time experiences

• Use data and experimentation to optimise monetisation, engagement, and retention across a broad player lifecycle—from new users to end-game whales

• Deeply understand player behaviour across multiple geos and platforms to ensure we deliver value through personalisation and segmentation strategies

• Work closely with the economy and systems design teams to ensure content aligns with long-term progression goals and avoids inflation

• Partner with UX, Research, and Community teams to develop empathy for player sentiment and pain points, and translate them into actionable product improvements

• Build business cases for major new initiatives and content verticals, including competitive research and revenue forecasting

• Mentor junior PMs and contribute to a culture of product excellence and cross-functional collaboration.

What We're Looking For

• Extensive experience in product management, ideally with significant responsibility on a F2P mobile game

• Demonstrated success managing complex monetisation and engagement systems, with extensive experience in content development

• Data-native mindset, with the ability to translate raw performance metrics into strategic insights and actionable plans

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proven track record of aligning diverse teams around a shared product vision

• Strong player empathy and experience working with user research, community feedback, or other voice-of-player channels

• Experience driving impact across cross-functional pods, including creative, design, and engineering teams

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @scopely.com.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Experience
jobs.description:
Job Description

About the Team : Our Technology team drives the evolution of our Technology, Engineering, Data, Product and User Experience functions. With a keen focus on delivering cutting-edge solutions, we shape the digital landscape for our customers, readers and users. From revolutionizing visuals to optimizing tools and harnessing the power of data, mobile, video and social platforms, our team is committed to providing a seamless and immersive experience across all touchpoints. Collaborating closely with our newsrooms and strategic partners, we spearhead the development of groundbreaking products and technologies. About the Role

Dow Jones is hiring a Senior Product Manager to help shape how AI shows up across our product portfolio. This role will help build the AI experiences across both consumer products (WSJ, Barron's, MarketWatch) and our professional information products (Factiva, WSJ Pro, Oxford Analytica, Dragonfly). You will partner closely with the internal teams that build our AI agent and orchestration platform, our search platform, and our personalization platform to ensure the experiences you ship consume reusable services rather than one-off implementations. Most importantly, you will represent the end user (whether a subscriber on their morning commute or an analyst building a client briefing) in the AI roadmap to ensure our work represents something that adds value to their lives.

The role sits on the GenAI Experiences team and reports to the Director of Product Management.

You Will

• Own the AI experience roadmap for one or more surfaces across the portfolio, with success measured against retention, engagement, and demonstrable user value, not shipped feature count.

• Translate the specific jobs of our users (consumer subscribers, financial analysts, risk and legal professionals, researchers) into AI experiences that do the work, save the time, or reveal insight they could not surface on their own, and ship them on reusable shared capabilities rather than hand-built per product.

• Partner with the internal platform teams to bring your users' requirements into the shared capability roadmap, and run the experimentation and measurement discipline that lets us tell retention-grade stories about AI impact.

You Have

• 7+ years of product management experience, preferably with at least 2 years shipping AI-powered products in production (using LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, agent-based or retrieval-based systems).

• Experience owning a consumer, B2B, or enterprise product that serves a well-defined user, ideally one where retention or engagement is the north-star metric.

Scopely is looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to join our unannounced project in Barcelona on a hybrid basis or at any of our remote locations in the UK, Portugal, and Ireland.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people worldwide daily.

We are in the early stages of development on an ambitious, unannounced, cross-platform Strategy/MMO featuring a well-known IP. You have the opportunity to join a highly experienced team to make a lasting impact on one of the next big releases.

What You Will Do

• Strategic Planning and Execution: Drive the roadmap and technical requirements for platform systems, backend services, and tooling needed to support a global, live-operated mobile/PC game.

• Leadership and Mentorship: Provide leadership in daily tasks and larger projects, ensuring quality and timely execution.

• Data Analysis and Insights: Help define technical KPIs, monitor performance, and identify areas of optimisation or risk.

• Communication and Collaboration: Serve as a vocal and proactive member of the team, actively communicate complex ideas clearly, and maintain visibility with upper management and cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and address potential issues.

What We’re Looking For

• Experience in technical product management and/or software engineering in the mobile games industry.

• Experience writing technical specifications, translating product needs into system-level requirements.

• Skilled in managing backlogs, setting goals, and choosing the right tools and techniques to achieve high-quality results.

• Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs and communicate risks or constraints to non-technical stakeholders.

Bonus Points

• Background in Software Engineering

• Previous working experience with live software.

• Familiarity with custom rendering pipelines or GPU-driven rendering architecture

At Scopely, we create games for everyone and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us and embrace the adventure!

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

jobs.description:

Our clients are mostly mobile gaming leaders but also span e-commerce, on-demand services, and entertainment apps. Recognized for 10+ years as one of the top mobile retargeting platforms, Adikteev now operates globally from Paris, San Francisco, Barcelona and Seoul and has grown to over 120 employees.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Data Products
jobs.description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

Every great learning experience at Preply starts with great data. Our data product team builds foundational data products from governed, reusable data models and semantic layers. They power analytics, AI (classic ML and LLMs) and the necessary context for agentic products, helping Preply drive growth, innovate faster and become a truly AI-native company.

We’re a new function with a greenfield mandate, working alongside a high-calibre product and engineering organisation, and you’ll be the first product manager dedicated to shaping what we build and in what order.

What You’ll Be Doing

Ownership: Shape and build the foundational data products for a fast-growing learning platform and marketplace, and modernise our data foundations and data platforms so every team can build on data that is trusted, governed and AI-ready.

Strategy and roadmap: Decide which data products to build and in what order. Spot opportunities with business and product teams, especially those that build our data moat, and make sure the data we build gets adopted and used.

Partners: Work hand in hand with analytics engineering, data science, engineering, product, finance and business teams.

Success: Prove the return on our data products by showing how they drive company and product outcomes and business performance.

What You Need To Succeed

• Experience in a senior product role, with proven experience building data products.

• Demonstrated business impact from data products, backed by tangible examples.

• Strong product craft: you plan and run an agile product process, build roadmaps, define metrics, coordinate stakeholders and make complex trade-offs with sound judgement.

• Experience working with data engineers or analytics engineers.

• A track record of driving adoption through compelling, high-quality data products that people choose to use, and of demoing new ways to use data that unlock new products and business experiences.

• Working knowledge of SQL, data governance tools and modern data platforms.

Nice to have

• Experience leading data modernisation transformations.

• Experience building company-wide agentic analytics

Why you'll enjoy working at Preply:

• An open, collaborative, dynamic, and diverse culture

• A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com

• Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development

• A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance, and health insurance

• Attractive relocation package for those not in Barcelona to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub

• Access to free mental health support platforms

• Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health

• The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!)

Our Principles

• Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.

• We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.

In this role, you will own a meaningful product area within The Knot’s wedding vendor marketplace, with a likely focus on recommendations, matching, and personalization. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Financial Services Ops
jobs.description:
Your role

We’re looking for a Product Manager to lead Financial Services Ops , the squad that turns compliance, risk, and operational needs into product. Your internal customers are the Compliance, Operations, Risk, and Fraud teams that keep Spendesk’s payment licence running, together with the four Financial Services squads building cards, wallets, and transfers for end customers.

Today, those teams pull product and engineering time from across Financial Services. A regulatory change, a manual operational workload, or a risk alert can become a new P0 on another squad’s roadmap. Your role is to absorb that demand, turn it into one prioritised backlog, and build the tools and workflows that help compliance and operations scale without slowing the rest of Financial Services down.

The squad already owns KYC and AML, including company onboarding, representative verification, ongoing transaction monitoring, and the migration of our transaction monitoring system. The scope is broader than KYC and AML: you will own the internal platform between Spendesk’s regulated entity and the products built on top of it.

What You’ll Own

• Onboarding and KYC: company and representative verification, document collection, and time-to-activation.

• AML and monitoring: transaction monitoring, alert handling, and the transaction monitoring system migration.

• Operations tooling: back-office tools, case management, and dashboards that replace manual work.

• Risk and fraud controls: controls, limits, and the signals Risk and Fraud teams need to act.

• Regulatory intake: one entry point and one priority order for regulatory and operational requests across Compliance, Legal, and the Financial Services squads.

• Infrastructure vendors: identity verification, monitoring, and BaaS partners across the EU, UK, and US.

What You’ll Do

• Define the platform strategy and roadmap so it serves Financial Services business goals and regulatory obligations.

• Replace the current competing-P0 model with a single intake and prioritised backlog agreed by Compliance, Operations, and the Financial Services squads.

• Rebuild company onboarding to reduce time-to-activation, improve document completion, and remove manual rework.

• Lead the transaction monitoring system migration with Engineering and Compliance.

• Build internal tools and dashboards that help Operations scale without adding headcount at the same pace.

• Define and instrument metrics that do not exist yet, including time-to-activation, file completeness at KYC entry, cost per manual case, straight-through processing rate, and engineering time spent on internal requests outside your squad.

• Act as the bridge between Product and Compliance, so regulation is designed in rather than patched later.

• Evaluate and manage identity, monitoring, and infrastructure vendors.

What We’re Looking For

• 5+ years of Product Management experience, ideally in fintech, payments, banking, or another regulated environment.

• Experience building products for internal users, such as back-office, operations tooling, platform, or infrastructure products.

• Comfort working with regulation. You do not need to be a lawyer, but PSD2, AML directives, compliance policies, and conversations with an MLRO should be familiar territory.

• Analytical rigour: you define success metrics, instrument what is not measured yet, and use evidence to prioritise.

• Clear, natural communication. You can explain a regulation in plain language, build trust with Compliance, Operations, and Engineering, and negotiate scope without losing substance.

• The resilience to work effectively in a changing environment with ambiguity and shifting priorities.

Nice to have

• Hands-on experience with KYC, KYB, AML, or transaction monitoring.

• Experience owning onboarding or identity verification flows with measurable outcomes.

• Experience leading a vendor migration or infrastructure integration, such as a BaaS, card processor, or monitoring provider integration.

• Experience working across EU, UK, and US regulatory contexts.

• Fluency in French or Spanish.

About Spendesk

Spendesk is the AI-powered spend management and procurement platform that transforms company spending. By simplifying procurement, payment cards, expense management, invoice processing, and accounting automation, Spendesk gives employees a simpler way to spend and finance leaders the visibility and control they need across company spend, including multi-entity structures.

Spendesk supports more than 200,000 users across companies including PayFit, Accor, Welcome to the Jungle, Swile, Big Mamma, Malt, and Yousign. The company has offices in the United Kingdom, France, Spain, and Germany, and puts community at the heart of its mission.

For more information: www.spendesk.com/press

About Our People And Culture

We believe people do their best work when they have the freedom to thrive and grow. Liberation is at the core of how we work: we empower Spendeskers to take ownership, navigate ambiguity, and seize opportunities. Our international team spans more than 35 countries, with a shared commitment to curiosity, kindness, and tackling challenges with a positive mindset.

About Our Benefits

Our culture is built on trust, empowerment, and growth, with benefits to match:

• Flexible on-site and remote policy.

• Latest Apple equipment.

• Access to Moka.care for emotional and mental health wellbeing.

• Great office snacks.

• A positive team to work with every day.

We also offer location-specific benefits, including health insurance, wellness allowances, commuter support, meal vouchers, and gym memberships.

Diversity and inclusion

At Spendesk, we are committed to fostering an environment where differences are encouraged, supported, and celebrated. We are building our culture for everyone, with everyone, and welcome people from all backgrounds.

As we are an international team, please submit your application and CV in English.

Job Description The Senior Product Manager (MLS) is structured, analytical and curious, and loves getting close to clients to understand what they really need. You will own new and existing products for MLSs (Multiple Listing Services), the organisations that connect real estate brokers and agents in a given geography through shared listing data and standards. You’ll be thinking big about how we can use our tech to keep innovating in the space, and get your hands dirty taking your products from early ideas through launch and growth.
You will report to our VP of Product, sit in our Product team and collaborate closely with engineering, data, sales, marketing and customer success. Around 30% of your time will be client-facing: regular sessions with client stakeholders, interviews with agents, brokers and other industry players, and focus groups. Staying on top of industry news and trends is part of the job.
You’ll spend your first months getting to know our clients, our products and the MLS world, then phase into full ownership of both new and existing products, including our most complex ones.

About Restb.ai We are a Barcelona-based scale-up, and world leader in generating AI insights for the real estate sector. We use computer vision, machine learning and large language models to examine real estate photos and listing data and turn them into insights that support property valuations across many subsegments and in 35 countries.

Main duties and responsibilities
• Own MLS-focused products end to end, from discovery and ideation through launch, adoption and ongoing improvement.

• Run regular sessions, interviews and focus groups with MLSs, brokers and agents, and turn what you hear into clear insights and decisions.

• Turn these insights into detailed product specs and requirements, and work with our engineering and product teams to deliver them.

• Make hypotheses, then prototype, test and pitch ideas quickly (using LLMs and other tools is encouraged) to find where value can be unlocked.

• Define success metrics for your products and track how they perform.

• Test and validate development work to make sure it works as expected.

• Work with sales and marketing on positioning, messaging and content, and support them with product expertise.

• Stay up to date with MLS and real estate industry news, trends and competitors.

• Continually improve the way things are done around you.

Desired skills and experience
• Bachelor’s degree with a quantitative focus (Engineering, Statistics, Business Analytics, Data Science, Math, Economics, etc.), or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years in product management, ideally in B2B SaaS or data products, with a track record of owning a roadmap and shipping products that moved key metrics.

• Knowledge of MLSs, brokerages or residential real estate is a strong plus, but not required.

• Hands-on experience running customer discovery and translating it into roadmap decisions.

• Confident running user interviews, workshops and focus groups, and comfortable presenting to clients and senior stakeholders.

• A strong and proactive communicator, with an active awareness of accountability and risk and how to escalate accordingly.

Job title: Senior Product Manager / Product Lead (Bestplay)
Location: Barcelona, Spain
Employment type: Full-time

About Bluetile

Bluetile makes high-velocity casual and hybrid-casual mobile games, and runs Bestplay, a leading play-to-earn app. Our games have passed 350 million installs worldwide, with several titles regularly in the US top 20 charts. We do it with a team of fewer than 60 people.
We build complete new games in two to four months and ship major features in weeks, not quarters. We use AI across game art, software development, live ops and analytics. Bluetile is part of the Nazara Technologies Group, and we’re entering our next phase of fast growth.

The role

Bestplay is one of the top play-to-earn apps in the world, with millions of downloads and a fast-growing, highly engaged user base, run by a small, efficient team. We’re hiring product leaders, from senior product manager up to director, to be core operators on Bestplay.
You’ll own the execution and results of major product features and domains, with a strong focus on growth, monetisation and live operations. This is a hands-on role: you’ll look at A/B results, configs and tickets yourself.

What you’ll do

• Own product domains end to end: turn high-level roadmap goals into shippable features, and be accountable for their commercial performance and speed of execution

• Move the metrics: track and improve revenue, retention, LTV and conversion through pricing models, rewarded mechanics, UX improvements and constant A/B experiments

• Run live ops and engagement: design and run in-app events, promotions and reward surges that improve D1, D7 and D30 retention and build daily habits

• Own UX quality: design user flows and wireframes in close collaboration with designers and developers

• Cover the whole product in a lean team: contribute to community engagement, player and customer support feedback, data tracking improvements, and anti-hacking and abuse prevention

• Study the market: regularly play competitor and adjacent apps to find mechanics and improvements worth taking

What we’re looking for

• 4+ years of product management in high-volume consumer mobile apps, rewarded platforms or mobile games

• A strong commercial and numbers mindset: confident with conversion funnels, payout and reward margins, A/B test statistics and daily dashboards

• Accountability for business metrics and revenue, not just sprint management

• A hands-on approach: you’re happy to build wireframes, investigate fraud patterns, read user tickets and work directly with engineers

• A good understanding of gamification and retention: streaks, progress bars, reward pacing and the psychology of engagement

• An interest in sustainable consumer app retention and reward economics (this role is not focused on crypto, tokens or NFTs)

We’re open to people from senior product manager up to director level.

Nice to have:

• Experience with offerwalls, rewarded play loops, payout economies or partner tracking

• Exposure to fraud prevention, bot detection or anti-abuse in high-volume consumer apps

How we work

• Autonomy and ownership: we expect a lot of ownership and accountability, and what matters is what you deliver. There are no mandatory office days

• Fast impact: what you want to change in the product one day can ship the next day or the next week

• Hands-on, small team: we have few managers and no layers of coordinators, and everyone stays close to the details

• Flat and organic: we’re a start-up, not a corporate. There are no fixed levels or formal growth meetings, and people who show impact take on more

• High expectations: the flexibility comes with high expectations, and it isn’t the right environment for everyone

jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Product Performance Manager to join our MONOPOLY GO! team in our Barcelona (Spain) Hub on a hybrid basis.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and one of the biggest mobile game launches in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.

As a Senior Product Manager within Live Mini Games Performance, you will own the performance and continuous optimization of some of MONOPOLY GO!’s most important live experiences. You’ll combine deep analytics, experimentation, player insights, and strong product judgment to identify opportunities and turn them into measurable improvements in engagement and business performance.

What You’ll Do

Drive Performance, Experimentation & Insights

• Own performance for key Live Mini Games, developing a deep understanding of player behavior, engagement, and business outcomes

• Identify opportunities through quantitative and qualitative analysis and translate insights into clear product actions

• Build and manage a strong pipeline of A/B tests and live optimizations, defining hypotheses, KPIs, and success criteria

• Lead performance readouts and turn learnings into broader strategies and best practices across the Mini Games portfolio

• Continuously optimize gameplay, balancing, rewards, pacing, and other live levers to improve player experience and performance

Own Execution & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Independently prioritize opportunities and drive initiatives from hypothesis through execution, measurement, and iteration

• Partner closely with Analytics, Data Science, Economy, Game Design, Production, Engineering, and Live Operations

• Act as a go-to product expert for your areas of ownership and proactively communicate performance, insights, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders

• Help raise the performance, experimentation, and analytical rigor of the wider team

Embrace AI as a Product & Productivity Tool

• Use AI tools to accelerate analysis, ideation, research, documentation, and everyday product workflows

• Identify opportunities to apply AI to improve how we understand players, optimize Live Mini Games, and operate the portfolio

• Experiment with emerging AI capabilities and help establish effective AI-enabled ways of working across the team

What We’re Looking For

• 3+ years of experience in Product Management, Economy Management, Analytics, or related disciplines (edited)

• Strong track record of using data, experimentation, and product judgment to improve measurable product outcomes

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to independently turn complex data into actionable insights

• Experience defining hypotheses, KPIs, A/B tests, and performance readouts

• Strong understanding of F2P game systems, LiveOps, player behavior, and game economies

• High degree of ownership and comfort independently prioritizing and solving complex problems

• AI-savvy mindset with hands-on experience using AI tools to improve the quality and speed of your work

• Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

Nice to Have

• Experience working on successful live-service mobile games

• Experience with casual or social games

• Experience with game economy, balancing, segmentation, or LiveOps optimization

• Advanced SQL, Excel, or other analytical tooling experience

• Experience applying AI to analytics, experimentation, game development, or LiveOps

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Referral
jobs.description:
¿Quiénes somos?
Filmin es la plataforma de streaming de referencia para los amantes del cine en España y Portugal. Cine independiente, documentales para entender el mundo, las series más premiadas, grandes clásicos de la historia del cine y un acceso privilegiado a los festivales de cine más importantes del mundo.

Qué buscamos
En Filmin existimos porque el cine nos cambió la vida.
Tenemos un producto en el que el criterio editorial es el protagonista, y que se complementa con nuestra tecnología y con la comunidad a la hora de cualificar y recomendar qué ver.
Creemos que en esa intersección entre cine seleccionado con criterio, el software y la comunidad existen grandes oportunidades para cambiar la vida a más gente.
Buscamos incorporar un rol de Product Manager a quien le apasione encontrar estas oportunidades, liderar una visión que las articule, y lleve a cabo su ejecución de manera alineada con los objetivos que tenemos como negocio.
Si te interesa el product-led growth , las comunidades y el cine, sigue leyendo.

El equipo
Formarás parte de un equipo de Producto que impulsa la evolución de la plataforma en distintas áreas estratégicas. Tu día a día será colaborativo y trabajarás de cerca con:

• Diseño de Producto: transformando insights de usuarios en experiencias simples, intuitivas y atractivas.

• Desarrollo (Frontend, Backend, Mobile, TVs, QA): definiendo y entregando funcionalidades de manera ágil, escalable y de alta calidad.

• Data: fundamentando las decisiones en métricas claras, validación continua y aprendizajes accionables.

• Customer Experience: garantizando que el producto se adapte a las necesidades y expectativas reales de los usuarios.

• Editorial: asegurando la coherencia y relevancia de los contenidos y mensajes dentro del producto.

• Marketing: alineando los lanzamientos con las estrategias de marca, adquisición, recuperación y retención.

• Stakeholders de negocio: manteniendo la visión del producto siempre alineada con los objetivos estratégicos de la compañía.

Nos movemos en un entorno colaborativo, donde la comunicación transparente, la creatividad aplicada y la mejora continua son algunas de las claves del éxito.

Funciones y responsabilidades

• Definir la estrategia de una vertical de producto digital alineada con fuertes objetivos de negocio, priorizando en el roadmap las iniciativas con mayor potencial.

• Construir y lanzar de manera controlada iniciativas dentro de nuestro ecosistema de software, colaborando de cerca con equipos multidisciplinares (diseño, desarrollo, data, CX, editorial, marca, etc).

• Tomar decisiones que aseguren el impacto buscado, analizando métricas de uso y feedback de usuarios para realizar ajustes de alcance y cambios de rumbo.

• Llevar a cabo investigación generativa y evaluativa para detectar oportunidades de crecimiento y validar soluciones en etapas tempranas del desarrollo de producto.

• Liderar la conversación con responsables de diferentes áreas de la compañía para alinear la estrategia de producto con el resto del negocio.

• Desarrollar y mantener relaciones clave con partners, identificando oportunidades de colaboración que aporten valor al producto y negocio.

Requisitos clave
Habilidades y experiencia profesional

• Experiencia previa relevante en gestión de productos digitales, idealmente en sectores y productos relacionados como video/audio on demand, apps móviles, plataformas OTT o modelos de suscripción B2C.

• Background en tecnología. Conocimientos técnicos para entender arquitecturas digitales, trabajar junto a equipos de desarrollo de software, y construir prototipos o hacer aportaciones al código.

• Dominio de los mecanismos para la creación y desarrollo de programas de loyalty, member-get-member o comunidades.

• Enfoque product-led growth . Experiencia definiendo y ejecutando estrategias PLG y loops de crecimiento*.*

• Liderazgo en metodología de producto. Conocimiento de s hape-up, visión crítica de las metodologías ágiles y la inteligencia artificial y flexibilidad para adaptarlas a un entorno diferente.

• Capacidad de trabajar en entornos cross-funcionales. Colaborar con ingeniería, diseño de producto, marketing y growth, data, legal, CX, etc.

La candidatura ideal…

• Comprende el negocio. Capacidad para entender una cuenta de resultados básica y hacer proyecciones de crecimiento.

• Toma decisiones basadas en datos. Uso de evidencias y datos de comportamiento, negocio y producto (con herramientas como Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Tableau, etc) para establecer indicadores clave, objetivos y priorizar iniciativas.

• Disminuye riesgo haciendo experimentos de bajo coste. Experiencia diseñando y evaluando experimentos A/B.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

• Contrato indefinido

• Rango salarial de 35-45K €

• Modalidad de trabajo híbrido: 3 días en remoto + 2 días presenciales en nuestra oficina de Barcelona

• Horario flexible

• Jornada intensiva durante los meses de verano y cada viernes

• 23 días de vacaciones anuales + Vacaciones Extra (Filmin Days)

• Oportunidades de Formación

• Una bolsa de 1.440 € anuales para utilizar en beneficios flexibles (Seguro Médico, Restaurantes, Transporte…)

• Cheque Guardería (600 euros anuales)

• Actividades/Eventos dentro y fuera de la oficina

Job Summary

As a Data Product Manager, you are obsessed with crafting personalized customer experiences that build upon your knowledge of the data flow across the customer print hardware and HP Smart ecosystems. You will work in a highly cross functional and dynamic environment to develop ways to leverage real-time data to define customer experiences within the products and through personalized communications. Not only will you define the data products to power engaging experiences, but you will also apply your knowledge of artificial intelligence and machine learning to automate and build new insights and capabilities. Key to this role is a core belief that building trust with our customers is critical and demonstrated by understanding the impact of the latest privacy policies on data capture and usage. You have a strong foundation in analytics and experience with collaborating with product management, engineering and marketing teams. Overall, you love how data can drive delightful and engaging customer experiences and are excited to scale it worldwide.

Responsibilities

• Deeply understand HP’s product and services data ecosystem in order to leverage existing capabilities and define new requirements for future experiences

• Balance the strategy, governance, and implementation of anything data related, and facilitate the conversations between all impacted stakeholders - executives, engineers, analysts, product teams, and external customers.

• Collaborate closely with the CRM, product and service teams to define data and functional requirements to deliver personalized experiences across all communication touchpoints.

• Apply your knowledge of AI and ML to define data products, schemas and models to automate customer experiences that can scale.

• Translate the requirements of large data initiatives into smaller, agile based stories that can be delivered in increments and then working to allocate resources for each initiative.

• Define a roadmap that defines the data requirements for new feature development that incorporates the needs of customers and the business.

• Understand the customer’s experience by continually immersing yourself in feedback and sentiment data to map out data personas and consumer profiles.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
Wallapop is a Barcelona based scale-up driven by the purpose to empower people to embrace a more conscious and human way of consumption. We believe in a world where collaborative economy is mainstream. This is what drives us💫.
Wallapop operates in Spain, Italy and Portugal, offering a catalogue of several hundreds of millions of products and services. Powered by technical innovation and continuous improvement, we bring together the scale & trust of classifieds with the marketplace’s convenience & reach. Our mission is to enable a connected trade ecosystem, making 2nd-hand the norm through smart use of technology.

The Challenge 🧩
Drive long-term user value and sustainable business growth by shaping and executing the product strategy for some of Wallapop’s most complex, high-impact initiatives. You will leverage data, experimentation, technical collaboration, and deep user empathy to unlock new marketplace opportunities, elevate product craft, and deliver step-function improvements in user experience.

What You Will Do 👇

• Product Strategy & Vision: Define and execute a long-term product roadmap for high-impact marketplace initiatives, aligning product vision with company goals to drive meaningful user and business outcomes.

• End-to-End Delivery & Collaboration: Lead discovery, definition, and delivery across cross-functional squads (engineering, design, analytics, and business operations) to turn complex challenges into simple, delightful user journeys.

• Technical Collaboration: Partner with engineering leadership to ensure product architecture supports long-term scalability, advocating for foundational improvements that support platform stability and experimentation velocity.

• Experimentation & Insights: Combine quantitative analytics, experimentation (A/B testing), and direct user research to validate hypotheses and make high-confidence roadmap decisions.

• Stakeholder Alignment: Communicate strategic trade-offs, roadmap priorities, and vision clearly across executive leadership and cross-functional teams to build alignment and shared momentum.

• Product Craft & Mentorship: Elevate product management standards across the chapter through active coaching, shared best practices, and collaborative knowledge-sharing.

What We’re Looking For 🔎

• Proven track record of defining product strategy and delivering measurable business outcomes (e.g., conversion improvement, user retention, revenue growth, or marketplace liquidity).

• Ability to collaborate closely with engineering teams on architecture, API integrations, and data flows, effectively balancing immediate delivery with long-term technical health.

• Competence in utilizing quantitative data, self-serve analytics, and user research to build structured, evidence-based business cases and product roadmaps.

• Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize high-leverage opportunities, and advocate for user-centric product decisions in complex organizational environments.

• Full professional working proficiency in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences. Spanish is a plus.

What Would Be A Plus 🚀

• Experience integrating emerging technologies (such as LLMs or automation tools) into consumer products or internal workflows to improve user experience and team velocity.

• Prior experience in two-sided marketplaces, e-commerce, or consumer tech platforms

Do note that all our jobs are 📍 Barcelona based. We follow a hybrid model where flexibility rules. We commit to a minimum of 6 days per month in the office. Each team self-organizes to decide on cadence and in-person/remote rituals.

Wallapop is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees as we want Wallapop to be a place for everyone.
We sponsor visa processes for international candidates when applicable and provide legal & admin support along the process combined with a competitive relocation package.

Additionally to the opportunity to contribute to an agile product set up and work together towards achieving our meaningful mission, we offer the following 🍭 Perks & Benefits :

• Generous individual learning budget of 2k per year

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
Labhouse is a fast-growing startup that builds, launches, and scales its own AI & Productivity Apps, operating under a subscription-based business model.

Based in Barcelona, Labhouse was founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos (Co-Founders of SocialPoint).

We operate at the intersection of mobile technology, AI, and product-driven growth, with a strong focus on experimentation and performance.

Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below.

About The Role

As a Lead Product Manager at Labhouse , you will be responsible for leading the product end-to-end , working closely with the CEOs to define, build, and scale our apps. Your mission will be to own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution , with a strong focus on driving revenue growth across our portfolio .

You will take full ownership of the product lifecycle — from ideation and validation to launch and optimization — combining strong product intuition, design sensibility, and analytical rigor . This role requires someone highly autonomous, entrepreneurial, and impact-driven , capable of defining KPIs, building dashboards, and making data-informed decisions.

You'll be responsible for:

• Work closely with CEOs to define new app opportunities and build products from scratch.

• Own the product roadmap of live apps, optimizing core features and improving key KPIs.

• Lead product development end-to-end, from ideation to post-launch optimization.

• Drive revenue growth across products through continuous experimentation and iteration.

• Define and implement KPIs, dashboards, and analytics frameworks to track performance.

• Design and optimize user funnels: acquisition, retention, monetization, and virality.

• Gather and structure user feedback and customer support insights to inform product decisions.

• Continuously benchmark competitors and explore innovative approaches to improve product quality and UX.

• Collaborate closely with design, engineering, and marketing teams to deliver high-impact features.

• Leverage AI tools to accelerate research, prototyping, and decision-making

About You:

Academic background:

• Ideally, with a technical degree (Computer Science, Data, or Telecommunications Engineering), to feel comfortable building dashboards and working hands-on with data.

What Are We Looking For

• Experience building products from 0 to 1 and 1 to 100

• Experience in mobile development, preferably in mobile apps with subscription-based models, F2P games, or consumer products.

• Strong product sense and design intuition, with the ability to create experiences that drive user behavior.

• Hands-on mindset: not just defining product strategy, but personally driving its implementation and execution to grow revenue.

• Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to define KPIs, interpret data, and generate actionable insights.

• Solid analytical foundation: SQL, statistics, experimentation, and product metrics (CAC, LTV, retention, ARPU). Hands-on experience with analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel)

• Strong project management skills, able to prioritize high-impact initiatives, understand trade-offs, and mitigate risks.

• High level of ownership, autonomy, and entrepreneurial mindset.

• Passion for UI/UX and Apple-like product experiences.

• Good level of spoken and written English.

Communication:

• Solid level of spoken and written English.

• Clear, structured communicator who can simplify complex data into product narratives

• Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including engineering, product, and marketing.

Nice to Have:

• Experience building products from 0 to 1.

• Experience working closely with founders or in startup environments.

What we Offer:

• The opportunity to work side by side with serial entrepreneurs who've built and exited at the highest level

• A real path to becoming a product leader, mentored directly by the CEO

• A fast-moving, AI-native environment where shipping beats talking

• Work with cutting-edge technologies, including the chance to integrate AI models into new apps.

• Remote work from anywhere in Spain. If you are based in Barcelona, we would love for you to join us at the office (Barcelona Tech City) at least two days a week.

• Flexible working hours.

• Permanent contract with an attractive compensation package, above the market average

• A young and top entrepreneurial team in a dynamic startup environment.

Hiring Process

• TA Interview – Initial conversation to get to know each other and understand your background.

• Team Interview – Deep dive into your product thinking, experience, and fit with the team.

• Technical Case & Presentation– Practical exercise to assess your product, analytical, and strategic capabilities.

• Final Interview – Final conversation to ensure alignment on expectations, culture, and role fit.
