Labhouse is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. However you identify or whatever your journey to this point, we welcome all candidates to apply for the position that inspires them.

Come join us and help us build a company that everyone is proud to be part of.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - Advertising
jobs.description:
WELCOME TO OLX

We're building marketplace sustainable ecosystems that millions of people depend on every month – to buy and sell cars, find homes, land jobs, and trade secondhand goods. It's commerce that matters: safe , smart , and environmentally responsible .

We do this with courage to innovate, commitment to outcomes, collaboration across 50+ nationalities and 7 markets, and a customer-led approach that puts real people first. Add a desire to win – and you get a culture that's ambitious, fast-moving, and built on trust.

Our brands – including AutoTrader, OLX, Otomoto Property24, and more – are loved by millions. And we're backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest tech investors.

Join OLX And See How Far You Can Go.

About the role

Advertising is one of OLX's most important revenue lines - and one of its biggest opportunities. Today, our advertising business spans multiple markets, formats, and platforms, but it needs a product leader who can take it to the next level: from foundational ad-tech infrastructure to new revenue surfaces powered by AI.

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the global advertising product end-to-end. This means everything from the ad-core stack (serving, auction, targeting, measurement) to growing revenue beyond listings through self-serve advertiser tools, programmatic demand, and retail-media formats. You'll also shape how advertising integrates into AI-native surfaces — balancing monetisation yield against buyer experience.

This is a role for someone who has built advertising products at scale, understands the programmatic ecosystem, and is excited about using AI to create new advertising experiences. You'll work closely with business and commercial stakeholders to grow revenue, while ensuring our advertising never compromises the trust our users place in the platform.

This role reports to the Head of Product.

What You'll Do

• Own the global advertising product end-to-end: ad-core stack (serving, auction, targeting, measurement) across all marketplaces and platforms

• Drive growth of advertising revenue beyond listings, including self-serve advertiser tools, programmatic demand, and retail-media formats such as sponsored listings, native, and video

• Own integration of ads into AI-native surfaces such as AutoIQ and agentic search, balancing yield against buyer experience

• Define and track advertising success metrics: revenue, fill rate, eCPM, advertiser ROI, buyer experience impact

• Partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, and Sales teams to build the product capabilities that unlock revenue growth

• Represent the advertising product at the leadership level, presenting strategy and results to executive audiences

What we're looking for

• Significant product management experience in digital advertising, ad-tech, monetisation, or revenue product at scale

• Proven track record of building and scaling advertising products — programmatic ads, third-party ads, billing systems, or ad-serving platforms

• Experience taking advertising or monetisation products from early-stage to meaningful revenue

• Ability to balance monetisation yield with user experience — making evidence-based trade-offs between revenue and buyer trust

• AI-native: you build with AI, not just use it for productivity. You experiment with AI tools outside of work and bring that curiosity into your product craft

• Zero-to-one: you see opportunities, not just optimisations. You spot problems, build prototypes, and ship

• Comfortable with ambiguity: you don't wait for perfect clarity — you create it

• Strong stakeholder management across commercial, engineering, and executive audiences

Preferred

• Experience with retail media, sponsored listings, native advertising, or video ad formats in a marketplace or e-commerce context

• Familiarity with AI-native product surfaces and how advertising integrates with AI experiences

• Multi-market experience across different regulatory and commercial environments

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX

OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!

OLX will process your personal data to assess your fit for the applied position. You may optionally consent to store your data for up to 12 months after the application process for consideration in future OLX roles. For more details on how your application data will be processed please check our Privacy Statement .

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Product Owner (MarTech) - Hybrid
jobs.description:
As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

J oin the world's leading travel subscription platform.

Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands – over 7.7 million Prime members since launching in 2017.

More than 100 million searches per day on our websites - more than 6 billion AI daily predictions

Good to have

• Experience with the tracking and measurement ecosystems of major media platforms, such as Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Apple Ads, Criteo, and others.

• Exceptional attention to detail with a rigorous approach to accuracy and quality. Problem-solving mindset, with strong troubleshooting and QA capabilities. Proactive, fast learner, and naturally curious about data privacy, tracking technologies, and the evolving marketing tech landscape.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.

• AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.

• Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.

What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture. Here's what we offer:

• A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.

• Grow opportunities to empower your career and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.

• Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - AI/ML

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Payments Platform
jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.

Payward's Payments & Blockchain team owns the first and last mile of every dollar that moves in or out of its products. That means dozens of banking partners, PSPs and local rails powering deposits and withdrawals for millions of users.

The team is looking for a product manager to shape the future of this platform, from the architecture underneath to the API layer internal clients build on. At the center is Payward's in-house PSP: a scalable, multi-tenant payments backend with hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs, so any Payward business can plug in and reach pay-in and payout rails worldwide.

The opportunity

• Own the product vision and roadmap for the Payward payments platform, covering both the shared backend and the integration surfaces internal clients build on (hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs)

• Map requirements across internal clients and use them to evolve the platform's vision and capabilities so it serves a growing range of use cases

• Partner with engineering to turn the target vision into a sequenced, high-impact roadmap, with milestones every client team can plan against

• Prioritize across competing client needs, make the trade-offs visible, and say no with a clear rationale

• Shape the client experience end to end, from first conversation to go-live, so teams can adopt the platform without heavy hand-holding

• Work with the banking and partnerships teams so each new PSP or bank integration is built once on the platform and reaches every Payward business

• Bring compliance, risk and legal requirements across Payward's entities and jurisdictions into the roadmap early, before they become launch blockers

• Set and track platform success metrics, such as time to launch a rail for an existing client, time for a new client to go live, share of rails available through the platform, and payment success rates

What You Bring

• 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in a platform, API or infrastructure role where your customers were other internal teams or developers

• Working knowledge of payments: pay-ins and payouts, PSPs and acquirers, bank rails (ACH, SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT and local methods), and how money flows between them

• Strong technical fluency. You can read an RFC, challenge an architecture decision, and write an API spec that engineers respect

• Experience shipping developer-facing products such as APIs, SDKs, or embeddable UI components

• Clear, structured writing. You turn complex system designs into docs that product, compliance and business stakeholders can all act on

• Skill at managing many stakeholders with different priorities, and building alignment without direct authority

• Comfort working with data to set goals and measure platform adoption and performance

Nice to haves

• Experience at a PSP, payment orchestrator or payments infrastructure company, or building one in-house

• Background with multi-tenant SaaS or B2B2C platforms

• Familiarity with crypto, stablecoins or on/off-ramps

• Experience working across multiple regulated legal entities or licensing regimes

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager

Green Eagle Solutions is a leader in automating renewable energy operations, empowering energy producers to optimize their assets and trading strategies through innovative SaaS solutions. Our flagship platform, ARSOS , combines advanced technology and intelligent automation to improve operational efficiency and trading performance.

Today, ARSOS supports the management of 90 GW of wind, solar, BESS, and hydro assets, executes over 1 million automated actions every month, and enables more than 10,000 wind turbines to operate autonomously .

Joining Green Eagle means growing alongside the company and becoming part of the transformative mindset that defines us.

Ready to make an impact? Join our team! 🤝💚

The challenge:

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to help drive the strategy and evolution of ARSOS, our B2B SaaS platform operating in real-time and mission-critical renewable energy environments.

This is an end-to-end Product role, combining Discovery and Delivery: from understanding customer problems and shaping product opportunities to prioritization, launch, and continuous improvement.

You will work autonomously and closely with Engineering and customers, using product data, business impact, and technical trade-offs to guide decisions.

AI is a key part of ARSOS' evolution. We are looking for someone with solid previous experience working with AI-powered products or capabilities, who can identify and develop AI use cases that create meaningful and measurable value for our customers.

What You'll Be Doing:

• Drive Product Strategy & Vision: Turn customer needs, business goals, market opportunities, and product data into clear priorities that drive ARSOS’ evolution.

• Own Roadmap & Planning: Manage product roadmaps, backlogs, and release cycles, balancing customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, and changing priorities.

• Lead End-to-End Product: Take product initiatives autonomously from discovery and problem validation through definition, delivery, launch, measurement, and continuous improvement.

• Ensure Effective Delivery: Partner closely with Engineering to navigate technical trade-offs and real-time operational requirements, anticipate risks, and ensure quality, reliability, and scalability.

jobs.description:
About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

About The Role

The largest nonprofits don’t just use Fundraise Up anymore. They build on it.

Enterprise customers connect us to their CRMs, data warehouses, mobile apps and in-house tools. Canvassing vendors, F2F agencies, P2P and OEM partners process donations through our API, and donation volume through it has grown roughly 5x in a year. You’ll own this surface end to end. You’ll set the API strategy, then relaunch and scale the API so every new product ships with it from day one. You’ll also expand the payment methods donors can use around the world. This is a technical role with a business goal: a strong API is a direct path to more money reaching the causes our customers serve.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the API strategy and roadmap end to end. This covers the Public API, webhooks and events, the P2P API, write and bulk operations, versioning, limits, idempotency and key security.

• Turn the integration needs of enterprise customers and key partners into platform capabilities that work for every customer, not one-off customizations.

• Build the Partner API Program from scratch, including onboarding, access, documentation and success metrics. Also own the no-code and data connectors partners rely on: Zapier, Make.com, n8n and data warehouse exports.

• Drive API parity by partnering with New Products teams, so P2P, Tap to Donate, Gift Cart and every future launch ship with API and event support at launch.

• Act as the product counterpart for enterprise customers and the go-to-market team on integrations, through discovery calls, technical requirements and Customer Advisory Board sessions.

• Own developer experience (portal, docs, SDKs, observability) and the metrics behind it: donation volume through the API, active integrations, time to first successful call and webhook delivery rate.

• Expand how and where donors can pay, as a smaller, adjacent scope. This includes local payment methods and geographic coverage, recurring payment retries, payment infrastructure, DAF giving and compliance.

• Use AI as a default tool, not an experimental one. At Fundraise Up, we expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work. That means finding where AI can change the shape of problems in API and platform product work, from research and specs to prototypes and data analysis, and growing your fluency as the tools evolve.

Skills And Qualifications

• 5+ years in Product Management in B2B SaaS, with at least 2 years owning a public API, an integrations platform or a payments product.

• Hands-on technical fluency with REST, OpenAPI, webhooks, OAuth and API keys. You read API docs and make test calls yourself.

• A track record with enterprise customers and technology partners, turning the requirements of a specific integration into platform capabilities.

• Comfort working with go-to-market teams and running customer interviews. You bring technical depth and business judgment together.

• Daily use of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor for research, specs, prototypes and data analysis.

• Languages: Fluent Russian (required, as you’ll be working in a Russian-speaking team) and English at C1 level, both written and spoken.

Nice to Have

• Payments experience, such as Stripe, local payment methods or recurring billing.

You’ll Thrive Here If You…

• Get excited by an under-built product area where the strategy is yours to write.

• Think in contracts. Hundreds of integrations depend on what you ship, so stability and predictability are features to you.

• Hear one customer’s blocker and see the capability the whole customer base needs.

• Size an opportunity in dollars before you build it, and own the result after you ship.

• Are as comfortable debating idempotency with engineers as walking an enterprise customer through a roadmap.

• Prototype and test things yourself instead of waiting for someone else to.

• Say what you think, invite pushback and change your mind when the data says so.

Please note that final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Gross Total Compensation

€5.900—€6.500 EUR

Perks & Benefits

• Sports reimbursement to help you stay active and feel your best.

• Coworking reimbursement for days when you'd rather work alongside other people.

• Annual professional development stipend to support your growth.

• English learning programs to help you communicate with confidence across our global team.

• Charitable giving program with company matching for your donations to registered non-profits.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.

About The Role

A donation made at a gala shouldn’t sit in a different system from one made online.

In-Person Giving brings Fundraise Up’s fast, connected giving experience into physical fundraising moments, starting with Tap to Donate and Giving Station. As a hands-on Product Manager reporting to the Director of New Products, you’ll decide where the product goes next. That means improving what exists today, and deciding on evidence how far to expand into ticketing, galas, and complex fundraising events. All of it builds on one connected platform rather than another isolated event tool. This is an individual contributor role. It is not a people-management, event-planning, or sales role.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the In-Person Giving product thesis and a sequenced roadmap. Turn customer research, market evidence, and commercial context into clear calls on what to build, integrate, partner on, defer, or leave out.

• Own delivery end to end with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Research, and QA. That covers requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, state transitions, and decision records, and staying close to QA and post-launch issues.

• Design for real event conditions: staff-led and self-service flows, mobile and optional hardware, unreliable connectivity, high-volume peaks, and operational recovery. Reuse existing payments, campaign, donor, reporting, CRM, and identity infrastructure wherever possible.

• Strong judgment in narrowing a large problem space to a focused release using customer evidence, product data, and commercial context, and in explaining what you chose not to build.

• Experience with transactional, multi-actor workflows involving permissions, states, money, and data relationships. You own the operational edge cases and data accuracy, not only the main user flow.

• Experience in marketplace or e-commerce environments, especially involving supply/demand dynamics.

• Technical background or a high degree of comfort collaborating closely with engineering teams on architectural trade-offs.

• Understanding of user segmentation, CRM automation, or retention marketing.

Do note that all our jobs are 📍 Barcelona based. We follow a hybrid model where flexibility rules. We commit to a minimum of 6 days per month in the office. Each team self-organizes to decide on cadence and in-person/remote rituals.
Wallapop is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees as we want Wallapop to be a place for everyone.
Additionally to the opportunity to contribute to an agile product set up and work together towards achieving our meaningful mission, we offer the following 🍭 Perks & Benefits :

• Generous individual learning budget of 2k per year

• Group and individual English, Catalan & Spanish lessons as part of our working day

• Private Health Insurance with Alan

• Flexible working hours + intensive Fridays

• Flexible remuneration to deduct from gross salary (kindergarten/food/transport check)

• Bonus for weddings & newborns

• Monthly product advantages (Wallapop Club)

• Work anniversary Gifts and Birthday Surprises

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE
At Macadam , we've built an app that rewards people for walking. With over 15 million users worldwide , we help people turn daily steps into positive habits that improve health and wellbeing.
Our product sits at the intersection of gamification, lifestyle and wellbeing , with a colourful, playful, character-driven universe rooted in mobile gaming.

THE ROLE
Users earn Macadam's coins by walking, and also by doing things our partners pay for: playing games in offerwall, taking surveys, shopping through cashback, completing brand challenges. These rewarded offers are one of our largest revenue streams, and the work is only getting bigger.
We're creating a dedicated Rewarded Offers squad and looking for its first Product Manager. You will sit in a small, autonomous team: you, a senior full-stack developer, and support from a designer and a data analyst. You report to our Head of Product, and will partner closely with the Revenue team in charge of partner negotiation. You own the problem and the outcome: more users earning through offers every day, with a healthy margin. You frame it, decide what matters, ship with the team, then read the numbers and make the call. And where the change is small, you build it yourself.
This is a role for someone with a "product builder" mindset, looking to take strong ownership and to deliver high impact.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own the squad's metrics: the share of daily users who complete an offer, revenue and margin per earning user, for offerwall, survey and affiliation.

• Own the roadmap: frame the problem, prioritise hypotheses, write product specs, run A/B tests, read results, and decide next steps.

• Integrate new providers with your developer, help rank offers by what they actually earn, and keep the rewards economy healthy.

• Work with the Revenue team and our partners (offerwall and survey providers, affiliate networks) to turn market opportunities into product changes, with care for fraud and compliance.

• Build end-to-end with AI: deliver product features, from initial design and prototyping to production, when the technical environment allows.

• Grow with the squad: the scope widens as the team does, with the option of more developers over time.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

• 2–4 years in product management (or a close role, such as growth, product analyst or product owner with features you shipped end to end), ideally on a consumer mobile app.

• Solid data and problem-solving mindset: you can pull a funnel, define a metric, run an A/B test and tell when a result doesn't hold up. SQL or a BI tool (Metabase, Mixpanel, Amplitude or similar) is a plus.

• Experience working side by side with developers on trade-offs and scope.

• Advanced AI proficiency & technical fluency: a habit of working with AI tools to conduct user research and competitive analysis, and to set up automated workflows that accelerate product discovery and execution.

• Design and user experience sensitivity.

• Autonomy and judgement: you propose the plan and don't wait for one.

• Clear written English. French or Spanish is a strong plus.

BONUS POINTS

• Experience with offerwalls, surveys, affiliate, cashback, or marketplaces.

• Background in gaming, gamified or rewards products.

• Familiarity with partner integrations (APIs, postbacks, attribution), fraud and reward integrity, and technical understanding.

• Interest in behavioural design.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

• Real ownership of a revenue-critical area, reaching 15+ million users.

• Direct work with a senior full-stack developer, and the chance to build your own squad.

• Growth, learning and exposure in an international team.

• Offices in the heart of Barcelona , hybrid working with international flexibility.

• Meal voucher, wellness allowance (Urban Sports), private healthcare (Alan), 4 Macadam holiday days.

• Friday team lunch, company events and offsites.

WHY MACADAM?
We don't just talk about change, we walk it. Our principles:

• Make it happen : take ownership, drive outcomes that matter.

• Build together, win together : support and challenge each other to go further.

• Trust the data : decide clearly, act confidently, measure what counts.

• Build for people : design with empathy, simplicity, real humans in mind.

• Think bigger : set the bar high, push boundaries, imagine better ways.

Want to see what we're about? Check out our website , Linkedin , Notion and Instagram page. Macadam is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive team.

jobs.title: Growth Product Manager | Uplift
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Growth Product Manager | Uplift based in Spain.

We are looking for an experienced Growth Product Manager to take ownership of the growth strategy for a new portfolio of digital products.

You will join a business at an early stage of development, with the opportunity to build its marketing and growth processes from the ground up.

Your primary focus will be optimizing the entire user journey, from acquisition and onboarding to subscriptions, payments, and retention.

Through data-driven experimentation, you will identify growth opportunities, validate hypotheses, and improve conversion and monetization.

You will work closely with marketing, development, and design teams to turn insights into impactful product improvements.

The role also involves exploring new markets, scaling successful acquisition strategies, and optimizing subscription-based business models.

This is an opportunity to take ownership, influence key product decisions, and directly contribute to building scalable digital businesses.

Accountabilities

• Own and optimize the complete user conversion funnel, from landing pages and onboarding to free trials, first payments, recurring subscriptions, and additional purchases.

• Analyze user behavior at every stage of the journey to identify conversion bottlenecks and opportunities for growth.

• Develop, prioritize, and validate growth hypotheses through A/B testing of paywalls, pricing strategies, trial mechanics, onboarding experiences, and upselling scenarios.

• Manage the full experimentation cycle, including hypothesis development, test design, implementation, performance analysis, and decision-making.

• Monitor and optimize key business metrics, including Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Lifetime Value (LTV), trial-to-paid conversion, recurring payments, refunds, chargebacks, and customer acquisition payback periods.

• Collaborate with user acquisition and marketing teams to identify scalable acquisition channels, analyze traffic quality, and evaluate cohort performance across different sources.

• Research new geographical markets and product niches, validate opportunities through cost-efficient experiments, and scale successful initiatives.

• Drive product features from initial concept to production by preparing clear specifications, coordinating with development and design teams, reviewing deliverables, and measuring their impact.

• Improve subscriber retention and monetization by identifying the features, experiences, and value propositions that encourage users to stay longer and make additional purchases.

• Continuously use product and marketing data to guide strategic decisions and improve overall business performance.

Requirements

• At least 3 years of professional experience in Growth or Product Management within B2C businesses.

• Mandatory experience working with subscription-based web products and a strong understanding of subscription business models.

• Proven track record of building and optimizing conversion funnels, supported by measurable results and clear before-and-after performance metrics.

• Hands-on experience managing the complete A/B testing process, with a solid understanding of statistical significance and experimentation methodology.

• Strong knowledge of unit economics and the relationships between CAC, LTV, conversion rates, recurring payments, and overall profitability.

• Good understanding of performance marketing channels, particularly Google, Meta, and Snap, with the ability to collaborate effectively with media buyers.

• Technical awareness and understanding of APIs, frontend and backend development, and common technical constraints, enabling informed product decisions and trade-offs.

• Ability to independently retrieve, analyze, and interpret data using SQL, Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4, Looker, or similar analytics tools.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a data-driven approach to decision-making.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and translate business objectives into actionable product initiatives.

• High degree of autonomy, ownership, and accountability, with the ability to drive projects from idea to execution without close supervision.

Benefits

• Product Ownership: Opportunity to build a digital product from the ground up and actively influence strategic and operational decisions.

• Autonomy and Impact: A results-oriented environment that encourages initiative, independent decision-making, and ownership of meaningful projects.

• Talented Team: Work alongside experienced professionals who share their knowledge, support one another, and contribute to continuous improvement.

• Learning and Development: Access to internal and external expert sessions, professional courses, and ongoing learning opportunities.

• Flexible Work Arrangements: Fully remote work options, with additional access to an office in Kyiv and coworking spaces in Lviv and Warsaw.

• Flexible Schedule: Freedom to organize your working hours according to your preferences and productivity.

• Work-Life Balance: 28 working days of annual vacation, up to 30 days of sick leave, and all public holidays.

• Additional Flexibility: Possibility to move working days between weekdays and weekends when needed.

• Healthcare and Well-being: Medical insurance, access to a Mental Health program, and compensation for psychological support sessions.

• Social Impact: Opportunities to participate in meaningful social initiatives, including programs supporting Ukraine.

• Personal Milestone Gifts: Gifts to celebrate important personal and professional milestones.

• Team Building: Quarterly online and offline team-building activities designed to strengthen relationships and team collaboration.

Hiring Process

The expected recruitment stages are:

• Initial pre-screening.

• Technical interview.

• Bar-raising interview (optional).

• Reference checks.

• Job offer.

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

jobs.title: Product Lead, Self-Serve Growth - Remote
jobs.description:
About Zyte

Zyte is a leader in web data extraction. Our full-stack Zyte API and world-class data services help thousands of companies, from individual developers to global enterprises, turn the web into reliable, structured data. We're a remote-first, globally distributed team that ships fast and lets results speak.

This is a transformative moment for web data, and AI is reshaping both sides of the market. The world needs web data more than ever: to train models, power agents and feed AI applications, so the audience for web data is exploding - creating new personas and new buying journeys almost overnight. At the same time AI is changing how that data is collected - from manual work by engineers to automation with AI.

Zyte is unique in solving both challenges of web data - the software needed for reliable access to websites and the AI and skills needed to turn web content into structured data. We have an important mission in the AI revolution.

The role

We're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to lead our self-serve acquisition and growth journeys across the channels used by personas hungry for web data. Our users are engineers, data teams and the builders of AI agents, and your job is to understand what they seek, what they try first and what convinces them to stay.

You'll lead conversion and growth across channels: our website, agents an the developer ecosystem. You'll be product owner for the website and application UI and will take a data driven approach to customer acquisition and growth, from traffic through trial, activation and subscription, right up to an account-managed relationship.

Our goal is to engage 500,000 developers next year who need web data and this role is central to converting them. In this role you'll shape the rhythm of funnels and experiments, ideating and iterating with a talented team on how we can improve experiences, find truths in data and build on the insight of customers to figure out the next growth step. You'll be fascinated by how engineers evaluate tools, how AI is changing the way they build and what it takes to earn their trust. You'll work to explode an audience in a market that is itself exploding, and to be able to point at the growth curve and say "I did that".

What you'll do

Manage the self-serve funnel end-to-end. Define, measure and improve every stage: signup, trial, activation, conversion to paid and expansion.

Be product owner for the website and product UI. Set the roadmap and priorities for our web presence and platform UX, working directly with the development lead, engineers and designers to ship improvements that capture demand and drive funnel activity.

Optimise the funnel as a conversion mechanism - design and run experiments, work closely with our design and product marketing teams on formats, copy and narratives for conversion.

Optimise PLG journeys that start in the developer ecosystem. Optimise the buying journeys that begin in open source and in the emerging ecosystems of agents, turning developer adoption and ecosystem presence into activation and growth. This means deeply understanding developer workflows: docs, SDKs, code examples and the first ten minutes of hands-on experience.

Build intelligent customer data and nurture growth. Build customer data based on usage and firmographics, and use this to nurture customers for growth with tailored onboarding, relevant content and (with our RevOps function) identify when our sales professionals should reach out and make contact. .

Run a rigorous experimentation practice. Develop hypotheses, ship A/B tests and funnel experiments, and report results honestly, doubling down on what works and killing what doesn't.

Requirements

• Proven results driving growth and managing funnels in a B2B SaaS or developer-focused business with a self-serve or PLG motion

• A deep curiosity about how engineers work and adopt tools. You've marketed or built for technical audiences and know that developers don't respond to marketing; they respond to products that respect their time

• Experience with developer tools, APIs, data products or technical audiences

• You prototype your own ideas: you use AI coding tools to vibe-code experiments, mockups and working demos rather than waiting for engineering capacity

• A track record of making websites effective engines for capturing demand and driving funnel activity; you've owned conversion, not just traffic

• Demonstrated success in customer growth and nurture: activation, free-to-paid conversion, expansion and churn reduction

• Intelligent, practical use of data: comfortable defining metrics, instrumenting funnels, segmenting customers and combining product signals with messaging and human outreach

• Experience working as a product owner or growth PM with engineering and design teams: writing clear requirements, prioritising ruthlessly and shipping iteratively

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; you can align marketing, product, CS, RevOps and sales around a shared funnel

• 5-8+ years in growth, growth product management or lifecycle/funnel roles

Nice to have

• You've written production code or contributed to open source

• Familiarity with experimentation platforms, product analytics (e.g. Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4), marketing automation and CRM tooling

• Experience building product-led sales (PQL) motions or platform-to-enterprise upgrade paths

How We'll Measure Sucess

Signup-to-activation rate, trial-to-paid conversion, self-serve revenue and expansion revenue, funnel velocity and the quality of PQLs handed to sales.

Benefits

By joining the Zyte team, you will:

• Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team

• Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work

• Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe

• Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools

jobs.title: Product Manager II - B2C
jobs.description:
¿Te apasionan los viajes🛫, la cultura🗽, el ocio🎡 y tienes ganas de participar en el crecimiento de la empresa Nº 1 en actividades, excursiones y tours en español por todo el mundo? Somos un equipo dinámico, multicultural e innovador, que entiende cada día como un desafío y una nueva oportunidad para crecer junto con la empresa.

Si quieres conquistar el mundo con nosotros, ¡te estamos esperando🚀!

Buscamos una persona para incorporarse a nuestro equipo de Product , dentro del departamento de Producto, como Product Manager II – B2C (CRO) , reportando directamente al Product Lead B2C. En Civitatis, nuestra misión es que millones de viajeros de todo el mundo descubran y disfruten experiencias inolvidables. Tu misión será que más viajeros encuentren lo que buscan, reserven con confianza y vuelvan a hacerlo, trabajando sobre los momentos en los que el viajero decide y compra, en web y web móvil. Combinarás criterio de producto con método (hipótesis claras, experimentos bien diseñados y decisiones apoyadas en datos), serás la referencia en optimización de la conversión y experimentación, y harás que la IA forme parte de cómo construimos y personalizamos la experiencia de compra 🤖.

¿Cómo será tu día a día?

• Liderar el ciclo completo de vida de iniciativas en tu ámbito: descubrir y definir problemas u oportunidades con datos, research y feedback de clientes, redactar iniciativas alineadas con los OKRs y los pilares estratégicos, colaborar en la priorización (modelo ICE), liderar el delivery con entregables claros y medibles y asegurar el aprendizaje tras su despliegue 📊.

• Mejorar la conversión y el valor de cada reserva en todo el recorrido de compra: ficha de actividad, disponibilidad y precio, checkout, métodos de pago, venta cruzada y experiencia posterior a la compra, en web y web móvil.

• Construir y mantener un pipeline priorizado de hipótesis a partir de evidencia cuantitativa (funnels, segmentos, analítica de comportamiento) y cualitativa (tests con usuarios, mapas de calor, grabaciones de sesión, encuestas, voz del cliente).

• Diseñar, ejecutar y analizar experimentos A/B y multivariantes con rigor (hipótesis, métricas principal y de control, tamaño de muestra, potencia y duración) y convertir los resultados en decisiones 🧪.

• Equilibrar el impacto a corto plazo (conversión, valor medio de la reserva, ingresos por visita) con el de largo plazo (confianza, cancelaciones, contactos a soporte, recurrencia).

• Definir y mantener la agenda de aprendizaje del área y compartir los aprendizajes con producto, diseño, ingeniería, marketing y negocio.

• Elevar la madurez de experimentación de la compañía: estándares, plantillas, criterios de decisión, calidad del tracking y del dato y velocidad de testeo, junto al equipo de datos.

• Aplicar IA en el producto y en la forma de trabajar: personalización, recomendaciones y venta cruzada, generación y análisis de variantes, análisis de feedback a escala y prototipado rápido, siempre con human-in-the-loop y midiendo su impacto.

• Trabajar con diseño en la experiencia y el copy, con ingeniería en la viabilidad técnica (APIs, rendimiento, pagos) y con marketing, CRM y Supply en todo lo que afecta a la decisión de compra, participando activamente en el diseño técnico-funcional de las soluciones.

• Coordinar el go-to-market, asegurando la preparación de los equipos implicados y la correcta documentación de cada lanzamiento (PR/FAQs, changelog).

• Contribuir a las buenas prácticas del equipo de producto, evangelizar la cultura de experimentación, mentorizar perfiles más junior y representar los valores y principios de Civitatis.

¿Qué buscamos?

• Más de 7 años de experiencia, de los cuales al menos 4 en producto B2C transaccional (travel tech, e-commerce o marketplace), con ownership directo de la conversión y de un programa de experimentación con volumen, e impacto demostrado en métricas de negocio.

• Titulación universitaria en áreas relevantes (Ingeniería, Estadística, Matemáticas, Economía, ADE o similares).

• Estadística aplicada a la experimentación: enfoques frecuentista y bayesiano, significancia, potencia y efecto mínimo detectable (valorable: tests secuenciales y reducción de varianza).

• Experiencia con plataformas de experimentación y feature flags (Optimizely, VWO, AB Tasty, GrowthBook o similares).

• Analítica digital y de comportamiento (GA4, Amplitude o Mixpanel, Hotjar o Contentsquare) y SQL para trabajar con tus propios datos.

• Conocimiento de plan de medición y calidad del dato: eventos, atribución, consentimiento y GDPR.

• UX y psicología del consumidor: heurísticas de conversión, persuasión responsable, copywriting, prueba social y accesibilidad.

• Conocimiento de checkout y pagos (métodos locales, wallets, pago aplazado, fraude) y de rendimiento web (Core Web Vitals) y su efecto en la conversión.

• Uso avanzado de IA: personalización, sistemas de recomendación y LLMs, prompts y agentes, prototipado y medición de ROI con human-in-the-loop.

• Español e inglés B2.

¿Por qué Civitatis?

• Formarás parte del líder mundial de reserva online de excursiones y visitas guiadas en español💃🏽.

• Espíritu joven, viajero y gran ambiente de trabajo. ¡+20 nacionalidades🌏!

• Hay vida más allá del trabajo: Flexibilidad horaria (gestionas tu horario de entrada y salida), jornada intensiva en verano, modalidad de trabajo híbrida, así como otras medidas de conciliación.

jobs.title: Growth Product Owner (ES)
jobs.description:
What does Nodes & Links do? Did you know that an ancient Roman Aqueduct initially cost 12 million sesterces but ended up costing more than 30 million? Big projects have always been problematic to humanity - we want to fix that.
We are developing an AI-first SaaS platform to help people who deal with very large projects. If someone is building a nuclear plant or a data center, they need a special kind of software to organize and prioritize their work. 👋That's us.
Recognized by TechNation, Construction Tech Review, and Amazon as industry leaders, we're part of Oxford University's Creative Destruction Lab and Entrepreneur First alumni, with awards from CIR, CogX, and the British Construction Industry. Our global clients include Intel, AECOM, and BAM, and we've raised $30M to date from top VC funds.
This is a great opportunity to join an ambitious deep-tech start-up in a dynamic and mission-driven environment, driving our growth from a start-up to a scale-up 🚀
You will also be helping to solve one of the oldest problems of mankind and potentially save the economy billions - not bad right? 🤘

📣 What will you do in the role? We are looking for a Growth Product Owner that will own a portfolio of screens that shapes how some of the largest projects in the world get delivered.
You will have end-to-end ownership, from scope creation to design prototypes that Engineers can directly pick for build. This ownership ensures you can directly express your vision on what problem to solve fast and efficiently. We embrace human direction and accountability with heavy AI tooling - you will work with new ways today, the way everyone else will be working tomorrow.

• Roadmap : Generate 6-week roadmaps based on the 3-month roadmaps given to you by the head of product.

• Own KPIs: Drive feature adoption, deepen engagement, and improve retention and expansion for your portfolio of screens, with clear targets and regular reporting on how your work moves those numbers.

• Test hypotheses and run experiments: Turn insights into clear hypotheses about activation, adoption or retention; design and run small, measurable experiments (A/B tests, copy/layout changes, onboarding tweaks), analyze the impact, and either iterate, scale, or kill ideas based on the data.

• Product Discovery : Watch sales calls, use Mixpanel, Hotjar, talk with customer success and do competitive analysis to generate new feature ideas.

• Elicit requirements : Establish communication with existing customers, build rapport with their users and elicit requirements for both new and existing features.

• Wireframe and User flows : Use Miro to generate user flows for your new features, along with capturing how users use existing tools to solve their problems.

• Suggest new features and success KPIs : Propose new features using data-driven arguments for them, and present it to the Head of Product.

👓 Who you are
• You have 3-5 years of experience in a B2B product management role with direct ownership of growth metrics such as activation, retention, feature adoption, not just delivery dates.

• Proven track record of running growth experiments (A/B tests, multivariate tests, or iterative launches), and using the results to iterate or kill ideas.

• You know when to say no. Protect the team from low-value work and scope creep

• You are able to work with senior Engineers presenting trade-offs e.g scope vs speed of delivering a feature.

• You earn the engineer’s trust in the teams you have worked with.

• You know how to communicate the same thing to different stakeholders: Engineers, Design, Sales, other Product owners.

• You know how to use data to extract conclusions and hypothesis.

• Experience with Perplexity (or similar) where output has helped shape features/capability

• Degree in Computer Science or other STEM background.

💗We would love if you have
• Previous VC-backed start-up experience

• Experience in working with Data Scientists

• You have learned a new technical domain and shipped features to prove it.

• Created wireframes and designs for your features.

• Experience with Cursor or no-code tools (like Lovable)

• Experience with Figma Make, Claude Design, Impeccable or similar

🤝 Who you will work with
• You will report to the Head of Product.

• We are a product centric company so the Product is the connection of multiple functions. Disciplines you will work and communicate with include: Engineers, QA, Design, other Product owners, Marketing, Customer Success, Sales.

• We’re remote-first, but if you miss the smell of whiteboard markers, we’ve got an office for you (Cyprus).

🏄 What if you’re a partial fit? We prioritise grit, positivity, and drive for growth, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match this job description.
Bonus : Figure out which part of this job opening was written by an AI and mention it in the interview.

🌌 Location Spain, Germany, Cyprus, Remote

👨‍👩‍👧 We are
• Hard working but not workaholic

• Explorers. Data is our compass and innovation our destination

• Independent thinkers. We are not afraid of looking where no one else is

• Team players. We believe the whole is bigger than the sum of its parts

• We have strong opinions, weakly held

• Continuously evolving the way we do things. Even our #donut dates

Nodes & Links is an equal opportunity employer: we value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.

🌴 Benefits Besides a competitive salary, we are also proud to support you with:

• A team of Noders who are second to none. Yep — the team is that good 🚀

• Equity in Nodes & Links — we are all in this together ✊

• One of the best health insurances out there (international coverage) ⚕️

• Remote work budget, to build your perfect set up (€500 year 1 + €100 year 2) 🏠

• Personal development budget, to keep growing (€1,000 pa) 📔

• Enhanced pension/providence fund (CY) (6% company contribution) 📈

• Annual #workation trip, to work and have fun with your teammates. We've been to Budapest, Crete, Aegina (x2) 💃🏻

• Wedding/Civil Partnerships additional leave of 3 days on us ❤️

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager - Virality, Referrals & KOL
jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Consumer Growth builds mobile and web experiences that help people become Kraken customers, fund their accounts, invest, earn, access new products, build wealth and stay lifelong clients. Product, engineering, design, data, and lifecycle marketing build together.

The opportunity

• Own growth in viral, KOL- and creator-referred new transacting users (NTUs). Set aggressive NTU targets backed by a credible growth model, then beat them. Build and scale sharing, referral, and creator systems that drive 10x, then 50x growth while hitting payback targets.

• Build sharing people find useful. Create natural reasons to pass on product value, and referral programs with modeled payback incentives, and without relying on aggressive incentives to hit targets. Make both work for the sender, recipient, and business.

• Own the audience-to-customer journey. Build and test paths from recommendations and creator audiences to product value and a first transaction. Partner with the teams that own onboarding and core product experiences on shared journeys.

• Own Consumer features and updates for the KOL Platform. Set the Consumer roadmap, ship features and ongoing improvements, and make measurement and commercial tools trustworthy and easy to use. Work with the teams that own KOL and affiliate relationships.

• Build creator tools across Kraken’s app and web. Help creators, key opinion leaders (KOLs), and power referrers invite their followers and turn their audiences into valuable new transacting customers. Understand their different motivations and build with core product teams.

• Make acquisition economics work. Own acquisition cost and gross-margin payback against clear targets, including fully loaded incentive, partner, operating, and fraud costs. Use downstream retention and revenue to judge what deserves more investment.

• Increase virality per new transacting user and per returning user. Test ways to improve send conversion, invites per sender, and invite-to-first-transaction conversion. Improve repeat sharing and loop speed, and prove the gains create incremental valuable new transacting customers.

• Build measurement you can trust. Validate instrumentation, define hypotheses and guardrails, and run tests that can detect meaningful effects. Separate attributed activity from incremental growth, interpret uncertainty honestly, and check that gains persist as you scale.

What You Bring

• You’ve personally built a product, tool, feature, or experience that spread beyond its initial audience. You can explain why it spread, your contribution, and how it acquired valuable customers.

• Repeated success beating acquisition targets through referrals, product virality, or creator-led growth. Show the baseline, target, result, timeframe, component rates you improved, and your personal contribution. Bring evidence the gains lasted.

• Strong growth product sense. You understand sharing psychology and the different motivations of customers, creators, KOLs, and power referrers. You combine customer research, creative product instincts, and strong UX and copy to give people a reason to participate.

• Analytical independence. You independently investigate behavior with SQL and product analytics, validate instrumentation, and build funnel, cohort, and growth models.

• Experimentation and commercial judgment. You design reliable tests, interpret uncertainty honestly, and distinguish attribution from incremental growth. You understand acquisition cost and payback, including downstream retention, revenue, and fully loaded incentive and fraud costs.

• Senior ownership and hands-on execution. You set strategy, make hard priority calls, align teams without relying on reporting lines, and deliver autonomously. You use AI and working prototypes to turn original ideas into experiences people can try.

Nice to haves

• Experience building self-service creator or affiliate tools, revenue-share systems, or reliable partner payouts.

• Consumer fintech, crypto, payments, or experience designing financial promotions and fraud controls.

• Experience adapting growth journeys across markets, cultures, and regulatory environments.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Codeway

Codeway builds category-leading consumer AI apps on mobile and web, at global scale.

600M+ downloads. 60+ apps. 400+ builders across Barcelona and İstanbul. Completely bootstrapped. No board. Profitable since year two.

Small teams move faster than big ones. But they need big resources to win at scale. Nobody starts from zero. The problem decides the solution, not us.

We turn category wins into six focused vertical companies: Wishlabs (AI Creativity), Wellture (Wellness), Learna (Language Learning), Sparked (Education), Cosmic Jam (Physical Products) and Catalyst Apps (Utilities & Productivity). Each has full ownership and the depth to go further than anyone else in its space.

Codeway HQ powers them all. One platform. One team that finds and grows builders. One set of guardrails. Every idea born here starts with an unfair advantage: the platform, the people, and the profits of every product before it. That's the system.

Turns out you can do both.

Move like an indie. Hit like a giant.

About The Role

Most AI assistants live in an app. This one you wear. The Cosmic Jam team is building an AI assistant around a connected device people wear every day: one button, your voice, and an assistant that turns a passing thought into a finished task. You’ll own the product end to end. What the assistant does with a spoken sentence. How it organizes someone’s day. What it connects to. And how we know it’s genuinely helping. You’ll work closely with engineering, design and Codeway’s infrastructure teams. This role is for builders who obsess over the first minute. People who know what makes someone talk to a device every day. Who read model outputs as closely as dashboards. Who ship, measure and improve, fast. The best assistants feel invisible. You’ll build one.

What You'll Do

• Own the app end to end, from the first minute of use to a daily habit.

• Define what the assistant does with what people say, and how its quality is measured and improved.

• Shape the space where captures become to-dos, reminders, notes and plans.

• Connect the assistant to the tools people already use, from their calendar to their own AI.

• Build the membership and the premium features that make it worth paying for.

• Track the numbers that prove it works, from daily captures and completed actions to retention and conversion.

• Work closely with engineering, design and AI teams to ship continuously.

• Own recording consent and privacy, together with legal.

What You'll Bring

• You’ve shipped an assistant or agent product built on language models to consumers, and improved it from real usage.

• You’re hands-on with the model layer: you write prompts and evals, read logs and prototype with AI tools.

• You have a feel for voice and capture, and you know what brings people back every day.

• You’ve shipped and grown a consumer subscription app.

• You write clearly in English and thrive in a small team with little process.

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with voice notes, meeting notes or dictation products.

• Experience with task, reminder or calendar products.

• Experience with wearables or other devices paired with an app.

• Experience building integrations or connectors for AI assistants.

What We Offer

• Competitive Compensation. Because great work deserves great pay.

• Full Private Health Insurance. Unlimited coverage.

• Free Breakfast & Lunch. Every day at Codebrew, our in-office coffee shop, with barista coffee and healthy snacks all day long.

• Meal & Transport Support. Monthly compensation that actually covers a proper lunch and your daily commute.

• A Top-Notch Office. In the iconic Edifici Estel, right in the heart of Barcelona.

• Flexible Schedule. We care about your impact, not about tracking your minutes.

• Top Tech Setup. From a high-end laptop to the software and gadgets that help you thrive.

• Wellbeing & Growth. Gym membership, English & Spanish course support, and a game corner for well-earned breaks.

• Pet Adoption Support. We cover your new pet’s essential vet costs in the first year.

• No Dress Code, Great People. A dynamic, talented, passionate team. Come as you are.

THE RECRUITING PROCESS

We are committed to keeping our recruitment process short and transparent. Here’s how it looks like:

• Application: Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile. You can also just write a few words about yourself.

• Talent & Culture Interview: Let’s talk about your experience & expectations and see what we can achieve together.

• Technical Interview: You will meet with your future team lead to go over the case and your technical capabilities in detail.

• Case Study: We might send you a task to solve.

• Final Interview: A final interview with one of our senior leaders.

• Welcome Aboard! You are now a part of the team.

Your personal data that will be collected through your applications made due to this advertisement will be processed automatically by the data controller Codeway in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK") and relevant legislation for the purpose of conducting job application processes. You can access detailed information on this matter from the "Candidate Information Notice" page at https://www.codeway.co . Codeway processes the personal data of job applicants in accordance with relevant legislation. " Privacy Notice for Employee Candidate " summarizes the data processing procedures during the application process.

jobs.description:
ACERCA DE NOSOTROS

Encuentro, fundada en 1986 en las Islas Canarias, es una marca de moda femenina que celebra la diversidad, la inclusión y el respeto. Nuestra inspiración es la mujer que disfruta de la vida y nuestro compromiso está en crear moda promoviendo la igualdad y la integridad.

¿QUÉ ESTAMOS BUSCANDO?

Como Product Manager Ecommerce, formarás parte del equipo de Marketing& Ecommerce y te encargarás de maximizar la venta y el rendimiento de nuestras colecciones en el canal online. Combinarás el merchandising digital con el análisis de ventas y stock.

¿CÓMO SERÁ TU DÍA A DÍA EN ENCUENTRO?

• Gestionarás el merchandising de la web y la app: selección, priorización y orden del producto en novedades, destacados y colecciones.

• Analizarás ventas, sell-through, conversión y margen, y compararás el canal online con las tiendas para detectar oportunidades.

• Harás seguimiento del stock online (coberturas, rotación y roturas) y coordinarás reposiciones y redistribuciones con Aprovisionamiento y Logística.

• Propondrás acciones de visibilidad, precio o promoción para los productos con bajo rendimiento o exceso de stock.

• Planificarás con los distintos equipos las acciones comerciales, los lanzamientos y las rebajas, y seleccionarás el producto para las campañas digitales.

• Impulsarás la mejora de la experiencia de compra mediante tests A/B y benchmark de competidores y tendencias.

• Reportarás los KPIs del canal online.

¿QUÉ ESPERAMOS DE TI?

• Formación universitaria en ADE, Marketing, Gestión de Moda o similar.

• Al menos 3 años de experiencia en merchandising online, gestión de producto o análisis comercial en moda o retail.

• Dominio de las métricas de moda (sell-through, cobertura, rotación y margen), Excel avanzado y Google Analytics.

• Nivel de inglés alto (B2-C1).

• Pasión por la moda y las tendencias, con habilidades analíticas y visión comercial.

• Buena comunicación y capacidad para trabajar con distintos equipos.

• Se valorará experiencia con plataformas eCommerce y herramientas de BI como Power BI.

¿POR QUÉ ENCUENTRO?

• Posibilidad de unirte a una empresa en pleno crecimiento.

• Oportunidades de desarrollo y formación continua.

• 30% de descuento en todos nuestros productos.

¡ÚNETE A LA FAMILIA ENCUENTRO!

Creemos en la diversidad, la igualdad y el talento. ¡Te esperamos!

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
⛵ About our Crew

Click&Boat is a rental platform product of Boats Group, the fastest-growing digital business in the recreational boating space. We are a talented team of techies, creatives, marketers, closers and customer advocates who spend each day pushing the boundaries of technology to make buying, selling & renting boats easy. We spend each day surrounded by 500,000 boats from across the globe!

Click&Boat is the European leader in boat rentals. Our marketplace makes boating accessible around the world, from a day trip to a week-long adventure, while enabling private and professional boat owners to generate additional income through rentals.

To support this growth, we're hiring a Product Manager, Monetization & Compliance to join our Product team in Barcelona.

🚤 The role

We're looking for a Product Manager with a strong business mindset to own our monetization and compliance roadmap . You will identify and ship the right opportunities to grow our revenue and contribution margin , while keeping the product compliant on tax and invoicing .

You'll own the strategy and the priorities, while delivery is run by your squad and its Engineering Manager. You'll work closely with finance, data, legal and operations , with regular exposure to our leadership team, and play a central role in meeting our revenue and margin targets.

The Product team at Click&Boat: 4 Product Managers , 1 Head of Product, 1 VP product organized into squads, each dedicated to a specific functional scope. Together, they deliver a first-class experience to our users: boat owners, renters, and Click&Boat's internal teams.

🛟 What floats your boat

• Build a point of view: you develop strong convictions on where we can grow revenue, and where Click&Boat should place its bets (pricing, fees, payments, upsells, checkout).

• Vision & Roadmap: you align the leadership team around a clear product vision, then turn it into a 3 to 6 month roadmap and concrete priorities that help your squad deliver maximum value against our OKRs.

• Compliance by design: you make sure tax, invoicing and regulatory requirements are built into the product, partnering with finance and legal to turn constraints into clean, scalable solutions.

• Data-driven decisions: you analyze quantitative and qualitative data to size opportunities, measure revenue impact and learn from every release.

• Decision making: you're comfortable deciding with 40 to 70% of the information, using data to guide you without waiting for perfect certainty.

• Fail fast, learn fast: you promote rapid iterations, A/B tests and continuous improvement, always with a "user first" approach.

🧭 What you bring aboard

• Significant experience as a Product Manager, regardless of the scope.

• You are both strategic and hands-on: able to define a monetization strategy and a long-term roadmap, while still going deep into a checkout experiment or a revenue metric when needed.

• A strong business and data mindset, with decisions grounded in solid analysis.

• Structure and excellent prioritization: you manage your time and stakeholders effectively.

• Excellent written and verbal communication: you justify your decisions with clarity and confidence, from squads to top management.

• You embrace feedback and see it as an opportunity to grow.

• Fluent or bilingual in English.

🌊 Bonus points (great to have, never a dealbreaker)

• Experience in a marketplace, tech or B2C company.

• Experience in pricing, payments, or regulated features (tax, invoicing), with a measurable revenue impact.

• Fluency in French and/or Spanish.

🗺 The hiring journey

• HR call with Talent Acquisition,

• Interview with the Product team,

• Management interview with a case study to assess your skills and alignment with our values: leadership, strategic thinking, learn & grow.

• Final Interview with Nicolas, our CTPO

We aim to keep things smooth, transparent, and respectful of your time throughout the process.

⚓️ What awaits you on board

• 🎯 A high-impact scope, directly tied to Click&Boat's revenue and margin, with direct exposure to top management;

• 🌱 Personal and professional development in a fast-growing, multicultural team;

• 🏖 8 additional days off;

• 🍽 Lunch vouchers (Cobee);

• 💪 Gym partnerships (Wellhub);

• ⛵ PNB Boat licence offered and exclusive discounts on your next boat trips;

• 🥐 Breakfast every Tuesday morning;

• 🏢 A welcoming office in Barcelona, next to the centrally located Cathedral and just a 20-minute walk from the sea;

• 🎉 Team-building activities;

• 💻 Hybrid role based in Barcelona (3 days per week at the office), with 3 days per month spent in Paris, around 6 to 9 trips per year.

Contract: Permanent position

Start date: ASAP

🪝 Ready to join?

If this opportunity sounds like your next adventure, hit the "apply to this job" button.

Remember, even if you don't meet every requirement, you might still be a great match for us! And yes, we're especially talking to women here: science says that you are less likely to apply if you don't meet them all. So go for it, we'd love to hear from you.

At Click&Boat, every application is reviewed with equal care and attention, regardless of age, gender, origin, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic. We hire for talent, drive, and mindset. The sea is open to all. 🌊

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Behavioral Data Solutions
jobs.description:
At Netquest (part of the Bilendi Group), we are looking for a Senior Product Manager – Behavioral Data Solutions to join our team in Barcelona, Spain (hybrid model).

Netquest is part of the Bilendi Group, a European leader in research technology and data collection. With over 4 million panelists across 44 countries and more than 600 employees, we support market research firms, agencies, and major corporations in obtaining key data for their studies. Within the group, Netquest leads the market research industry with a strong presence and renowned reputation in Spain and LATAM, while we continue expanding across Europe with a strategy focused on innovation and specialized services.

Sitting at the intersection of product management, market intelligence, and business strategy, your mission will be to drive the development and evolution of Bilendi’s Behavioral Data solutions—ensuring our offerings remain competitive, differentiated, and aligned with customer needs. You will define the product vision, roadmap, positioning, and requirements for our Behavioral Data activities, leveraging proprietary technologies including Wakoopa, consent-based panels, and advanced data science capabilities. In this role, you will work closely with technology, data science, operations, and commercial teams, without carrying direct sales or P&L responsibility.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Product Strategy & Roadmap

• Define and maintain the vision and roadmap for Bilendi's Behavioral Data products and solutions.

• Identify market opportunities, customer needs, and emerging industry trends.

• Prioritize product developments and investments based on strategic objectives and market potential.

• Ensure alignment between product initiatives and Bilendi's broader business strategy.

Product Definition & Development

• Translate business and customer requirements into clear functional specifications.

• Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders and development teams.

• Manage and prioritize the product backlog.

• Support technology and data science teams throughout the product development lifecycle.

• Drive the development of new data products and enhancements to existing solutions.

Market Intelligence & Positioning

• Maintain a deep understanding of the behavioral data, audience measurement, digital analytics, and consumer intelligence markets.

• Monitor competitors, technologies, regulations, and industry developments.

• Define product positioning, value propositions, and differentiation strategies.

• Contribute to pricing recommendations and packaging strategies.

Commercial Enablement

• Support sales and account management teams with product expertise.

• Develop product documentation, sales materials, and product presentations.

• Participate in strategic client discussions when product expertise is required.

• Act as an internal ambassador for Behavioral Data products and capabilities.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Experience: 5+ years of experience in product management, product ownership, or solution management roles.

• Industry Knowledge: Strong understanding of behavioral data, audience measurement, digital analytics, ad-tech, mar-tech, consumer intelligence, or market research.

• Product Execution: Proven experience defining product roadmaps and translating market needs into clear functional and product requirements.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to engage effectively with technical, data science, operational, and commercial teams.

• Analytical & Strategic Mindset: Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities, with a focus on driving product competitiveness and market differentiation.

• Communication & Influence: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to support commercial teams and participate in strategic client discussions.

• Languages: Fluency in English (working language across the group); Spanish is a strong plus.

• Preferred Experience (nice to have): Hands-on background in behavioral or passive data collection (metering), audience measurement, digital analytics, ad-tech/mar-tech, data products/SaaS solutions, or online panel management.

WHAT WE OFFER

• Permanent contract ( contrato indefinido ).

• Private health insurance with medical network or reimbursement (50% covered for the employee).

• Flexible compensation plan: meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport, and childcare.

• Flexible working hours: start between 8:00 and 10:00 AM, finish between 5:00 and 7:00 PM, with intensive hours on Fridays.

• Hybrid working model: 2 days at our Barcelona office and 3 days remote.

A Diverse Team for a Global World: At Netquest and Bilendi, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of gender, age, origin, or nationality.
