jobs.title: Sr Product Manager - Retention
jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Consumer Growth builds mobile and web experiences that help people become Kraken customers, fund their accounts, invest, earn, access new products, build wealth and stay lifelong clients. Product, engineering, design, data, and lifecycle marketing build together.

The opportunity

• Choose the right bets. Identify the client segments and problems worth solving. Own the roadmap and allocate effort against expected client value, commercial impact, and engineering cost. Set the baseline, target, and threshold for scaling; stop weak bets.

• Build NTU retention. Help newly transacting users build on their first transaction, discover further value, and form repeat investing and financial habits through their first weeks and months. Find where they stall and improve the steps that lead to lasting use.

• Retain and bring back established clients. Keep active clients engaged, address signs of lapsing, and reactivate clients who have stopped. Understand how needs change with tenure, holdings, and financial goals, then deepen the client’s relationship with Kraken.

• Make the next financial move useful. Test ways to support client intent: recurring deposits and buys, useful portfolio context, timely opportunities, or relevant Earn products. Choose from the evidence. Successful automated investing and Earn can create lasting value without frequent manual activity. Make rewards, access, and risks clear.

• Prove the commercial impact. Track retention by cohort and segment, linking behavior to retained balances, net inflows, product adoption, and revenue. Measure active engagement through useful actions, such as reviewing a portfolio or investing, and track successful automated habits separately. Distinguish inflows from asset-price gains, establish incremental impact, account for incentives and costs, and check that gains last after promotions end.

• Connect product and lifecycle. Partner with lifecycle marketing on push, email, web, and app journeys, from a relevant message to a useful financial action. Adapt to local payment habits and market requirements.

• Build and ship with the team. Turn the chosen problem into prototypes, requirements, and experiments with engineering, design, and data. Bring risk, compliance, and legal partners into design decisions. Balance client impact, reliability, maintainability, and delivery speed; scale what works.

What You Bring

• Evidence that you’ve personally led consumer product changes that beat retention or expansion targets. Be ready to explain the baseline, target, result, timeframe, and your contribution, including the impact on revenue, assets, or retained balances.

• A clear account of what changed underneath the result: component behaviors or funnel rates such as repeat deposits, return-to-transaction conversion, successful recurring investments, or reactivation. Show how you established incremental impact and whether it lasted.

• Strong client and product judgment. You can choose a segment and problem worth pursuing, understand why clients return, hold, withdraw, or disengage, and turn that insight into a useful experience.

• Hands-on analytical depth. You query and validate your own data, diagnose cohorts and funnels, size opportunities, and design experiments that can detect a commercially meaningful effect.

• Commercial discipline. You can explain how market conditions, incentives, costs, and client trust affected your results, and use that evidence to decide whether an improvement is worth scaling.

• Senior ownership from decision through delivery. You’ve owned a roadmap, made product and technical trade-offs, allocated effort, stopped weak bets, and worked effectively with engineering, design, data, lifecycle marketing, and risk/compliance partners.

Nice to haves

• Experience with consumer investing, wealth, savings, fintech, or crypto products. Freemium gaming is nice-to-have as well.

• Experience building recurring investment, deposit, Earn, portfolio, or goal-based experiences.

• Experience adapting client journeys across markets and local financial behaviors.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Campaign Pages
jobs.description:
About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

About The Role

A great campaign page doesn’t just tell a story. It turns a visitor into a donor.

Campaign Pages are where nonprofits launch campaigns, tell their stories and convert donors before checkout. They sit close to revenue, next to Checkout Modal and Elements in our Pre-Donation Experience. You will be the one person accountable for the Campaign Pages roadmap, quality and delivery. Your job is to make the product scalable, ready for enterprise customers and a clear driver of revenue, while traffic keeps growing and the product stays stable.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the Campaign Pages strategy and a 6–12 month roadmap aligned with Product and Pre-Donation Experience priorities, and explain the reasoning behind decisions to leadership and stakeholders.

• Run continuous discovery using customer, GTM, Support, funnel and competitive signals. Separate one-off requests from systemic opportunities and validate problems before anything gets built.

• Drive delivery end to end with a dedicated Engineering Team Lead, Product Designer and Product Analyst: clear PRDs and edge cases, a backlog that is ready 2–3 sprints ahead, and launches with proper instrumentation.

• Own product health and enterprise readiness, covering conversion, page performance, reliability, publishing issues and support volume. Resolve deal-breakers and churn-risk requests within agreed SLAs.

• Partner with PM Growth on experiments, personalisation and ARPV initiatives. Prioritise incoming hypotheses against your own product data, and carry winning learnings across Checkout, Elements and Campaign Pages.

• Keep Engineering, Design, Analytics, GTM, Support and adjacent PMs aligned. Coordinate dependencies with Platform, Checkout, Gift Cart, Billing and Integrations when work touches shared systems.

• Make sure GTM, Support and CSMs know what is shipping, why it matters and how to explain it to customers.

• At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve. In this role, that means using AI for research synthesis, spec drafting, analysis and communication, with your assumptions and sources made explicit.

Skills And Qualifications

• 5+ years in Product Management or Product Ownership, ideally in B2B or enterprise SaaS, fundraising, marketing technology, e-commerce or conversion-focused products.

• Proven end-to-end ownership of a product area: roadmap, discovery, execution, launch and measurement.

• Strong delivery discipline: you write clear specs, cover edge cases and keep Engineering unblocked.

• Analytical rigour: you use funnels, metrics, support signals and qualitative feedback to prioritise.

• Systems thinking: you can see how a surface connects to checkout, payments, analytics, integrations and GTM workflows.

• A working understanding of growth and experimentation: how hypotheses are generated, prioritised and measured.

• Strong UX sensibility and a good working partnership with Design.

• Hands-on, everyday AI use in product work.

• Languages: Fluent Russian (required, as you’ll be working in a Russian-speaking team) and English at C1 level, both written and spoken.

Nice to Have

• Experience with landing pages, campaign or website builders, CMS, donation or checkout flows.

• Hands-on experimentation, personalisation or conversion-optimisation work, including converting paid traffic after it reaches the landing page.

• Experience in nonprofit tech, fundraising, payments or marketing operations.

• Experience handling enterprise customer requests and GTM escalations.

You’ll Thrive Here If You…

• Own outcomes, not tasks, and don’t wait for permission to fix what’s broken.

• Can hold a wide context and still move quickly.

• Say no to a loud request when the data says something else matters more, and can explain why.

• Care as much about stability as about the next shiny experiment.

• Give and ask for candid feedback without ego.

• Get energy from aligning several teams around one shared goal.

• Keep sharpening your AI workflow because you want to, not because you were told to.

• Want your work to translate directly into more money reaching nonprofits.

Please note that final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Gross Total Compensation

€5.600—€6.100 EUR

Perks & Benefits

• 23 days of vacation, 14 public holidays, and 5 fully paid sick days.

• Private health insurance for you and your family.

• Mental health support with therapy sessions for you and your partner.

• Sports reimbursement to help you stay active and feel your best.

• Fully remote work.

• Generous home office stipend to set up a comfortable, productive workspace.

• Coworking reimbursement for days when you'd rather work alongside other people.

• Annual professional development stipend to support your growth.

• English learning programs to help you communicate with confidence across our global team.

• Charitable giving program with company matching for your donations to registered non-profits.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.

• Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. Exercise caution and ensure the authenticity of emails claiming to be from our company.***

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
DayClass by Simple is a fitness app for anyone who wants to feel strong, steady and energetic, whatever their age or starting level: tai chi, walking, chair workouts, calisthenics, with a coach in their pocket.

It is the fastest growing product at Simple. Thousands of people subscribe every day and the app holds a 4.9 rating in the App Store. Getting people in is no longer the hard part. The hard part is the first weeks: turning one class into a habit of training several times a week.
We're looking for a proactive Product Manager. Someone who comes with hypotheses, launches experiments every week and raises the quality bar together with designers, not someone who waits for a backlog.

You will own DayClass features and initiatives end to end: product quality, early and long-term metrics, research and validation, and the business results the product drives, from the first open after purchase to renewals a year later. Your first focus is activation and early retention, turning one class into a habit of training several times a week. As DayClass continues to grow, you'll also have the opportunity to shape its next chapter as we expand beyond fitness into medical and health services.

You will report to the Product Lead of DayClass and work every day with the design team, engineering, analytics, the content production team, the growth and marketing teams who bring users to DayClass, and the legal team.

You'll join a team that values autonomy, rapid experimentation and product quality. We work with short feedback loops, prototype ideas quickly and keep processes light.

What You Will Do:

• Own the metrics of your features end to end: first workout completion and 3 workout days in the first 7, D7, D30 and long-term retention, workout rating, renewals and LTV

• Run a steady experiment pipeline: hypotheses, prioritization, A/B design with analytics, decision, rollout. Several experiments in flight at any time

• Work hand in hand with designers on product quality: home screen, workout player, post-purchase onboarding, challenges, progress and streaks. Ship polish, not only features

• Build and drive the product roadmap: personalization and adaptive workouts, progress and challenges, re-engagement through push and Live Activities

• Run research and validation: interviews, UX research, session recordings, store reviews and support tickets. Validate ideas before the team builds them, turn what you find into fixes

• Work closely with growth and marketing, the teams that bring users in: know which ads, funnels and promises each user came through, make the first minutes in the app deliver on that promise, and feed product insights back into creatives and funnels

• Bring requests for new classes and materials to the content production team, and work with analytics so product changes move business metrics, not only product ones

• Help build the medical part of the product: new health services inside DayClass, designed with medical, legal and compliance teams from day one

• Work with the legal team on everything users see and agree to: claims, pricing and subscription terms, consent, privacy and health data

• Write clear requirements for engineering and analytics events, keep the QA bar high

• Keep the team fast: ship small things the same day, prototype and vibe-code experiments yourself, cut process that slows the team down

• Use AI tools daily for prototyping, analysis and research

What We’re Looking For:

• 4+ years as a PM in B2C mobile subscription apps, health and fitness is a plus

• A track record of moving product and business metrics (activation, retention, renewal) through experiments, with numbers you can show

• Strong product taste and a habit of working closely with designers. You notice small things that make an app hard for a beginner

• Analytical independence: cohorts, funnels, A/B statistics, comfortable with SQL or BI tools

• Bias to action: ship small, measure, iterate, own the result

• Hands-on with AI coding and prototyping tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar). You can build and launch a simple experiment without waiting for engineering

• Comfortable working in regulated areas with legal and compliance; health, medical or telehealth experience is a plus

• Technical fluency with iOS and Android teams; push, Live Activities and CRM tools (Braze) are a plus

• Fluent English

Perks And Benefits:

• Competitive salary package commensurate with experience, plus stock options

• The equipment you need to do your job

• 21 days annual leave, plus bank holidays

• Office in Limassol (hybrid) or a remote option for candidates residing outside of Cyprus

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

Digital Lead - Global

Help shape how the next generation of industrial robots is engineered, trained and brought to life. In this role, you will drive the evolution of ABB Robotics’ integrated toolchain for industrial Physical AI. You will lead a portfolio spanning engineering tools, simulation and AI-enabled workflows, enabling customers to design, program, simulate, validate and continuously improve robotic applications – from virtual concept through real-world production. You will define the product strategy and drive the development of a scalable, commercially sustainable software portfolio that makes industrial automation faster to engineer, safer to validate and easier to evolve.

This is a global role; the preferred location is within Europe.

Working model is hybrid

30% or more of travelling might be required for this position.

Your responsibilities:

• Define portfolio strategy and drive growth: Set the portfolio vision, strategy and roadmap, including customer value propositions, market positioning, business models and investment priorities to drive profitable growth.

• Drive RobotStudio’s journey towards autonomous engineering for Physical AI: Build on its leading position in robotics engineering and simulation, evolving it into an agentic engineering platform spanning synthetic data, AI training and validation as part of ABB Robotics’ broader Physical AI platform.

• Turn technology into adopted products: Translate customer needs and technology developments into products and capabilities, and drive their adoption across the installed user base by systematically identifying and removing technical, workflow and usability barriers.

• Advance agent-assisted engineering: Evolve engineering workflows towards autonomous and AI-assisted approaches, enabling seamless integration across engineers, automation pipelines and AI agents through modular products, stable APIs and SDKs.

• Drive product execution: Own product requirements, priorities, metrics, pricing, launches and lifecycle decisions, working closely with R&D and cross-functional teams from early technical exploration through scalable product delivery.

• Develop the ecosystem and market presence: Build strategic partnerships with customers, system integrators and technology providers. Lead build, buy and partner decisions and drive go-to-market activities.

• Deliver measurable customer outcomes: Enable a seamless journey from virtual engineering and experimentation through commissioning, deployment and lifecycle improvement, driving greater engineering productivity, faster deployment and improved validation quality.

Your background:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering, computer science, robotics, automation, or a related technical discipline.

• 10+ years of experience in robotics, automation, industrial software, simulation or related engineering technologies, with experience shaping product or technology strategy.

• Proven ability to turn technology innovation into products, drive adoption of new technologies and ways of working across large user bases, and systematically remove barriers to adoption.

• Ability to operate across levels, from strategy and investment discussions with senior management and customers to detailed technical discussions with engineering teams.

• Hands-on technical mindset, using prototypes and modern AI-assisted development tools to explore and validate ideas together with engineering teams.

• Working knowledge of modern simulation and emerging Physical AI technologies, including areas such as agentic engineering, reinforcement learning, computer vision, VLA models and simulation-based training a plus.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - AI Platform
jobs.description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

Preply is an AI-native company, and the AI Platform is the foundation that underpins all of our AI initiatives. We’re building it to power AI product features for learning and the marketplace, personalising the experience for our tutors and learners, and to be the single place for teams at Preply to build agentic systems and workflows. It will be pivotal in helping Preply move fast, automate and scale.

As the first product manager on the AI Platform, you’ll define the mission, vision and strategy across traditional ML, LLM and agentic systems. This is a new, greenfield role: a great opportunity to make a product impact on a foundational platform. You’ll make sure we build safely and responsibly, with the platform setting the standards, governance and guardrails for how Preply builds with AI.

The role focuses on building the product roadmap with multiple engineering teams, helping other product teams build faster, and measuring the platform’s impact on how fast Preply builds, automates and scales with AI.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Define the mission, vision, strategy, and product roadmap for the AI platform across traditional ML, LLM, and agentic systems, working with multiple engineering teams

• Increase the return on investment in ML and LLMs, and set the direction for building and scaling agents across internal and external workflows

• Provide product teams with a trusted foundation to build, learn, and ship AI safely at scale

• Implement safeguards and controls, including standards, governance, and guardrails for building, to ensure safe shipping

• Reduce the cost of building and running AI across the company

• Demonstrate and increase the ROI of AI investments, showing impact on business metrics and delivering platform metrics around speed, safety, activity, and cost

• Collaborate with engineering managers and the engineering, data, and product chapters to identify opportunities and pain points, and understand the experience of teams building on the platform

What You Need To Succeed

• Technical platform experience across ML, GenAI, and agentic platforms, including gateways, models, tools, memory, governance, and security

• Ability to set the direction for how agents are built and scaled across internal and external workflows

• Experience shipping AI and ML systems from a product, technical, or engineering background

• Excellent product sense in the fast-changing AI domain, with a drive to do product work, not just building

• Leading AI fluency, using AI to transform personal work and helping others do the same

• Proven ability to influence and align senior engineering, data, and business stakeholders, with credibility among data and engineering teams

Nice to have

• Hands-on experience in platform, AI, or ML engineering before moving into product

• Experience in tech or AI-native businesses, such as e-commerce, fintech, or B2B SaaS with critical AI features

Why you will love it at Preply

• An open, collaborative, dynamic, and diverse culture

• A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com

• Learning & Development budget and time off for self-development

• A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance, and health insurance

• Attractive relocation package to join the Preply Barcelona Hub if not already in Barcelona

• Access to free mental health support platforms

• Access to Gym-pass -partnered wellness and gym centres throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health

• Opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in

Our Principles

• Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.

• We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.

• Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.

• Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.

• Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.

• Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.

• Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.

• Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.

• Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.

• One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description
The Senior Technical Product Manager is someone who is structured, analytical, and tech native, and can act as a bridge between our products and our tech teams. We are looking for someone who can be trusted to take the idea for a complex technical solution and diligently yet pragmatically do everything that is needed to develop it and get it across the line, analysing, escalating, designing, proposing, and coordinating a range of client and internal stakeholders.
You will report to our VP of Product, sit in our Product team and be the main product counterpart for our infrastructure tech team, owning the new and existing features and solutions they build. You will also work closely with the rest of the Product team, Customer Success and colleagues across the company. Around 90% of your time will be internal, with the remaining 10% client-facing: capturing requirements, onboarding clients and troubleshooting technical issues.
There is a lot to learn about the real estate industry, our clients and our products, so you will start with smaller, well-defined pieces of work and take on more as you ramp up. Within a year, we expect you to own a portfolio of technical features and solutions end to end, run client calls and POCs, and be a trusted right hand in delivering our technical roadmap.

About Restb.ai
We are a Barcelona-based scale-up, and world leader in generating AI insights for the real estate sector. We use computer vision, machine learning and large language models to examine real estate photos and listing data and turn them into insights that support property valuations across many subsegments and in 35 countries.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Own a portfolio of features and solutions built by our infrastructure tech team, both new and existing, from initial idea through release and ongoing improvement.

• Capture and clarify requirements from clients and internal stakeholders, and turn them into clear, well-structured specs.

• Act as the primary interface between Product and the infrastructure team for your features, coordinating delivery and keeping everyone aligned.

• Analyse data and test outputs (including LLM and computer vision results) to validate that solutions work as expected and deliver real value.

• Design pragmatic solutions and propose trade-offs between scope, quality and time.

• Spot risks and blockers early, and escalate them with a clear view of the options.

• Support clients with technical onboarding, integration and troubleshooting.

• Get hands-on with LLMs and other tools to prototype ideas, automate tasks and test hypotheses.

• Write clear documentation, such as specs, release notes and client-facing guides.

• Over time, lead client calls, requirements workshops and POCs.

• Continually improve the way things are done around you.

﻿
Desired skills and experience

• Bachelor’s degree with a quantitative focus (Engineering, Statistics, Business Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Maths, Economics, etc.), or equivalent experience.

• 4+ years in technical product management, engineering, solutions or technical consulting roles, including leading delivery of complex technical projects. Experience in real estate is a plus, but not required.

• Ability to truly understand and manipulate data. Someone who looks at data and sees a story and actionable insights.

• A pragmatic, structured problem solver who uses a hypothesis-driven approach to get quickly to the best answer, backs up recommendations with data, and can clearly articulate the risks of each decision.

• A track record of shipping solutions that delivered measurable impact, and of influencing stakeholders and leadership without direct authority.

• Technically curious and comfortable around code: you don’t need to be a developer, but you understand how software gets built and can hold your own in technical discussions with engineers. Everything else can be learned on the job.

• A strong and proactive communicator, with an active awareness of accountability and risk and how to escalate accordingly.

• A fast learner with a high bar and a strong growth mindset: you take ownership, seek out candid feedback, and get things done.

• C1-level English, with strong written and oral communication. This role is in English, resumes in other languages won’t be considered.

• This is a hybrid role based in Barcelona, with at least 3 days a week in our office (many of the team come in more). Visa support is available for the right candidate.

What makes working at Restb.ai great
Join a Barcelona scale-up with an international team of 19 nationalities, working with companies around the world, where your work is actively shaping the cutting edge of the real estate industry.

• Free snacks, drinks, hot drinks and salads in the office.

• Monthly lunch allowance.

• Monthly in-office massage.

• Quarterly offsite team-building events.

Our hiring process

• Intro call, HR (30 min): your background, what you're looking for, and salary range for the role.

• Fit/behavioural interview, VP of Product (45 min): your experience, your values, and how you work. An opportunity for you to find out more about the role and the company.

• Live case exercise, panel (60 min): a short, realistic problem you'll work through live, so we can see how you think, communicate, and present. Closely directed, challenging, and fun!

• Informal team interviews: meet some of the people you will work with across product, engineering, and customer success.

• Offer.

At Restb.ai we consider diversity as one of our main pillars and we foster an inclusive work environment based on cooperation and mutual respect. We offer equal opportunities for everyone regardless of race, cultural background, gender, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religious beliefs or disability.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
Acclaim is a voice-first AI platform for customer experience in industries such as banking, fintech, insurance, healthcare and consumer lifestyle products.

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager for the Acclaim AI platform: the infrastructure, studio, agentic and speech layers that our voice-first AI agents are built on.

Requirements:

• Proven experience as a product manager in platform, infrastructure or AI platform products.

• High autonomy: you take a goal, drive discussions, build the process around it, and come back with the next strategic question without being chased.

• Strong cross-cutting prioritization: you have turned chaos into goals, priorities and a roadmap, and you know the frameworks and how to align stakeholders around them.

• Portfolio ownership: you have run two or more products or teams at the same time, not one after another.

• Working knowledge of how AI agents are built: orchestration, routing, intent detection, reasoning patterns such as ReAct, RAG. You have worked with evals and understand why they matter.

• Clear written and spoken communication with executives, engineers and commercial teams.

• English - professional working level.

Nice to have

• Direct experience managing other product managers.

• Hands-on experience with voice or speech AI products.

• Experience with developer-facing products: APIs, SDKs, usage-based pricing.

• Experience in enterprise B2B or regulated industries.

Responsibilities:

• Own platform strategy, priorities and roadmap across multiple teams. Turn competing requests into a ranked plan with clear goals that an executive can read once and understand.

• Align stakeholders from different departments on trade-offs, and keep the teams focused on right priorities.

• Run several teams or product areas, and step in hands-on where needed.

• Define and track platform metrics like business results, reliability and quality (SLA), time to deploy a new agent, and the delivery effort needed per client.

• Work with engineering on agent architecture, speech, guardrails and evals: shape requirements and take part in technical discussions as an equal.

• Help decide which platform capabilities grow into standalone products.

• Set up the product process and team structure as the platform scales, and take over cross-cutting product work from the leadership team step by step.

What we offer:

• Ownership of the strategy and roadmap of a multi-layer AI platform, with direct access to the leadership team.

• The chance to build the product process, roadmap and team structure of the platform during a growth stage, instead of inheriting them.

• Work on the current AI stack: speech, agents, guardrails, evals.

• Fully remote across Europe

• 21 vacation days + public holidays + 5 sick days

• Private English lessons via Preply

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Operations Automation & Enablement (OAE)
jobs.description:
About The Opportunity

We are seeking a hands-on, strategic Senior Product Manager - Ops Automation & Enablement (OAE) with a passion for building the intelligence and systems behind world-class banking operations.

This is a true builder’s role: you will lead the strategy, design, delivery, and enterprise-scale adoption of Agentic AI, hyperautomation, process mining, and internal tooling to reshape how complex, control-intensive Banking Operations are executed.

You will work cross-functionally with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and operational leaders to ensure N26 can scale aggressively across markets and product offerings without proportional headcount growth—all while maintaining the strict regulatory and quality standards our customers expect.

In This Role, You Will

Lead Enterprise Transformation & Agentic AI Adoption:

• Architect AI Workflows: Design, deploy, and govern E2E, multi-step Agentic AI solutions and automations that target high-volume processes, cross-team friction, and manual back-office tasks.

• AI Champion: Act as the primary AI Champion for Banking Operations: translating complex ML/AI concepts into practical, working systems rather than just talking about them.

• Change Management & Value Realization: Identify structural and behavioral barriers to adoption; design frameworks that embed new AI capabilities into day-to-day operations and team decision-making.

End-to-End Operating Model & Process Intelligence

• Process Mining Re-Engineering: Lead structured process capture, process mining, and workflow mapping. Evaluate opportunities to completely redesign end-to-end workflows rather than merely automating existing inefficiencies.

• Core CRM & Platform Integration: Partner with Conversational Banking and Platform owners to optimize Salesforce (our core case-management backbone) and integrate AI agents with our central architecture and AWS infrastructure.

• Operational Efficiency & ROI: Define and track clear metrics for every initiative (FTE impact, handling times, error rates, cost-per-unit, and time saved) to ensure high business value and ROI.

Execution, Governance & Cross-Functional Alignment

• Bridge Tech & Operations: Work directly with Banking Ops leads, Data Science, AI Enablement, and Engineering to turn operational pain points into clear product specs, PRDs, and prompt configurations.

• Regulatory Excellence: Collaborate with Data Protection, Legal, and Compliance teams to build resilient workflows that comply strictly with GDPR, the EU AI Act, and internal governance standards.

• Operational Readiness: Own product readiness for launches: ensuring changes in one pod do not disrupt downstream processes, control environments, or customer outcomes.

What You Need To Be Successful

• Product Management Experience: 5+ years in Product Management, Process Engineering, or Operational Transformation, ideally in a fast-moving tech, digital, or fintech environment.

• AI & Automation Track Record: Demonstrated experience taking ML, RPA, or Agentic AI products from 0 to 1 (or significantly scaling them) with measurable, quantified operational savings.

• Hands-On & Technical Curiosity: Comfortable working with APIs, prompt engineering, agentic frameworks, and orchestration tools. You are hands-on enough to build/configure the first version yourself, but strategic enough to design the long-term vision.

• Process Improvement Mindset: Proven expertise in workflow mapping, failure demand analysis, and structured waste-reduction methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent).

• Regulated Environment Experience: Background in banking or fintech, navigating compliance, legal, and risk sign-offs in a control-heavy environment.

• Analytical & Data-Driven: Proficient in using data to model impact before building and measure results after (Power BI, SQL, or similar).

• Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of presenting complex trade-offs to senior leadership (EXCO/SteerCo) and influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority.

About You

• Structured by default: You write things down, build systems, and actively retire processes that no longer serve the organization.

• AI-First Instinct: You inherently see how agents can augment human teams and make work faster, smarter, and cleaner.

• Pragmatic & Outcome-Focused: You care deeply about results, operational quality, and scalable growth, not just deploying shiny tools.

What’s In It For You

• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.

• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.

• Come together with your team in the office for a dedicated day of teamwork each week, plus another day of your choice, and enjoy the flexibility of remote work the rest of the time. Some roles may require additional in-office presence.

• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.

• Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.

• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.

• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Madrid and Barcelona, and a 1,700-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!

Equal opportunities for all

At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages.

We are committed to providing an excellent and accessible candidate experience. If you require any accommodations to make this process work for you, please let us know. We’re here to support you!

Discover more about Diversity & Inclusion at N26: https://n26.com/en-eu/diversity-and-inclusion

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
Barcelona, Spain | Hybrid | Full-time | Product Management

About The Role

As a Staff Product Manager at Kiwi.com, you will own a deeply technical product scope spanning core logic, supplier integrations, and pricing algorithms while driving commercial outcomes. Operating closer to tech and data than a traditional PM, you will set vision, write specs, run experiments, and ship products end-to-end using AI agents to accelerate execution.

About The Inventory - Data Acquisition Team

In our Kiwi.com Data Acquisition team, we are responsible for sourcing the most accurate, complete and competitive content for our customers and ultimately enhancing their searching success. We collect, analyze and integrate data from multiple services and sources to ensure content quality and bookability. In short, our mission is to ensure our users find the flights they are looking for, at the best possible price.

What You Will Do

• Guide products from discovery to launch by shaping clear product vision, balanced technical trade-offs, and shared outcomes that ship iteratively into production.

• Build a comprehensive understanding of data pipelines, API integrations, caching logic, and pricing algorithms to support swift, autonomous technical choices.

• Partner closely with engineering teams to explore architecture trade-offs, refine system designs, and establish clear acceptance criteria that support real business and customer needs.

• Integrate AI agents into everyday workflows to enrich data analysis, support rapid prototyping, and shorten the feedback loop from concept to delivery.

• Co-create impactful AI and machine learning initiatives that elevate content quality, support dynamic pricing, and refine system health monitoring.

• Cultivate close alignment across engineers, data scientists, and commercial partners, bringing diverse perspectives together around transparent, shared priorities.

• Support and mentor fellow product managers through thoughtful product discovery, metric-informed decision-making, and open feedback loops.

• Communicate domain strategy and insights with clarity, empathy, and transparency across both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What You Will Need

• A proven track record of nurturing complex tech products end-to-end with clear accountability for positive business outcomes.

• Your previous significant experience as a technical Product Manager is backed by supporting internal tools, data flows, and iterative experiments.

• You bring successful experience in working comfortably with data pipelines, API contracts, caching considerations, and system data exploration.

• You bring senior-level experience with hands-on AI agent orchestration, thoughtful prompt design, and developing AI-assisted prototypes.

• You thrive in collaborative, fast-moving spaces where teams ship early, learn together, and iterate using production signals.

• You can demonstrate your skills in connecting strategy, technical depth, and data modeling in an open environment free of red tape.

• You have professional proficiency level English language skills (written and verbal), and you communicate with clarity, empathy, and precision.

We offer you

• We offer a hybrid and flexible work environment. A lovely, modern office in the center of Barcelona (Passeig de Gracia) with great views and amenities.

• Monthly entitlement of 200 Euro redeemable through Cobee. Cobee is a benefits platform offering a range of benefits (meals, transport, nursery, health insurance, and physical wellness) and flexible compensation. It also allows our employees to allocate up to 30% of their gross salary to the consumption of certain products or services, leveraging tax exemption.

• We also enjoy benefits, such as flexible working hours, 30 paid vacation days and sick days.

• Annual financial bonus based on company and individual performance.

• Flight vouchers to celebrate your Kiwi anniversaries.

• Relocation package within the EU (including visa transfer support).

• Dogs are welcome in our offices.

About Kiwi.com

Kiwi.com is a leading global travel-tech company headquartered in the Czech Republic. Our innovative algorithm enables users to find better route options and prices other search engines can’t see, daily performing billions of price checks across 95% of global flight content. Are you bold, bright and curious? Join a global business that’s still got a start-up heart.

Interested? Join us and help us make travel more accessible to all.

Kiwi.com is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, uniformed services, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

Throughout the recruitment process and for some time after it’s finished, we’re going to process your Personal Data. You can find all the necessary information in our Privacy Policy available at: https://jobs.kiwi.com/recruitment-privacy-policy/.

jobs.title: Product Manager (BCN)
jobs.description:
Lexroom is building the AI platform where legal work gets done. In just over two years, we've grown from zero to €25M ARR, and today more than 20,000 legal professionals across Italy, Spain, Germany, France, and Bulgaria rely on Lexroom .

We're backed by $73M from Left Lane Capital, Base10 Partners, and Eurazeo, and we're a team of around 300 builders who move fast, say things straight, and own each outcome.

Our next goal? Become Europe's most-used legal product.

Why Lexroom ?

• Shape the Standard: Be part of the team setting the benchmark for legal AI in Europe.

• Work with the Best: Collaborate with exceptional colleagues in a culture that values competence, curiosity, and ambition.

• Deliver Meaningful Results: Your contribution will directly influence how legal professionals work—faster, clearer, and more efficiently.

At Lexroom , we leave buzzwords behind. Here, you’ll build something that lasts: a trusted platform, a strong reputation, a new standard for the legal world.

Role

You’ll own the product for two distinct but connected areas: one of our core AI product surfaces (such as legal research, drafting, practice workflows) and one of our international expansion markets across Europe.

That means doing the discovery work to understand what law firms actually need, shipping features that move retention and depth of use, and helping figure out what Lexroom means in a new market, from corpus coverage to onboarding to positioning.

What You’ll Do:

What We’re Looking For

• 2–4 years as a Product Manager, ideally in B2B SaaS or early-stage startups.

• You’ve shipped high-quality features end-to-end in fast-paced environments and can point to the outcome, not just the output.

• AI-native PM: you are able to build a working MVP using AI coding tools.

Bonus if you have: experience with legal tech, enterprise software, or a previous international market expansion.

What To Expect

• Scope: You’ll own a product area from day one, not assist on someone else’s roadmap.

• Team: Small squads, fast feedback, direct access to the founders and CTO.

Rewarding Your Contribution

We value excellence and share success:

Annual Salary Range: €45,000 – €80,000+ depending on seniority

• Stock option package: Your hard work will directly contribute to—and benefit from—our success.

Benefits That Matter

• Hybrid Work: Flexibility to balance remote work with in-person collaboration at our Barcelona office.

• Health Insurance: Comprehensive coverage to ensure peace of mind.

At Lexroom , ambition meets discipline and purpose.

We're not just building a product—we're setting a new standard for the legal world. If you're ready to contribute to something lasting and meaningful, we'd love to hear from you

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - AI Platform
jobs.description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

Preply is an AI-native company, and the AI Platform is the foundation that underpins all of our AI initiatives. We’re building it to power AI product features for learning and the marketplace, personalising the experience for our tutors and learners, and to be the single place for teams at Preply to build agentic systems and workflows. It will be pivotal in helping Preply move fast, automate and scale.

As the first product manager on the AI Platform, you’ll define the mission, vision and strategy across traditional ML, LLM and agentic systems. This is a new, greenfield role: a great opportunity to make a product impact on a foundational platform. You’ll make sure we build safely and responsibly, with the platform setting the standards, governance and guardrails for how Preply builds with AI.

The role focuses on building the product roadmap with multiple engineering teams, helping other product teams build faster, and measuring the platform’s impact on how fast Preply builds, automates and scales with AI.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Define the mission, vision, strategy, and product roadmap for the AI platform across traditional ML, LLM, and agentic systems, working with multiple engineering teams

• Increase the return on investment in ML and LLMs, and set the direction for building and scaling agents across internal and external workflows

• Provide product teams with a trusted foundation to build, learn, and ship AI safely at scale

• Implement safeguards and controls, including standards, governance, and guardrails for building, to ensure safe shipping

• Reduce the cost of building and running AI across the company

• Demonstrate and increase the ROI of AI investments, showing impact on business metrics and delivering platform metrics around speed, safety, activity, and cost

• Collaborate with engineering managers and the engineering, data, and product chapters to identify opportunities and pain points, and understand the experience of teams building on the platform

What You Need To Succeed

• Technical platform experience across ML, GenAI, and agentic platforms, including gateways, models, tools, memory, governance, and security

• Ability to set the direction for how agents are built and scaled across internal and external workflows

• Experience shipping AI and ML systems from a product, technical, or engineering background

• Excellent product sense in the fast-changing AI domain, with a drive to do product work, not just building

• Leading AI fluency, using AI to transform personal work and helping others do the same

• Proven ability to influence and align senior engineering, data, and business stakeholders, with credibility among data and engineering teams

Nice to have

• Hands-on experience in platform, AI, or ML engineering before moving into product

• Experience in tech or AI-native businesses, such as e-commerce, fintech, or B2B SaaS with critical AI features

Why you will love it at Preply

• An open, collaborative, dynamic, and diverse culture

• A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com

• Learning & Development budget and time off for self-development

• A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance, and health insurance

• Attractive relocation package to join the Preply Barcelona Hub if not already in Barcelona

• Access to free mental health support platforms

• Access to Gym-pass -partnered wellness and gym centres throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health

• Opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in

Our Principles

• Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.

• We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.

• Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.

• Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.

• Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.

• Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.

• Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.

• Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.

• Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.

• One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager/Game Designer (New Games)
jobs.description:
About Us
WildCard Games makes games players come back to every day. Our portfolio includes Spades Fever, Ultimate Cribbage, Domino Fever, and more, played by millions of people worldwide. We’re growing our New Games team to build and test new titles quickly and invest in the ones players give us a reason to believe in.

The Role
We’re looking for a Senior or Lead Product Manager who can pick up a rough prototype, recognize what makes it worth playing, and help a small team decide what to build next. You’ll play each build yourself, watch how players respond, and use both to answer three questions. What makes someone want another game? What’s getting in the way? Is this game worth another week of the team’s time?

You’ll own individual titles from concept through validation, soft launch, and scale. You’ll own day-to-day product priorities and bring leadership a clear recommendation when it’s time to invest, test a specific change, or stop development. Once a game is performing consistently, you’ll hand it over to LiveOps.

What You'll Do

• Shape and play new games. Work alongside design, art, and engineering to get ideas into players’ hands quickly. Play deeply enough to pinpoint where a choice becomes interesting, a round starts to drag, or a player finds a reason to come back. Give the team specific feedback and play the next build to see whether it helped.

• Keep prototypes focused. Identify the biggest open question for each game and the smallest build that can answer it. Know which details are essential to making the game feel good and which can wait.

• Lead validation and make timely calls. Agree on success criteria before each test. Combine playtests, player behavior, and cohort data to recommend whether to advance, iterate, or stop. When you ask for another iteration, be clear about what you’d change and what result would justify further investment.

• Own the roadmap and product performance. Choose measures that fit the stage of the game, from first-session completion and voluntary replay to D1, D7, and D30 retention, ARPDAU, and LTV. Use what you learn to set priorities and keep the Director and team aligned on trade-offs.

• Build toward scale. Partner with UA on audience fit, creative testing, and acquisition costs. Develop the progression, economy, and monetization that support repeat play and a viable business.

• Prepare successful games for LiveOps. Work with the receiving team on analytics, event tooling, content pipelines, documentation, and a roadmap they can confidently take over.

• At the Lead level, mentor other PMs, improve how we evaluate new games, and help shape portfolio priorities with the Director of Game Development.

What You Bring

• 5+ years in mobile game product management, including early prototype work and experience taking at least one free-to-play title from soft launch to scale.

• Strong game design judgment. You can explain what makes a game satisfying for its intended audience, identify the change most likely to improve it, and revise your view when players surprise you.

• A track record of making decisions with incomplete information. You can walk us through a game you backed, one you stopped, and what you knew when you made each call.

• Hands-on experience with retention, game economies, and free-to-play monetization, including how ads fit into the player experience.

• The ability to investigate performance yourself using SQL or BI tools, cohort analysis, A/B testing, and unit economics.

• Experience keeping a small cross-functional team moving. You set clear priorities, make trade-offs quickly, and give designers and engineers room to solve the problem.

Nice to have

• Experience with classic card, board, or casual social games and an understanding of what keeps their players coming back for years.

• Experience testing UA creative and evaluating CPI alongside retention and LTV.

• Experience running live events or seasonal content, or handing a game over to a LiveOps team.

• A background in game design, analytics, or production.

What we offer

• Competitive compensation and stock options

• Fully remote work

• Hands-on ownership of new games, from the first playable build through launch and scale

jobs.title: AI Solution Product Owner
jobs.description:

About The Job

Sanofi is an innovative global healthcare company, driven by one purpose: we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. Our team, across over 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible. We provide potentially life-changing treatment options and life-saving vaccines to protect millions of people globally, while putting sustainability and social responsibility at the center of our ambitions.

Digital is driving Sanofi's ambition to become the first biopharma powered by AI at scale - accelerating how we discover, develop, and deliver breakthrough medicines and vaccines. Sanofi is rebuilding how it works with customers, suppliers, and colleagues, and AI and data are at the center of that transformation. As part of M&S Digital, you will build the products and platforms that make Manufacturing & Supply faster, leaner, and smarter, so medicines reach patients sooner.

About This Product

You will lead flagship Data and AI products that may range from topics such as AI for inspection readiness, agentic supply chain, and lab automation - taking them from the first idea through to scaled adoption across Manufacturing & Supply.

Your users are the global teams working in quality to make sure patients have the most reliable product; the scientists working on the shopfloor who make our medicines and constantly improve efficiency to make sure we have enough product to deliver into the hands of patients; and the supply chain teams who are looking to fundamentally reinvent our delivery chain, reduce lead time, and secure supply.

Your job is to give them capabilities that can scale and create meaningful impact: products that turn world-class AI and data into everyday working tools for the people who make our medicines.

Mains Responsibilities

Own flagship products and their impact

About You

Experience and domain

• You have demonstrated experience delivering products before - this is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have. You have personally taken at least one product from concept to a deployed capability that real users rely on.

• 5+ years in product, data science, applied science, or a technical product role with Progressively broader scope, with a consistent record of shipping rather than prototyping

First-principles thinking

Execution and builder mentality

Influence and business fluency

User focus

Mindset

jobs.title: Product Manager - B2B SaaS
jobs.description:
One of our clients in the foodtech industry is looking for a Product Manager with 3 + years of experience.

💰Salary 40-60k
📍 Hybrid in Barcelona (at least two days per week at our office in Poblenou)
🏝️ Vacation & perks : All AI tooling that you wish to experiment with, a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership, flexible working hours, a bright modern office, PayFlow, and many more (see below)

Check out their job description below:

We are the market leader solution for point of control in restaurants, handling all back-office vital operations like product management, inventories, purchases, price tracking, document conciliation, bank conciliation, paychecks, clocking in/out, P&L reports, etc.

Not only we have a system of record that helps operate restaurants with control and clarity, but we are also the leaders in offering AI Agents, starting with Fina. They work 24/7 doing the heavy, tedious work that our customers don't have time to do well.

This is no AI hype. Our customers obtain visible value from our AI Agents, both in money and time saved. We are becoming strategic partners in the design of their businesses.

👉 Our mission is to empower millions of restaurateurs to level up their business.
👉 Our vision is to lead the market through innovation, strong relationships and by becoming the go-to tech partner for restaurant success.

👀 We are backed by Y Combinator, the accelerator behind Airbnb and Twitch. We are growing fast with support from top-tier investors like JME, Decelera, Extension Fund, Wayra, and Zone2Boost.

➡️ Why are we hiring?

We are hiring because our ambitions are increasing: more customers, more AI automation, and a relentless focus on delivering value at scale.

Here, a PM is an uncertainty resolver who bridges the gap between complex AI technology and real-world restaurant needs. As we scale, we are looking for someone who has already lived the operational challenges, metrics, and business dynamics of a B2B SaaS. We need a creative PM with exceptional judgment to lead large initiatives independently and maintain a direct pulse on our customers.

If you’re excited by full ownership and building an AI-native product before we fully evolve from startup to scale-up, this is the right moment to join.

➡️ About our Product Managers

Here, we don't believe in "feature factories." As a PM here, you are the DRI (Directly Responsible Individual) for your area.

• You won’t be writing specs: Our Product Engineers own the technical specs and execution. You will focus on the "Why" and the "What." You’ll talk to customers, look at the data, and collaborate with engineers to decide what not to build.

• Prototyping is your superpower: We favor action. You’ll spend a significant part of your time prototyping and validating ideas (think Peter Yang: idea in the morning, prototype at noon, customer validation by lunch).

• AI-native mindset: You don't just "add AI" to a feature; you rethink user flows assuming AI is the core engine. You are the brain that shapes the AI’s output with criteria and context.

• Customer Proximity: Many of our restaurants are based right here in Barcelona. You’ll be just a step away from the people using what you build.

➡️ About how we create product

• Shape the Team: We are currently a small, focused team (Ingrid, Gemma and Andrea). You will have the unique opportunity to help shape the Product organization from the ground up.

• Radical Simplicity: We favor a single way of doing things to avoid over-engineering. We prioritize simple solutions and proven patterns over unnecessary complexity.

• High Ownership: We work as DRIs. While engineers own the stability and execution, you own the discovery and the ultimate success of the initiative.

• Agile Execution: We apply a Lean model (prototype, launch, learn). A 3-day prototype in Figma, Magicpath, or NoCode tools delivers more value to us than a 3-week spec.

➡️ What You’ll Do

• Strategy & Vision: Align product discovery with business goals, making data-driven and user-centered decisions.

• Fast Iteration: Prioritize solutions into small, actionable releases. You will ideate, prototype, launch, and repeat until the problem is solved.

• Direct Customer Feedback: Join customer meetings and dive into their workflows to ensure we are moving the needle.

• AI Orchestration: Define how our AI agents interact with our systems, starting small and scaling based on real-world observation.

• Full Ownership: Responsible for the entire lifecycle of an initiative—from the first "Why" to monitoring its adoption and impact.

• Lead the Bar: Demand excellence in the user experience. You will ensure we ship fast without compromising the core value of the product.

Example objectives for your first months:

• Group Vision Discovery: Lead the discovery for our "Restaurant Groups" vision to drive growth in Weekly Active Users (WAU).

• Kickstart Major Initiatives: Launch large-scale initiatives like "Orders" alongside engineering, proposing iterative solutions to solve complex problems fast.

➡️ What You Need To Bring

• 3-5 years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS: You know what it takes to drive adoption, retain business customers, and build intuitive workflows for complex B2B systems.

• Hunger & Curiosity: A natural drive to learn and experiment with cutting-edge AI models and tools. You are an early adopter by nature.

• Great Judgment: The ability to discard most ideas and choose only what aligns strictly with company objectives.

• Customer Love: A genuine passion for understanding what users actually need (and why they need it).

• Proactivity: We expect bottom-up action. Don't wait for a roadmap; if the product needs a change to provide value, make it happen.

jobs.title: Product Manager AI
jobs.description:
At Teamsystem Spain we are looking for a Product Manager (AI) to lead the evolution of our products with artificial intelligence capabilities, aimed at accounting firms, micro-businesses and SMEs. This is a role with a direct impact on how our customers work every day, and one in which AI is a key lever for connecting products and data.

What you will do

• Define the product strategy together with the GPM, identifying where AI delivers measurable value: productivity, automation, decision support and accuracy.

• Analyse AI opportunities, customer needs and the competitive landscape, including generative and agent-based solutions for accounting, tax, payroll and SME management.

• Prioritise use cases by business value, technical feasibility, data availability and risk, for each type of customer.

• Define success metrics (accuracy, error or hallucination rate, time saved, adoption, cost per interaction) and establish evaluation frameworks with engineering and data science.

• Work with technical teams across the entire lifecycle: data requirements, build-or-buy decisions, prompt and RAG design, evaluation, monitoring and iteration.

• Ensure a responsible approach: data protection and GDPR, security, transparency towards the user, human oversight where needed, and alignment with the European AI Act and internal AI governance.

• Coordinate design, engineering, data and product teams to deliver the roadmap, both in the short and medium term.

• Drive synergies between products such as TS Facturas, SDS, Aplifisa and Asesor Excelente, and work with marketing, sales and support to ensure successful launches.

jobs.title: Product Manager (AI)
jobs.description:
About Us

Luzia is Europe's fastest-growing AI consumer company, redefining conversational AI with cutting-edge LLMs and an unparalleled user experience. We're on a mission to make Luzia the go-to AI personal assistant for millions of users across Latin America.

⚡ 80M+ users worldwide in under 3 years

The role

This is a hands-on role on an AI product. You will lead one of our product areas end to end: deciding what to build and what not to build, specifying agentic features with engineers, and putting them into production. There is no separate engineering manager layer, so you will own prioritisation for your area and understand how the system works, backend included, well enough to make the trade-offs yourself.

Responsibilities

• Own the roadmap for your product area, deciding what to build, what not to build and which KPIs it needs to move, using both qualitative insight and data.

• Work with Engineering, Design and Growth to turn AI capabilities into products that solve real user needs, specifying how a feature should behave, when it should call a tool or hand off to a person, and what it must never do.

• Set the team's priorities and make sure engineering effort goes to the work that matters most.

• Define how we know an AI feature is good enough to ship: the evaluation, the quality, latency and cost metrics, and the signal that tells us when a change has broken something.

• Write clear product requirements and documentation, and run experiments whose results change what we do next.

• Challenge assumptions, including the team's, and present your findings and recommendations to business leaders.

Requirements

• 4+ years building technology products, as a product manager or through an equivalent route such as product engineering or a technical founder role, including meaningful experience in a B2C consumer product.

You have shipped something where you chose the model, designed how it behaves, decided when it should call a tool or hand off to a human, and evaluated whether the output was good enough to release. You can explain what it cost, how you measured quality, and what you did when something changed underneath you.

• A strong data mindset. You go to the data yourself, use the numbers in front of you to test a decision, and are comfortable with SQL and product analytics tools.

• You drive action rather than coordinate it. You are comfortable challenging ideas, pushing back with reasoning, and making a call when the information is incomplete.

Nice to have

• Experience with conversational products, assistants or agents in a consumer setting.

• Experience with transactional or e-commerce products, including third-party API integrations.

Working model

This is a hybrid role based in our Madrid office - you’ll combine working from our office and working from home

Equal opportunity

Luzia is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on what you build and how you think.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is €70K to €90K gross per year, depending on experience. Employment is covered by the Spanish national collective agreement for consulting, IT and market research companies (Convenio Colectivo Estatal de Empresas de Consultoría, Tecnologías de la Información y Estudios de Mercado y de la Opinión Pública).
