jobs.description:
WELCOME TO OLX
 
We're building marketplace sustainable ecosystems that millions of people depend on every month – to buy and sell cars, find homes, land jobs, and trade secondhand goods. It's commerce that matters: safe, smart, and environmentally responsible.
 
We do this with courage to innovate, commitment to outcomes, collaboration across 50+ nationalities and 7 markets, and a customer-led approach that puts real people first. Add a desire to win – and you get a culture that's ambitious, fast-moving, and built on trust.
 
Our brands – including AutoTrader, OLX, Otomoto Property24, and more – are loved by millions. And we're backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest tech investors.
 
Join OLX and see how far you can go.


About the Role
We are a large-scale consumer marketplace building AI-native product experiences across multiple markets. Trust and Safety is not a defensive function here - it is a strategic growth lever. A platform users trust converts better, retains longer, and earns stronger word of mouth. Fraud, abuse, and bad actors actively destroy the value we create; eliminating them is product work at its core.
We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the Trust & Safety product agenda end-to-end. You will define the strategy for how we detect and prevent fraud, protect user integrity, and keep our marketplace safe - while building systems that are intelligent, proportionate, and do not create friction for the millions of legitimate users who rely on us every day. AI is central to how you will do this: not as an add-on, but as the foundation of a new generation of proactive, signal-driven safety infrastructure.
This role can be based in Spain, Portugal or Poland.


What you will do:
•
Own the Trust & Safety product strategy and roadmap translating business risk and user insight into a clear, prioritised plan.

•
Shift the function from reactive incident response to proactive, intelligence-driven fraud prevention: build the Risk Engine, data signals intelligence, anomaly detection, and investigation tooling that make this possible.

•
Ship AI-native T&S product experiences: partner with Data Science and Engineering to design, prototype, and productionise real-time detection and decisioning systems using ML models, LLMs, and behavioural signals.

•
Balance fraud mitigation with growth protection—ensuring T&S interventions do not unnecessarily create friction for legitimate users or throttle marketplace supply/demand. Make hard, evidence-based trade-off decisions.

•
Define and track the right T&S success metrics: fraud loss rates, false positive/negative rates, time-to-resolution, user trust scores, and financial exposure. Communicate impact in business terms to senior leadership.

•
Partner closely with Engineering leads, Data Science, Legal, Compliance, and Operations—holding shared accountability for outcomes and navigating competing priorities.

•
Build long-term instrumentation, monitoring, and evaluation capabilities to measure fraud rates, detection model performance, and contributor/user impact at scale.

•
Establish business cases quantifying fraud losses and ROI of prevention investments; secure resources and drive prioritisation grounded in data.

•
Ensure products and strategies meet local and regional compliance, legal, and security requirements across all markets.

•
Apply AI to how you operate as a PM: faster threat analysis, synthetic user research on abuse patterns, AI-assisted spec writing, automated experimentation pipelines—whatever moves the needle on velocity.

•
Represent Trust & Safety at the leadership level, presenting strategy, risk posture, and results clearly to executive audiences.

What we are looking for:
•
Significant product management experience in the digital sector: consumer facing platform, marketplace, mobility, e-commerce, classifieds, fintech, or similar high scale environment.

•
Proven experience owning trust related products or problem spaces such as Trust & Safety, Fraud Prevention, Risk, Identity & Verification, Marketplace Integrity, Account Security, Abuse Prevention, Payments Risk, or Compliance Technology.

•
Track record of building scalable systems that proactively detect, prevent, and mitigate abuse, fraud, risk, or other trust related issues, rather than relying solely on manual or operational processes.

•
Strong analytical and data driven mindset, with experience defining success metrics, evaluating impact, and making prioritization decisions based on evidence and measurable outcomes.

•
Experience partnering closely with Engineering, Data Science, Operations, Legal, Compliance, and other cross-functional stakeholders to deliver complex products in regulated or high-risk environments. Experience in vendor management and collaboration.

•
Experience building, deploying, or working closely with machine learning, AI, risk scoring, decisioning, detection, recommendation, or automation systems. Hands-on experience with AI-powered trust or fraud products is a plus.

•
Demonstrated ability to balance user experience, marketplace growth, operational efficiency, and risk mitigation, making thoughtful trade offs that protect both users and the business.

•
Comfortable operating in ambiguity, taking ownership of complex problem spaces, influencing senior stakeholders, and driving strategy and execution across multiple teams.

•
Strong core product muscle that transfers across fraud domains—you've stepped into unfamiliar threat vectors, oriented fast, and delivered. Domain specificity matters; rigid domain lock-in does not.

•
Well versed in building, iterating core Data (Science) products at scale

Nice to Have:
•
Experience building trust, risk, fraud, or safety products across multiple international markets and regulatory environments.

•
Familiarity with emerging regulations and industry trends affecting online platforms, digital marketplaces, payments, AI, and consumer trust.

If you're excited by the opportunity to solve complex trust challenges at scale and build products that make a meaningful difference to millions of users, we'd love to hear from you. This is a role for someone who enjoys tackling ambiguous problems, partnering across disciplines, and shaping the future of trust in a modern, AI-powered marketplace.

OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!

The Opportunity
 
OLX is looking for a Principal Product Manager to drive high-impact, zero-to-one initiatives across our Real Estate business (otodom.pl, imovirtual.com and storia.ro). This is a builder role focused on creating new value - not a people-management role. It's well-suited for someone who thrives on building new things, moving fast, and navigating a complex organisation to turn ideas into impact.
 
You'll lead 2–3 special initiatives in parallel, each scoped over 6–24 months. These could range from developing AI-driven capabilities and new monetisation models to building new product features that drive growth. We're hiring for mindset, not a fixed checklist.
 
You'll join the product leadership team and contribute to strategic direction across the area. The focus is on building, pushing, and delivering new value, complementing a team that excels at running and optimising the core business. 
 
This role reports to the Director of Product and can be based in Spain, Portugal or Poland. Remote work is possible within these countries.
 
What You'll Do
 
Lead zero-to-one initiatives from concept to market validation to scaled delivery - own the vision, strategy, and execution.
Build with AI as a daily lever - prototypes, agent-augmented workflows, AI-powered discovery and experimentation.
Run lean experiments to prove product-market fit fast, with minimal bureaucracy.
Present and defend your concepts to senior stakeholders - building alignment through evidence and conviction.
Navigate a matrixed organisation: identify opportunities to move quickly, build coalitions, and drive progress without waiting for perfect alignment.
Own the business case: connect product decisions to revenue and margin impact.
Raise the bar for product craft across the team - set the standard through your work, share methods and examples, and act as a role model for what high-quality product thinking looks like in practice.
 
What We're Looking For
 
8+ years of product management experience with a proven track record of building and launching new products from zero to one - not just optimising what exists.
AI native - you build with AI in your personal and professional life. 
Entrepreneurial DNA - uncomfortable with "business as usual," driven to create new value.
Fast and execution-driven - moves at pace, ships quickly, and creates momentum rather than waiting for perfect conditions.
High product craft - rigorous discovery, lean experimentation, strong narratives, data-driven decision-making.
Strong executive presence - able to defend a concept to senior directors and build alignment.
Business and financial acumen - unit economics, P&L thinking, ROI-informed decisions.
Ability to drive multiple initiatives in parallel with minimal oversight.
Marketplace or two-sided marketplace experience is a plus.
Comfort working in cross-functional, multicultural teams across multiple markets.
Willingness to travel approximately every two months.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.location: EMEA / Romania / Bulgaria / Portugal / Canada / United Kingdom / Spain / Poland (Remote)
jobs.description:
✨ ONE PLATFORM, A WHOLE WORLD OF OPPORTUNITY



The best jobs have always clustered in a handful of the world's wealthiest cities. But talent is everywhere. Oyster set out to close that gap - building a global employment platform that lets companies hire, pay, and care for brilliant people anywhere.



We're proof that a high-performing culture doesn't need an office. Distributed across 60+ countries since 2020, we've built something the industry keeps noticing:



 - Ranked #10 of 250 on TIME and Statista's 2026 list of America's Top WorkTech Companies https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-hr-named-10-of-americas-top-worktech-companies-of-2026-by-time 

 - Named one of America's Greatest Startup Workplaces 2026 https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-2026-newsweek-award by Newsweek

 - A G2 Spring 2026 Leader https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-named-best-roi-for-any-global-employment-platform-for-g2-spring-2026 across Employer of Record, Global Employment, Multi-country Payroll, and HR Compliance

 - The only B Corp-certified global employment platform ~ independently verified since 2023



Two of those rankings measured our business impact from the outside. One measured how our own people feel about working here. They landed in the same place ~ because at Oyster, culture and performance aren't separate conversations. They're the same one.



And we're just getting started. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who care as much as you do, we'd love for you to apply.




THE ROLE



Location: While this position is posted in a specific location, all of Oyster's positions are fully remote, you can work from home, forever. To create the best experience for our new hire, this role requires you to be based within +3 / -5 UTC.



We’re hiring a Lead Product Manager to own the vision, strategy, and outcomes for a critical area of Oyster’s Employer of Record product. You will shape customer-facing experiences, internal tools, and operational workflows that help companies employ talent globally with confidence, compliance, and simplicity.



You will work across the full EOR system, not only individual features, to understand how customer needs, country requirements, policies, data, operational processes, and technology interact. You will start with the customer problem and desired business outcome, use direct discovery and first-principles reasoning to identify root causes, and decide whether the best intervention belongs in product, process, policy, Operations, or a combination.



You’ll operate independently, making and communicating difficult trade-offs amid ambiguity. You will constructively challenge requested solutions, align senior stakeholders, and connect product decisions to measurable customer, operational, and commercial impact. You will also identify where AI and automation create real value, and where risk or customer needs call for a human in the loop.

 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the product vision, strategy, prioritization, and measurable outcomes for an EOR sub-domain.

 - Build a systems-level view of customer journeys, internal workflows, policy constraints, data flows, and exceptions across the EOR lifecycle.

 - Lead direct customer and operational discovery. Separate symptoms and feature requests from underlying problems, and evaluate product, process, policy, and operational interventions before choosing a solution.

 - Translate strategy into outcome-based roadmaps with clear decisions, learning plans, and success measures.

 - Work deeply with Operations and AI Engineers to improve scalability, exception handling, service quality, and cost-to-serve, not simply digitize existing processes.

 - Partner with Engineering and Design from discovery through delivery, using prototypes and technical insight to reduce risk early.

 - Constructively challenge and align senior stakeholders across Legal, Compliance, Finance, Operations, and Go-to-Market, and communicate strategy, trade-offs, and impact clearly in senior forums.

 - Contribute repeatable product practices that strengthen discovery, decision quality, and outcome ownership across the Product organization.




CORE REQUIREMENTS

 - 5+ years in Product Management, including demonstrable experience owning a complex product area end-to-end.

 - 3+ years in HR tech, payroll, benefits, hiring, compliance, or another regulated or operationally complex B2B domain.

 - Strong systems thinking, with the ability to explain how policy, operations, data, and technology interact, including exceptions and edge cases.

 - Proven first-principles thinking: the ability to separate the requested feature from the desired outcome and explain why one intervention (product, process, policy, or Operations) was chosen over the alternatives.

 - Strategic judgment and independence: proven ability to make significant decisions under ambiguity, with explicit trade-offs and a clear view of what was deprioritized.

 - Deep direct-customer discovery, with examples where conversations with customers and operational teams materially changed the problem definition or planned solution.

 - Proven ability to constructively challenge, persuade, and align senior stakeholders with competing priorities, and to partner strongly with Operations, Engineering, and Design.

 - Clear executive communication, with evidence of measurable customer, operational, or commercial impact (e.g. cost-to-serve, cycle time, retention), including the baseline, the change, and how the result was attributed to the decision.

 

Bonus / Nice-to-Have Experience

 - EOR, payroll, HR technology, benefits, compliance, fintech, healthcare, logistics, or another regulated and operationally complex domain. Transferable experience counts where the complexity is comparable (multi-country rules, compliance exposure, human-in-the-loop workflows).

 - Scaling products or workflows across countries, customers, teams, or markets.

 - Hands-on experience prototyping with AI tools or shipping responsible AI- or automation-enabled product experiences.

 - Fully distributed and multicultural working experience.




YOU'LL ALSO NEED

 - A reliable home internet connection and fluency in both written and spoken English.

 - High standards for quality, ethics, privacy, and compliance in products that affect people and employment.

 




HOW WE WORK TOGETHER AT OYSTER

Our values guide the work we do, the decisions we make, and the culture that makes Oyster what it is. We make it happen—progress is our default setting. We drive change, we build and give trust, and we move as one united team.



Our mission is to create a more equal world of work: helping companies everywhere hire, pay, and care for talent anywhere. Everything we do ladders up to our mission. We embrace asynchronous, collaborative work and share how we operate in the Oyster Public HQ https://oysterhr.notion.site/Welcome-to-The-Reef-Oyster-s-Open-Source-Employee-Guide-fc482e3f10

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager AI -  — Studio Builder
jobs.description:
OUR VISION

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System for French SMEs and Accounting Firms — and soon, European ones.

We help entrepreneurs get rid of time-consuming accounting and financial tasks while giving them access to the information they need to make better decisions for their business.


ABOUT US

Pennylane is one of the fastest-growing Fintechs in France — and soon in Europe.

In five years, we have:

 - 💻 Built a groundbreaking accounting and financial platform for SMEs and accounting firms

 - 💰 Raised €225 million from leading investors, including Sequoia

 - 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grown from 7 co-founders to more than 850 Pennylaners

 - 🌍 Built an international and remote-friendly environment with more than 25 nationalities

 - 🤝 Earned the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms

 - 🚀 Reached more than 700,000 SMEs and 4,500 accounting firms in France


WHY THIS POSITION IS CRITICAL TO OUR MISSION

At Pennylane, Product is at the heart of how we create value for our customers.

We are now making a major bet on AI: not only to automate existing workflows, but also to fundamentally change how people interact with their financial software and extend what the product can do.

Our AI ecosystem is being built across several complementary layers:

 - A shared AI platform, or “harness”, that provides the foundations required to run reliable agents: context, memory, tools, skills, loops, guardrails and observability

 - Studio Coworker, a conversational product experience that helps users analyse information and take action inside Pennylane

 - Autopilot, which automates accounting and financial workflows to reduce manual data entry

 - Studio Builder, the product you will own, enabling users to build and deploy personalised apps, automations and agents on top of Pennylane

Studio Builder is our most ambitious AI product initiative.

The idea is simple but powerful: give customers the ability to extend Pennylane according to their own needs, without requiring them to build everything from scratch. Users should be able to describe what they want to achieve and rely on AI to create, configure and deploy the right experience directly within Pennylane.

This could unlock a new way to use financial software: more personalised, more extensible and increasingly capable of adapting to every company’s specific workflows.

As Senior Product Manager, AI, you will shape this product from the ground up. You will define the vision, understand where AI can create genuine customer value and turn a highly complex technical ambition into a simple, useful and scalable product experience.

You will join one of the key teams shaping the future of Pennylane.

You can also read more about Pennylane’s position at the intersection of AI, accounting and financial software in The New York Times https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/23/business/dealbook/pennylane-ai-accounting-france.html.


WHAT YOU WILL OWN


THE VISION AND STRATEGY FOR STUDIO BUILDER

You will define how Studio Builder should help customers create, personalise and extend Pennylane.

You will identify the most valuable use cases, understand where customers struggle today and establish a clear product strategy that balances ambition, usability and technical feasibility.


THE END-TO-END BUILDING EXPERIENCE

You will own the experience through which customers:

 - Define what they want to build

 - Configure the relevant data, context, tools and actions

 - Test and iterate on their app, automation or agent

 - Deploy it within Pennylane

 - Monitor its usage and improve it over time


THE FOUNDATIONS OF AN EXTENSIBLE AI PRODUCT

You will work closely with the AI platform team to ensure that Studio Builder makes the underlying capabilities of Pennylane accessible and useful to customers.

This includes thinking deeply about how users interact with:

 - Context and memory

 - Tools and skills

 - Agent loops and workflows

 - Guardrails and permissions

 - Reliability and observability

 - Deployment and iteration


A CLEAR PRODUCT OUTCOME

You will define the metrics that matter and establish how we measure success.

Depending on the stage of the product, this may include:

 - Activation and adoption of Studio Builder

 - Number and quality of apps, automations or agents created

 - Successful deployment and repeated usage

 - Customer value generated through personalised workflows

 - Reliability, trust and user satisfaction

 - Expansion of Pennylane’s product capabilities through customer-built experiences


HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE AS A PRODUCT MANAGER

You will work in a highly collaborative environment with Engineering, Product Design, AI specialists and other Product Managers.

You will:

 - Lead continuous discovery with SMEs, accountants and internal users

 - Turn complex customer problems into clear product opportunities

We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, https://www.trustpilot.com/review/qonto.com based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture https://qonto.com/en/careers/culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here https://medium.com/qonto-way/the-qonto-way-our-culture-is-our-strategy-90defd4895f9).

 

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre https://www.linkedin.com/in/aprot/ and Steve https://www.linkedin.com/in/steveanavi/, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

We've built a discrimination-free hiring process https://medium.com/qonto-way/a-recruiters-dilemma-confronting-bias-in-hiring-b78acce148eb because the best teams are built on merit.

Join us as a Product Manager, Loans and build Qonto’s first SMB loans from zero to one. You’ll shape how thousands of European businesses borrow to grow, as we open lending under our own credit license.

 - Build loans from zero to one: You’ll own the roadmap and KRs of our new Loans squad, from first idea to launch.

 - Dig into SMB credit pain points: You’ll run continuous discovery and experiments to learn how businesses borrow today and what they truly need.

 - Shape underwriting and decisioning: You’ll define how we assess eligibility and decide how much we lend, together with Risk.

 - Bring AI into credit: You’ll explore how AI can guide clients to the right financing, within a strict regulatory frame.

 - Ship responsibly with our partners: You’ll work with our credit platform team, Risk, Compliance, Growth and Product Marketing to get every launch approved and live.



➡️ What we’re looking for

 - Zero-to-one launches: You’ve taken products from idea to market as a PM, ideally in finance or another regulated space.

 - Credit curiosity: You know lending, or you’re eager to learn it, from underwriting to repayment.

 - AI-fluent: You use AI every day and want to apply it to credit decisions.

 - Autonomy with Risk and Compliance: You can carry a launch through approvals on your own.

 - Real ownership: You own your roadmap and KRs, within the global credit strategy.

 - A solid head start: You’ll build on an existing credit platform and reusable building blocks, not from a blank page.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (VPN)
jobs.description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Founded in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN, Proton was built on the belief that privacy is a fundamental human right . What started as an encrypted email service has grown into an ecosystem of privacy-first products, including Proton Mail, VPN, Drive, Pass, and Calendar, used by millions of people worldwide.

We're profitable, independent, and building for the long term. Free from venture capital control and advertising-driven business models, we focus on what matters most: our users. Our work helps protect digital freedom, from everyday privacy to supporting journalists and activists in challenging environments.

Today, we're an international team of 700+ people, with offices across 9 countries. We have high standards for the people we hire and the work we do. You'll work alongside talented, driven colleagues who challenge each other, take ownership, and care about getting things right.

Explore our open-source projects .

The Role:
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the consumer side of Proton VPN. Product at Proton sits at the intersection of Engineering, Growth, Data and Design. Your job is to grow engagement, conversion and retention by building a product people trust and enjoy using. You know product-led growth and how to make a freemium model work. You’ll own features end to end, from discovery to launch and iteration, working with R&D, Security, Back-End, Growth, Marketing, Design and Customer Support.

What you will do:

• Work with the senior leadership team to define the vision and roadmap for the consumer VPN.

• Ensure that we are building, shipping and supporting the right features that deliver impactful value creation over time.

• Drive product innovation: develop novel, game-changing product features that expand our value proposition to new user segments and increase our defensibility.

• Define and own what success looks like in terms of adoption, activation and retention.

• Facilitate hand-in-hand collaboration between product, engineering, growth and marketing to align on the vision and the execution.

• Lead the teams through execution. See through the fog of war and know where to go and what needs to be done quickly and decisively. Troubleshoot and solve problems involving multiple teams inside and outside of product.

• Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and gather customer feedback to inform product decisions.

• Anticipate growth ceilings and define scaling strategies to prevent them, that include managing projects beyond pure-product work, and include foundational technology, tools, and processes, such as a customer engagement platform.

• Set a fast pace for the team, help them to overcome blockers and execute faster.

What we are looking for

We need you to have:

• 7-10 years of product management experience in B2C SaaS, preferably in security and/or productivity contexts.

• Proven track record in successful product and major feature launches in fast-paced environments.

• Strategic leader with an analytical and data-driven mindset, with a track record of delivering products and features on time and with commercial success.

• Strong empathy for the customer, user-centric mindset, and an unwillingness to lower standards.

• A strong innate sense for good UX, with a love for design.

• Experience building and managing high-performing teams.

• A work ethic of going above and beyond to make things happen. Ability to be hands-on and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

• Deep technical acumen and a technical background (ideally a Computer Science degree), able to contribute to technical decisions.

What we offer:

• Work that Matters: Millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments.

• A Great Team: Diverse, collaborative, and tight-knit, with people from MIT, Harvard, Stanford, Caltech, Cambridge, ETH, and more.

• Technology: The right hardware and software to do your best work.

• Learning & Development: We invest in your growth. Proton is one of the fastest ways to accelerate your career — real challenges, real ownership, from day one.

• Employee Benefits: Strong health coverage, solid retirement options, generous leave, and wellness support.

• Stock Options: From day one, you have a real stake in what we're building. When Proton wins, you win.

• In-Person Collaboration: Offices across Geneva, Zürich, Barcelona, London, and more. You'll spend most of your time collaborating face-to-face.

• Food: Lunch and snacks on us every day in the office.

• Transport: We cover public transport, bike allowances, or parking — whichever works for you.

• Flexible Working: You own your schedule. Outcomes matter more than clock-in times.

Compensation range:

• Barcelona: €50,000–€95,000 gross annually.

• Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process.

• Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. We strive to create equal opportunities, promote open dialogue, and support continuous learning to ensure every voice is heard and respected.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

Candidate Privacy Notice

When you apply for a position, refer a candidate, or are considered for a role at Proton AG (Proton, we, us, or our), your information is stored in Greenhouse, in accordance with their Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position. We also retain this information for consideration for future roles that you may apply for or that we believe may align with your background and skills.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. Should you have any inquiries about how we use or manage your information, or if you wish to access, correct, or delete your data, please contact our privacy team at careers@proton.ch.

Proton does not accept unsolicited resumes from any sources other than directly from candidates. We will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from an unsolicited offer, even if the candidate is subsequently hired by Proton.

To learn more about our privacy policy, please visit our privacy policy page .

jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to join our unannounced project in Barcelona on a hybrid basis or at any of our remote locations in the UK, Portugal, and Ireland.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people worldwide daily.

We are in the early stages of development on an ambitious, unannounced, cross-platform Strategy/MMO featuring a well-known IP. You have the opportunity to join a highly experienced team to make a lasting impact on one of the next big releases.

What You Will Do

• Strategic Planning and Execution: Drive the roadmap and technical requirements for platform systems, backend services, and tooling needed to support a global, live-operated mobile/PC game.

• Leadership and Mentorship: Provide leadership in daily tasks and larger projects, ensuring quality and timely execution.

• Data Analysis and Insights: Help define technical KPIs, monitor performance, and identify areas of optimisation or risk.

• Communication and Collaboration: Serve as a vocal and proactive member of the team, actively communicate complex ideas clearly, and maintain visibility with upper management and cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and address potential issues.

What We’re Looking For

• Experience in technical product management and/or software engineering in the mobile games industry.

• Experience writing technical specifications, translating product needs into system-level requirements.

• Skilled in managing backlogs, setting goals, and choosing the right tools and techniques to achieve high-quality results.

• Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs and communicate risks or constraints to non-technical stakeholders.

Bonus Points

• Background in Software Engineering

• Previous working experience with live software.

• Familiarity with custom rendering pipelines or GPU-driven rendering architecture

At Scopely, we create games for everyone and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us and embrace the adventure!

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/ .

Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @ scopely.com .

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice .

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

jobs.title: Head of Southern Europe Revenue & Growth
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Southern Europe Revenue & Growth team is a high-performing sales organisation focused on helping businesses across Iberia and Italy grow using modern financial infrastructure. We work with businesses of all sizes to power innovative business models, reduce costs, expand internationally, and deliver outstanding experiences for their customers.

What you’ll do

• As Head of Southern Europe Revenue & Growth, you will lead and coach a high-performing team of account executives and sales managers. You will be responsible for delivering ambitious targets and driving predictable, sustainable revenue growth across Iberia and Italy and across Stripe’s product portfolio.

• You will be an exemplary cross-functional leader, operating effectively at the highest levels of a matrixed organisation. You will partner with teams across Stripe to achieve our revenue goals and help our users realise their ambitions.

• We are looking for a leader with a proven track record of building and scaling sales teams in Southern Europe or across EMEA. You will have consistently delivered outstanding results while maintaining a long-term, user-first mindset. You will thrive in ambiguity, operate effectively in a high-growth environment, and enjoy solving complex problems.

• The ideal candidate will bring strong regional sales leadership experience, including developing go-to-market strategies, launching new products, and scaling technology sales teams. They will be an excellent communicator with a deep understanding of the commercial and cultural dynamics of Iberia and Italy.

• You will represent Stripe across the broader Southern European ecosystem, building relationships with entrepreneurs, enterprises, financial institutions, fintechs, government agencies, and other key stakeholders. You will participate in industry events and continue to strengthen Stripe’s position as a thought leader throughout the region.

Responsibilities

• Recruit, develop, and lead Stripe’s sales organisation across Iberia and Italy.

• Help shape the long-term vision and strategy for Southern Europe, with a clear focus on performance against the key sales metrics that drive sustainable regional growth.

• Deliver targets by product, segment, and country across both new and existing users, supported by strong partnerships with product specialists, Professional Services, Engineering, Product, and Partnerships.

• Drive user adoption, ensuring that users go live and ramp quickly, achieve their business objectives, and realise the full value of Stripe’s platform.

• Build deep, trusted relationships with C-level executives at users and partners across the region, acting as a strategic adviser while strengthening Stripe’s community in Southern Europe.

• Lead with clarity and context, sharing insights and user feedback across the organisation and making a significant contribution to shaping Stripe’s product roadmaps.

• Develop market-specific strategies that reflect the distinct opportunities, competitive environments, and user needs of Iberia and Italy.

• Represent Stripe externally and raise its profile across the Southern European technology, financial services, and business communities.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 15+ years of technology sales experience, including 10+ years in sales leadership roles

• Second-line sales management experience

• Experience leading and managing a sales business in a high-growth financial services or technology environment, with a track record of consistently exceeding revenue and quota targets.

• Proven experience leading sales teams and driving growth across Southern Europe, Iberia, Italy, or a comparable multi-market EMEA region.

• Excellent operational skills, including reporting, forecasting, data analysis, and sales operations management.

• Demonstrated ability to recruit, develop, coach, and retain a high-performing sales team.

• Ability to support teams with strategic account guidance and serve as an executive sponsor for key user and partner relationships.

• Exceptional leadership and communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and build strong relationships with highly technical users.

• Experience bringing new products to market and developing effective regional go-to-market strategies.

• Demonstrated passion for scaling technology or payments businesses.

• Ability to lead effectively across different markets, cultures, and business environments.

• Professional proficiency in Spanish, in addition to English.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience in the payments, card issuing, spend management, financial services, or fintech sectors.

• Prior experience at a growth-stage payments, internet, or software company.

• Strong executive relationships and a well-established network across the Southern European business and technology ecosystem.

• Professional proficiency in Italian, in addition to English.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Veriff Network
jobs.description:
About Veriff
Veriff is building trust infrastructure for the internet. Our AI-powered identity verification and fraud prevention platform helps businesses across fintech, crypto, gaming, mobility and marketplaces know who their users are, and whether they can be trusted, in 230+ countries and territories. We build our own technology end to end, and every verification we run teaches us something about how fraud really works.

The role
Veriff sees fraud at a scale and breadth that no single platform can see on its own. Our job now is to turn that advantage into products customers can see, measure and act on, and to build the network that makes it compound.

As Lead Product Manager for Fraud on the Veriff Network team, you will make the fraud detection, prevention and accuracy strengths of our product legible to customers. You will own the concrete product experiences that do this, such as a Feedback API that lets customers tell us what happened after a decision, fraud insights inside Station (our customer portal), and automated fraud reporting. You will also lead the customer engagement that turns those experiences into a feedback loop: customers share outcomes and signals, our detection gets sharper, and every platform on the network benefits.

This is one of the first roles on the Veriff Network, and it directly shapes how we package, sell and grow our fraud offering.

What success looks like

In your first 90 days, you will have assessed our fraud product roadmap and packaging and agreed a revised version with product and fraud leadership. You will have identified the top three to five fraud product improvements, with the highest-priority items shaped and in development.

By six months, the first updated fraud product offering is live with a group of design and beta partners.

By nine to twelve months, a shared-signal pilot is running with a set of platforms, as the first step toward a cross-platform fraud network.

By twelve months, the improved fraud products are generally available and are measurably helping us attract and close deals with our core customer segments.

What you'll bring

• Fraud and risk expertise. You have shipped fraud or risk products, or you have been responsible for fighting fraud and managing risk at a scaled, digital-native company. You understand attack patterns, how fraud teams actually work day to day, and how the precision/recall trade-off plays out in the real world.

• Network product experience. You have worked on network-effect or marketplace data products, where aligning incentives between participants and building feedback loops are central to the product.

• Data and ML product craft. You can specify a signal, read a model evaluation, and ship and manage a rules engine. You know what to build yourself and what to leave to data science.

• Customer discovery with fraud teams. You can get fraud and trust leaders at platforms talking openly, and you turn what you learn into a clear roadmap.

Nice to have

• Experience building with operations teams. Our fraud operations experts are the source of truth on what fraud looks like in practice, and the right person turns their judgment into product. If you haven't worked closely with an operations team before, you'll need to show strong cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Commercial packaging. You have shaped how a product is priced and sold, and worked deals alongside Sales.

Why Veriff?

We are the preferred identity verification platform partner for the world’s most innovative growth-driven organizations helping conveniently verify and safeguard users anywhere in the world. We support the broadest number of identity documents from nearly every country and territory in the world - and this is continually increasing! With a diverse team in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, and Estonia, as well as robust backing and funding from investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, we’re dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer and more secure world. We strive to be the benchmark for trust online, and we take pride in being a positive force.When you join Team Veriff, we offer you the opportunity to have a real impact and advance your career whilst looking after you along the way with a range of benefits designed with you in mind. Some of our favourites include...

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
Wallapop is a Barcelona based scale-up driven by the purpose to empower people to embrace a more conscious and human way of consumption. We believe in a world where collaborative economy is mainstream. This is what drives us. 💫

Wallapop operates in Spain, Italy and Portugal, offering a catalogue of several hundreds of millions of products and services. Powered by technical innovation and continuous improvement, we bring together the scale & trust of classifieds with the marketplace’s convenience & reach. 🌱 Our mission is to enable a connected trade ecosystem, making 2nd-hand the norm through smart use of technology.

The Challenge 🧩

Drive long-term user value and sustainable business growth by shaping and executing the product strategy for some of Wallapop’s most complex, high-impact initiatives. You will leverage data, experimentation, technical collaboration, and deep user empathy to unlock new marketplace opportunities, elevate product craft, and deliver step-function improvements in user experience.

What You Will Do 👇

• Product Strategy & Vision: Define and execute a long-term product roadmap for high-impact marketplace initiatives, aligning product vision with company goals to drive meaningful user and business outcomes.

• End-to-End Delivery & Collaboration: Lead discovery, definition, and delivery across cross-functional squads (engineering, design, analytics, and business operations) to turn complex challenges into simple, delightful user journeys.

• Technical Collaboration: Partner with engineering leadership to ensure product architecture supports long-term scalability, advocating for foundational improvements that support platform stability and experimentation velocity.

• Experimentation & Insights: Combine quantitative analytics, experimentation (A/B testing), and direct user research to validate hypotheses and make high-confidence roadmap decisions.

• Stakeholder Alignment: Communicate strategic trade-offs, roadmap priorities, and vision clearly across executive leadership and cross-functional teams to build alignment and shared momentum.

• Product Craft & Mentorship: Elevate product management standards across the chapter through active coaching, shared best practices, and collaborative knowledge-sharing.

What We’re Looking For 🔎

• Proven track record of defining product strategy and delivering measurable business outcomes (e.g., conversion improvement, user retention, revenue growth, or marketplace liquidity).

• Ability to collaborate closely with engineering teams on architecture, API integrations, and data flows, effectively balancing immediate delivery with long-term technical health.

• Competence in utilizing quantitative data, self-serve analytics, and user research to build structured, evidence-based business cases and product roadmaps.

• Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize high-leverage opportunities, and advocate for user-centric product decisions in complex organizational environments.

• Full professional working proficiency in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences. Spanish is a plus.

What Would Be A Plus 🚀

•
Experience integrating emerging technologies (such as LLMs or automation tools) into consumer products or internal workflows to improve user experience and team velocity.

•
Prior experience in two-sided marketplaces, e-commerce, or consumer tech platforms

Do note that all our jobs are 📍 Barcelona based. We follow a hybrid model where flexibility rules. We commit to a minimum of 6 days per month in the office. Each team self-organizes to decide on cadence and in-person/remote rituals.

Wallapop is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees as we want Wallapop to be a place for everyone.

We sponsor visa processes for international candidates when applicable and provide legal & admin support along the process combined with a competitive relocation package.

Additionally to the opportunity to contribute to an agile product set up and work together towards achieving our meaningful mission, we offer the following 🍭 Perks & Benefits :

• Generous individual learning budget of 2k per year

• Free office meals, lunch selection from different providers

• Group and individual English, Catalan & Spanish lessons as part of our working day

• Private Health Insurance with Alan

• Flexible working hours + Intensive Fridays

• Flexible remuneration to deduct from gross salary (kindergarten/food/transport check)

• Gym & Wellness plan, including physiotherapist in the office

• Generous referral Program & Charity Donation

• Bonus for weddings & newborns

• Wallapop Renta (Tax income support)

• Monthly product advantages (Wallapop Club)

• Work anniversary Gifts and Birthday Surprises

• Contribution towards your WIFI in your monthly payroll

• One-off payment based on compensation package to go towards setting up your home office

• Relocation package (monetary support and legal advice) and visa sponsorship, if applicable

• 26 holidays per year

• TOP hardware of your choice (latest Apple or Windows)

What does the hiring process for this position look like? 👀 **Please, note that all interviews take place remotely over hangouts.**

Intro Call - run by talent acquisition, focus on providing more information about the role and the company as well as going over your experience, motivation, and expectations. This usually takes 45-60 minutes.

Hiring manager call: run by the HM to asses basic fit with the role. This usually takes 30-45 minutes.

Case Study preparation - you will be assigned a task to discuss during the case study interview for the role.

Live Case study Interview - run by the hiring team, focus on the required core skills and the ability to deliver in a given context. This usually takes 60 minutes.

Stakeholder Interview - run by relevant stakeholders reflecting the reality of the context of the role, focus on the ability to collaborate & deliver in a cross-functional set-up. This usually takes 60 minutes.

Culture Interview - run by culture interviewers, focus on adherence to Wallapop's purpose and business proposition. This usually takes 60 minutes.

Offer - should you be the right candidate, your offer will be discussed over a call with talent acquisition and will then be confirmed in writing.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Platform & Ecosystem
jobs.description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

About the Role:

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike’s Work Intelligence Unit is building the foundation for a work delivery platform for humans and agents. MCP gives AI assistants secure, permission-aware access to Wrike, Skills help them use that access effectively and GraphQL provides a structured foundation for retrieving and acting on work data.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the product direction for Wrike’s AI Platform & Ecosystem, including MCP, Skills and GraphQL. You will make Wrike easier for AI assistants and agents to understand, use and extend.

This is a platform role with broad leverage. You will lead the core MCP team, help other Wrike teams create their own MCP tools and Skills where they hold domain expertise and give the GraphQL engineering team clear product direction on how its capabilities and tools should evolve. You will also own the publishing and ongoing quality of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant AI marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.

Role Scope:

You will own the strategy and roadmap for Wrike’s agent-facing platform, working closely with the core MCP and GraphQL engineering teams complemented by Architecture, Security, customer-facing and product teams across Wrike.

MCP, Skills and GraphQL Strategy:

• Lead the core MCP team and define the roadmap for how external AI assistants and agents securely interact with Wrike.

• Define MCP standards and enable other Wrike teams to create high-quality tools for the domains where they have expertise.

• Lead the discovery and creation of Skills that help agents and AI assistants use Wrike effectively, while establishing standards that other teams can follow.

• Set the product direction for GraphQL and the tools built on top of it, ensuring its evolution improves the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core.

Ecosystem, Quality and Distribution:

• Own the publishing, maintenance and evolution of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.

• Create a clear approach to MCP quality, reliability, governance, documentation and developer experience.

• Work with customers, partners and internal teams to identify the highest-value agent workflows and improve them through feedback and usage data.

• Translate technical trade-offs into clear product decisions; hands-on coding is not required.

• A scalable MCP and Skills ecosystem that lets AI assistants and agents securely understand and act on work in Wrike, while enabling Wrike teams to contribute their domain expertise.

• GraphQL capabilities and tools that broaden the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core for MCP, Skills, and future agent experiences.

• A strong marketplace presence and high-quality plugin experience across the AI assistants where customers want to use Wrike.

Your Impact:

• Make Wrike a trusted, useful system of action for AI assistants and agents working across customers’ existing ecosystems.

• Give customers reliable, permission-aware ways to let AI assistants retrieve context and take action in Wrike.

• Turn customer needs, ecosystem signals and technical constraints into a focused roadmap for MCP, Skills and GraphQL.

• Enable other teams across Wrike to contribute agent-ready tools and Skills while maintaining shared standards for quality and governance.

• 5+ years of PM experience in technical, platform, AI, developer, or enterprise software.

• Experience with MCP and Skills, including how agents use tools and guidance to act effectively.

• Technical fluency in AI agents, MCP, Skills, permissions, reliability, and developer experience; hands-on engineering is not required. GraphQL experience and an understanding of structured product data is a major advantage.

• Use customer research, adoption data, experiments, and feedback to set priorities and improve outcomes.

• Explain complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.

• Proactive and can-do: take ownership, solve problems, and adapt as you learn.

Why This Role Is Unique:

• You will help define how Wrike becomes a trusted platform for AI assistants and agents, not just a destination where work is stored.

• You will work at the intersection of agentic AI, developer experience, enterprise permissions, platform strategy and customer value.

• The role is remote across the European Union, with a preference for Prague, Czech Republic and Cyprus.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Nucs AI
Nucs AI is revolutionizing cancer care through cutting-edge AI and medical imaging technology. Founded in 2024 by a multidisciplinary team of oncologists, AI researchers, and healthcare innovators, we’re tackling one of medicine’s most pressing challenges: the growing demand for accurate, timely cancer diagnostics in the face of rising scan volumes and limited radiologist capacity.
We sit at the intersection of diagnostics and treatment planning—building AI-powered tools at the convergence of medical imaging, radioligand therapy, and artificial intelligence. Starting with prostate cancer and expanding across oncology, we partner with world-leading medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies across the US, Europe, and Australia to bring precision oncology into everyday clinical practice.
Our mission is to enhance diagnostic precision and expand access to expert-level cancer care, improving patient outcomes worldwide. We’re venture-backed, early-stage, and building a team that blends deep clinical expertise with engineering intensity—moving with the rigor the medical field demands and the speed the problem deserves.

The Opportunity
Nucs AI is looking for a Senior Product Manager who thrives at the intersection of complex technology and specialized end-users. You will own critical parts of our product roadmap, translating deep clinical and technical requirements into clear product direction, then driving execution across data, engineering, regulatory, and commercial areas. This is not a role where you manage a feature backlog in isolation; you will be expected to build conviction around what we should build, why, and in what order, and to defend that thinking rigorously.

What You’ll Do
Product Development Support

• Own the roadmap for one or more product lines (e.g., DeepPSMA, SelectPSMA, TrackPSMA), balancing clinical impact, technical feasibility, and business value.

• Engage directly with clinicians, nuclear medicine physicians, and oncologists to deeply understand their workflows, pain points, and decision-making processes.

• Translate ambiguous, technically complex problems into well-structured product requirements and clear success criteria.

• Develop and articulate a clear product narrative: why this feature matters, who it serves, and how it connects to the broader platform vision.

• Navigate the regulatory landscape (FDA, CE marking) as a stakeholder, you do not need to be a regulatory expert, but you must understand how regulatory requirements shape product decisions and timelines.

Cross-Functional Coordination

• Drive cross-functional execution with engineering, AI/ML, clinical, regulatory, and commercial stakeholders, keeping a small team moving fast without sacrificing quality.

• Contribute to go-to-market strategy, positioning, and customer enablement alongside commercial and clinical teams.

Analytics & Insights

• Define and track meaningful product metrics; use data and user feedback to inform iteration and prioritization decisions.

What You Bring

• 3-6 years of product management experience in a B2B or technical environment building products for specialized, professional users (not purely consumer products).

• Demonstrated ability to manage complex products where the user base has deep domain expertise, e.g., enterprise software, developer tools, scientific instruments, industrial platforms, or similar.

• Strong conceptual and systems thinking. You can see the big picture, connect disparate inputs into a coherent product thesis, and reason about second-order effects. You don't just execute, you think.

• Startup or high-growth experience. You have worked in an environment where speed, ambiguity, and wearing multiple hats were the norm, not the exception.

• Excellent communication skills. You can write clearly, present a compelling argument, and facilitate productive discussions with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Comfort with technical depth. You do not need to write code, but you should be able to engage meaningfully with engineers and data scientists on architecture, data, and tradeoff discussions.

• Intellectual curiosity and learning agility. You pick up new domains quickly and enjoy becoming a quasi-expert in areas you previously knew nothing about.

• Fluency in English (native or professional proficiency required - C1 level or higher)

Bonus Points

• Experience in healthcare, medtech, health-AI, or a regulated industry.

• Familiarity with medical imaging, oncology workflows, or clinical decision support.

• Experience working with AI/ML-driven products where model behavior shapes the user experience.

• Exposure to FDA 510(k), De Novo, or CE marking processes for software as a medical device (SaMD).

Why Nucs AI

• Mission with real impact – Your work directly improves how cancer patients are diagnosed and treated.

• Ground-floor opportunity – Early-stage company, meaningful equity, and outsized influence on the direction we take.

• World-class collaborators – Work alongside leading oncologists, nuclear medicine physicians, and AI researchers globally.

• Massive market tailwinds – Radioligand therapy and AI-driven oncology are multi-billion dollar growth markets.

• Autonomy and flexibility – Remote-first, flexible working. We hire great people and trust them to deliver.

• Equity upside – Competitive equity package. We’re building something big and want you to share in it.

How to Apply
Submit your resume and a brief note on why this role and Nucs AI excite you.

Equal Opportunity
Nucs AI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Fully remote (EU timezone preferred) · Reports to Crypto Exchange CEO (interim: Group CEO) · Owns the growth function end-to-end
The liquidity problem is already solved — what doesn't exist yet is the growth playbook, and this role owns it from day one.
Most exchange growth mandates ask you to spend your first year chasing liquidity, convincing partners the product is real, and waiting for infrastructure to catch up to your ambitions. This one is different. CXM Group's retail centralised exchange is already live. Liquidity is sourced via prime exchanges. An established IB (Introducing Broker, aka KOL in crypto world) network — built through the group's existing multi-asset broker business — is primed for crypto activation. The blank sheet isn't the product. It's the acquisition playbook, and that's yours to write.
The primary bet is declared: IB-referred spot and perps trading as the lead acquisition channel, with CFD client conversion as a second-phase lever once the flywheel is turning. Your mandate is to confirm that hypothesis — through structured pilots with real stopping rules — or replace it. If it holds, you scale. Either way, you make the call on data.
This is a hands-on distribution role at the strategic level. In the early phase, you personally close the anchor IB relationships that validate the referral model. You equip country managers to activate their markets. You translate what IBs and customers are actually responding to — fee sensitivity, onboarding friction, product gaps — into clean demand signal for the CEO's roadmap decisions. The upside is tied directly to exchange growth performance.
Why this beats the seat you're in now

• You inherit the starting line most growth leads spend a year reaching. Live product, sourced liquidity, a warm IB network — the infrastructure problems are solved before you arrive.
- The hypothesis is declared, not vague. You're not walking into "figure out growth." You're validating a specific channel bet, with a clear timeline and the authority to kill it if the data says to.
- The distribution network is warm, not cold. Existing IBs already have relationships with CXM Group. Crypto activation is an extension, not a cold start.
- A CFD conversion pool you don't have to build. An established base of CFD traders with natural appetite for spot and perps exists as a Phase 2 channel — ready when the primary flywheel is turning.
- Downside capped by group infrastructure. You operate under the regulatory, operational, and financial umbrella of an established multi-asset group. The execution risk is yours; the existential risk is not.
- Compensation reflects the upside. Base salary, profit share tied directly to CEX growth performance, and a cross-referral incentive for directing clients across CXM Group divisions.

This is for you if

• You've personally built or activated an IB or partner network — not inherited one — and you've closed the anchor relationships that made it move.
- You've run structured acquisition pilots with real hypotheses and real stopping rules, and you're comfortable being the one who kills a bet, including your own.
- You understand CEX mechanics — spot, perps, order book, onboarding economics — well enough to translate IB and customer feedback into product input without a translator.
- You're currently a VP or Head of Growth, Partnerships, or IB Networks at a retail CEX, forex, or CFD platform and you've outgrown what the role can actually give you.
- You can drive outcomes in a structure where you own the growth motion but not the P&L — and you know the difference between noise and a clean signal worth escalating to a CEO.
- You want a seat close enough to the top that your judgment shapes the business, not just your team's targets.

Your first year
The first phase is immediate and personal. You identify and close the anchor IB partners whose activation sets the standard for everything that follows — this is hands-on relationship work, not delegation. In parallel, you equip country managers with the tools, commission structures, and product knowledge to run activation in their markets. By Q4 2026, you've run a structured pilot programme, read the cohort data, and made a clear call: the primary channel hypothesis holds and you shift to scale mode, or it doesn't and you redirect resources. Either outcome moves the business forward. If the hypothesis is confirmed, Phase 2 opens: activating the existing CFD client base as a conversion channel into spot and perps, with the IB infrastructure already beneath it. Throughout, you're the demand-signal function for the CEO — translating what the market is actually telling you into decisions about fees, product, and sequencing.
The ask
If this is the mandate you've been waiting for, tell us in a few lines: what's the first thing you'd want to know about the existing IB network before deciding how to activate it?

jobs.description:

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The Role

As Senior Product Manager, User Acquisition, you'll explore an important extension of how RevenueCat helps developers grow: helping them not just monetize the users they have, but acquire more of the right users in the first place.

RevenueCat already has several footholds in user acquisition, including our Apple Ads integration and integrations across the attribution and MMP ecosystem. But we're still early in defining what a broader RevenueCat user acquisition product should become. You'll be the first dedicated product hire focused on this space, reporting directly to our product lead for Ads, with significant latitude to shape both the strategy and the products we build.

This is a genuine zero-to-one role. You won't inherit a predetermined roadmap. Your job will be to deeply understand how app developers acquire users today, identify where RevenueCat has an opportunity to solve problems meaningfully better, and turn those insights into products we can test, ship, and scale.

You'll bring real expertise in mobile performance marketing and user acquisition to that process. The opportunity could eventually span attribution and measurement, products built on top of existing acquisition channels, new ways to optimize spend using downstream monetization data, partnerships, advertising infrastructure, or things we haven't considered yet. We have hypotheses, but we're hiring you in part because we want your perspective on which ones are worth pursuing.

You thrive in zero-to-one environments. You can take a large, ambiguous opportunity, identify the most important unanswered questions, narrow it into product bets, and find pragmatic ways to test those bets before making large investments.

•
You are sufficiently technical to work closely with engineering on integrations, APIs, SDKs, data flows, identity, attribution, and other technical product decisions.

•
You communicate clearly across different audiences and media, particularly in writing.

In the first month, you'll:

•
Spend significant time with developers understanding how they acquire users today, how they evaluate acquisition performance, and where the process is painful, expensive, fragmented, or opaque.

•
Build a deep understanding of RevenueCat's existing acquisition-related products, integrations, data, customer research, and technical capabilities.

•
Build strong working relationships with engineering, design, data, go-to-market, and other product teams whose work intersects with user acquisition.

•

•
Begin forming your own point of view on where RevenueCat could create differentiated value in user acquisition.

•

•
Have a clear recommendation for where we should focus first — and why.

•
Begin validating that direction through prototypes, design partners, technical exploration, lightweight product experiments, or an initial shippable bet.

•
Establish a learning agenda that makes the biggest risks and unanswered questions explicit, and gives us a fast path to increasing or decreasing our conviction.

•
Align senior stakeholders around what we're testing, what we're not pursuing yet, and what evidence would cause us to change direction.

Within the first 6 months, you'll:

•
Have shipped our first substantive user acquisition product bet, or generated enough evidence to decisively change or stop it before making a larger investment.

•
Have turned a broad strategic opportunity into an increasingly focused product direction.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Realtime
jobs.description:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We're hiring a Product Manager for Supabase Realtime . You'll own the surface area developers use to build live, collaborative and event-driven apps on Supabase: Broadcast , Presence , Postgres Changes , and the capabilities we build next.

You'll work closely with the Realtime Engineering team and with partners across Product Management, Design and GTM.

This role is ideal for someone who's excited about building tools for millions of developers and who has a passion for the types of user experiences unlocked by simple, scalable real-time channels. You should have a nuanced understanding of full-stack application development, including existing and emerging real-time and sync patterns.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

•
You'll collaborate with customers of all sizes and expertise levels: from an indie developer adding live updates to a side project, to startups building collaborative SaaS, to enterprise teams streaming live data to dashboards.

•
You'll own the problem statements and solution rationale behind the Realtime roadmap. This means working with Engineering and Design to shape how Supabase crafts the developer experience for the problems you’ve prioritized solving.

•
You'll shape how Realtime evolves to enable future application experiences , including its role in AI apps and alongside other Supabase products.

•
You'll own Realtime packaging and pricing , working with Pricing, Finance and Billing.

•
You'll use data to understand how Supabase developers are using Realtime features : where they succeed, where they get stuck, and what to tackle first.

•
You'll keep Engineering, Design and GTM aligned. You'll own the plan of record for what's coming, why, and in what order.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

Must have

•
5+ years of Product Management experience on developer tools, or are an ex-founder with equivalent depth. You're comfortable commenting on an architecture doc, following a design discussion, and advocating for the user when trade-offs are required.

•
Have owned an app development platform, feature or framework where real-time was core to the developer experience.

•
Get your own answers from data. You know what you care about in terms of product instrumentation and are comfortable querying and cleaning your own findings.

•
Are comfortable with Postgres and familiar with logical replication.

•
Work async by default. Supabase is fully remote. You make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings.

Strong signal

•
You have an existing audience among developers, through social media, open source or developer advocacy.

•
Worked on a sync engine, local-first or live-query product.

•
Worked with gaming, AR or collaborative-tool customers.

•
Shipped something using Supabase.

What We Offer

•
Fully Remote

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

•
ESOP

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

•
Tech Allowance

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

•
Health Benefits

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

•
Annual Off-Sites

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

•
Flexible Work

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

•
Professional Development

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

•
~400 team members

•
60+ countries

•
20+ languages spoken

•
Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

•
540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.
