jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

What you'll be doing

•
Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

•
Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

•
Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

•
Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

•
Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

•
Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

•
Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

What you'll need

•
Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

•
Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

•
Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

•
AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

•
Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcomes

•
Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

•
Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

•
Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

•
AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

•
Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

•
Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Spain . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Spain .

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Security
jobs.description:
About Nebius :

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a Security Product Manager to join our team. Security Product Manager is responsible for conveying the company’s security strengths to customers, partners and the market at large. This includes participating in relevant security partnership initiatives, influencing security positioning and branding, and working closely with internal teams to ensure company’s security posture and security products is communicated effectively to all stakeholders. By combining expertise in compliance requirements with a customer-centric approach, Security Product Manager helps position security as a competitive advantage rather than just an internal obligation.

Your responsibilities will include:

1. Product Management

• Define the vision and roadmap for Nebius’ security products.

• Owning the ideation, postmortem, prioritization, backlog, and customer feedback processes.

• Guiding new features, systems and services from inception to launch, while keeping customers at the center of everything.

2. Customer-facing communications

• Lead public-facing communications around security updates or changes in compliance status.

• In the event of a security incident, coordinate user messaging (email notifications, press releases, FAQs) with support from the Head of Security Products and CISO.

• Gather user feedback on user experience and security to guide continuous improvements.

3. Competitive analysis and market research

• Conduct ongoing research on industry benchmarks, emerging security standards and technologies, and competitor certifications.

• Identify gaps and opportunities in organization’s product security posture; propose strategic initiatives that differentiate the company’s security story in the market.

• Stay informed about new regulations or frameworks that may influence future product certifications or transparency requirements (e.g., privacy laws, data sovereignty standards).

4. Certification and audit support, service ownership

• Collaborate with the CISO office to gather technical evidence or make necessary product enhancements that satisfy certification requirements.

• Take ownership of some security-related services of Cloud platform.

• Track and maintain a certification roadmap (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPPA, etc.), working closely with CISO, GRC & Compliance, Corporate Security departments. Communicate timelines, goals and status updates to leadership and sales representatives.

5. Cross-functional collaboration

• Coordinate with multiple Product Managers to align security goals with other product roadmaps, ensuring a consistent narrative between product security and external messaging.

• Work with Platform Security, GRC & Corporate Security and legal teams to gather essential information for security products enhancements (e.g., penetration test summaries, compliance reports).

• Work with Customer-facing teams to address client inquiries about security posture and guide them on using security features optimally.

We expect you to have:

• 3+ years of Product Management or Program Management experience with a focus on security initiatives.

• Basic knowledge of compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) and familiarity with how they translate into business value.

• Proven ability to communicate technical concepts in a clear, customer-friendly manner (e.g., writing content, speaking at webinars or conferences).

• Stakeholder management skills to align with other Product Managers, CISO staff, engineering, marketing, and customer-facing teams.

• Analytical mindset: comfortable defining success metrics (e.g., security feature adoption, NPS around trust, certification progress) and making data-driven decisions.

• Project management skills: demonstrated ability to manage inter-team collaboration within company-wide projects, ensuring timely delivery of cross-functional tasks and alignment with compliance goals.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

• Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or PMP; prior experience in regulated industries; prior experience working for Cloud Service Provider.

About Nebius

Nebius AI is an AI cloud platform with one of the largest GPU capacities in Europe. Launched in November 2023, the Nebius AI platform provides high-end, training-optimized infrastructure for AI practitioners. As an NVIDIA preferred cloud service provider, Nebius AI offers a variety of NVIDIA GPUs for training and inference, as well as a set of tools for efficient multi-node training.

Nebius AI owns a data center in Finland, built from the ground up by the company’s R&D team and showcasing our commitment to sustainability. The data center is home to ISEG, the most powerful commercially available supercomputer in Europe and the 16th most powerful globally (Top 500 list, November 2023).

Nebius’s headquarters are in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with teams working out of R&D hubs across Europe and the Middle East.

Nebius AI is built with the talent of more than 500 highly skilled engineers with a proven track record in developing sophisticated cloud and ML solutions and designing cutting-edge hardware. This allows all the layers of the Nebius AI cloud – from hardware to UI – to be built in-house, distictly differentiating Nebius AI from the majority of specialized clouds: Nebius customers get a true hyperscaler-cloud experience tailored for AI practitioners. We’re growing and expanding our products every day.

If you’re up to the challenge and are excited about AI and ML as much as we are, join us!

Benefits & Perks:

• Competitive compensation

• Career growth and learning opportunities

• Flexibility and ownership

• Collaborative and innovative culture

• Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

• International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (R14206)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote - India

Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

Location Note

We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, the role must be performed from within India.

The Opportunity

Oportun is seeking a talented, customer-focused, and analytical Senior Product Manager to join the Servicing & Payments team. You will help create a trusted post-disbursement experience that strengthens members' confidence in Oportun, supports their financial health, and encourages continued engagement and repeat member behavior.

You will define product strategy, set measurable objectives and key results, create outcome-oriented roadmaps, and partner with engineering, design, data, operations, risk, compliance, and other teams to deliver reliable, scalable solutions. You will help make repayment easy, intelligent, successful, and accurately reflected for lending members.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

• You'll define and execute product strategy and roadmaps that improve repayment outcomes, member trust, and repeat engagement.

• You'll own initiatives end to end - from discovery and requirements through delivery, measurement, and iteration.

• You'll create simple, transparent, and reliable servicing and payment experiences across self-service and assisted channels.

• You'll use member insights, data, and experimentation to improve payer rate, payment success, DQ prevention, and lending-member NPS.

• You'll lead cross-functional delivery with engineering, design, data, operations, risk, compliance, legal, and finance.

• You'll communicate product strategy, trade-offs, progress, and measurable business impact to senior stakeholders.

• You'll bring ideas for how we can do things better - proactively, not just when asked.

• You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully - to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster.

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You're customer-focused and analytical, with a track record of navigating complex problems and turning member needs and data into practical product decisions. You're collaborative, communicate clearly, and build consensus across a wide range of cross-functional partners.

You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

• You'll have 5+ years of product management experience in high-growth environments.

• You've demonstrated experience partnering with business executives and cross-functional teams across compliance, risk, operations, fraud, technology, business intelligence, finance, training, legal, and cybersecurity.

• You bring strong analytical problem-solving skills, including experience with data-informed decision making, testing and experimentation, metric definition, and data analysis.

• You've demonstrated a track record of shipping and iterating on impactful products while building consensus across a broad group of cross-functional partners.

• You bring strong product execution skills and the ability to help teams push through obstacles and blockers to deliver value for members.

• You communicate clearly and concisely and have strong documentation skills.

Nice to Have

• Experience launching products within complex legal and regulatory frameworks, including financial services.

• Experience with SQL.

• Experience working with a multinational workforce.

• You've used AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to improve your own productivity.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

WORKING AT OPORTUN

What's in it for you

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.

Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include:

India Benefits:

• Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance;

• Provident Fund; Life & Accident Insurance;

• Internet, Fuel, Meal & Telephone Allowances.

This is a summary of select benefits and does not represent the full benefits package. Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers
We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ .

We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Platform & Ecosystem
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Cyprus - Remote

Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

About the Role:

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike’s Work Intelligence Unit is building the foundation for a work delivery platform for humans and agents. MCP gives AI assistants secure, permission-aware access to Wrike, Skills help them use that access effectively and GraphQL provides a structured foundation for retrieving and acting on work data.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the product direction for Wrike’s AI Platform & Ecosystem, including MCP, Skills and GraphQL. You will make Wrike easier for AI assistants and agents to understand, use and extend.

This is a platform role with broad leverage. You will lead the core MCP team, help other Wrike teams create their own MCP tools and Skills where they hold domain expertise and give the GraphQL engineering team clear product direction on how its capabilities and tools should evolve. You will also own the publishing and ongoing quality of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant AI marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.

Role Scope:

You will own the strategy and roadmap for Wrike’s agent-facing platform, working closely with the core MCP and GraphQL engineering teams complemented by Architecture, Security, customer-facing and product teams across Wrike.

MCP, Skills and GraphQL Strategy:

• Lead the core MCP team and define the roadmap for how external AI assistants and agents securely interact with Wrike.

• Define MCP standards and enable other Wrike teams to create high-quality tools for the domains where they have expertise.

• Lead the discovery and creation of Skills that help agents and AI assistants use Wrike effectively, while establishing standards that other teams can follow.

• Set the product direction for GraphQL and the tools built on top of it, ensuring its evolution improves the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core.

Ecosystem, Quality and Distribution:

• Own the publishing, maintenance and evolution of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.

• Create a clear approach to MCP quality, reliability, governance, documentation and developer experience.

• Work with customers, partners and internal teams to identify the highest-value agent workflows and improve them through feedback and usage data.

• Translate technical trade-offs into clear product decisions; hands-on coding is not required.

What You Will Help Shape:

• A scalable MCP and Skills ecosystem that lets AI assistants and agents securely understand and act on work in Wrike, while enabling Wrike teams to contribute their domain expertise.

• GraphQL capabilities and tools that broaden the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core for MCP, Skills, and future agent experiences.

• A strong marketplace presence and high-quality plugin experience across the AI assistants where customers want to use Wrike.

Your Impact:

• Make Wrike a trusted, useful system of action for AI assistants and agents working across customers’ existing ecosystems.

• Give customers reliable, permission-aware ways to let AI assistants retrieve context and take action in Wrike.

• Turn customer needs, ecosystem signals and technical constraints into a focused roadmap for MCP, Skills and GraphQL.

• Enable other teams across Wrike to contribute agent-ready tools and Skills while maintaining shared standards for quality and governance.

Your Qualifications:

• 5+ years of PM experience in technical, platform, AI, developer, or enterprise software.

• Experience with MCP and Skills, including how agents use tools and guidance to act effectively.

• Technical fluency in AI agents, MCP, Skills, permissions, reliability, and developer experience; hands-on engineering is not required. GraphQL experience and an understanding of structured product data is a major advantage.

• Use customer research, adoption data, experiments, and feedback to set priorities and improve outcomes.

• Explain complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.

• Proactive and can-do: take ownership, solve problems, and adapt as you learn.

Why This Role Is Unique:

• You will help define how Wrike becomes a trusted platform for AI assistants and agents, not just a destination where work is stored.

• You will work at the intersection of agentic AI, developer experience, enterprise permissions, platform strategy and customer value.

• The role is remote across the European Union, with a preference for Prague, Czech Republic and Cyprus.

What’s Next?

• Introduction Call with a Recruiter

• Conversation with the AI Product Director

• Interview with Product and Engineering, Architecture representatives

• Final interview with CPO and HRBP

Benefits & Perks:

• 25 working days of paid vacation

• Sick Leave Compensation (5 Uncertified + 10 Certified Days)

• Parental Leave: Fully Paid Maternity / 4 Weeks Paid Paternity

• 2 Volunteer Days

• Medical Insurance (Employees + Dependents)

• Life Insurance (Employees)

• Provident Fund

• Hybrid Working Model

• School Allowance (Up to €600/month for school aged kids)

• Simcard w/ Unlimited Internet Access for active employees

• Office Lunch Allowance (via Wolt) on Wednesdays / Thursdays

• Work Permit, Blue Card & Naturalization Support

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova , Lead Recruiter.

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

Hybrid work mode

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Greece

URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/ssarktiaEdEzba97Jjs1YN/jobs-at-patchstack

Overview
Patchstack protects WordPress sites for hosts, agencies and developers, and we're now launching a security product for people building JavaScript apps with AI tools like Claude Code. That product is early. We have good signals from hosts and hackathons, but we haven't yet found who it serves best, what they value, or why they'll keep paying for it.
You'll be the product manager who finds that out. You'll talk to customers, use the product in real AI-assisted workflows, test ideas quickly with our designer and engineers, and build the measurement that tells us what's working. You'll work alongside two small engineering squads, a senior product designer, QA and infrastructure. You own which customer problems we invest in and how we learn from the results.
About you
You're happiest early, before the answers exist. You'd rather run a small test this week than wait for perfect data. You're comfortable in a terminal and have built things with AI-assisted tools, so you can use our product the way our customers do. You form your own view on technical claims rather than taking "it's not feasible" or "the metric improved" at face value. You say what you think, including when it's awkward, and you change your mind when the evidence says so. You work well in a flat team with little process, and you help people around you get better rather than taking work off them.
This is a fully remote job, based anywhere in Europe.
Responsibilities

• Run customer discovery for the JavaScript product: interviews, observed usage, support and event feedback, and your own hands-on use.

• With Growth and Product Marketing, recommend which customers and problems to focus on, backed by evidence of who uses, who pays and why.

• Shape what we build with the Senior Product Designer from early discovery through testing. You own the problem and intended outcome; they own the design response.

• Agree outcomes and priorities with the engineering squads and help them turn validated problems into work. Squads own delivery.

• Build and ship small prototypes, experiments and product changes yourself where that's the fastest way to learn, within our review and QA process.

• Own product measurement in PostHog: define the actions that matter, get tracking in place, and combine the numbers with customer evidence to explain what's working.

• Keep what we've learned, decided and assumed visible in Notion so the team can make good investment calls.

• Raise risks, gaps and decisions early, and escalate anything beyond your remit.

• Experience as a product manager on a technical or developer-facing product, ideally pre or early product-market fit.

• Examples of changing or stopping a product direction based on customer and technical evidence you gathered yourself.

• Hands-on with AI-assisted development, the command line, packages and dependencies. You don't need to be a production engineer, but you need to be at home in that environment.

• Strong customer research and data analysis skills, including building useful measurement from little reliable data.

• Clear, direct communication with designers, engineers and leadership in a remote, low-process team.

• €75–100k salary, depending on location and experience, plus company stock options

• 4.5-day working week (half-day Fridays)

• Remote-first, with reasonable overlap with EU timezones

• 38 days' paid time off a year (including public holidays) plus 3 health days

• Company laptop, and co-working membership or home-office equipment

• AI tooling budget

• Quarterly health and wellness allowance

• Travel for conferences, events and our annual company meetup

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/patchstack-senior-product-manager

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Australia

URL: https://zandahealth.com/eu/

Product Owner

Remote | Permanent Contractor | Core EU Collaboration Hours
Reports to: Product Manager

Are you a product driven problem solver who enjoys turning customer insight into things that actually get built? Do you love turning complexity into clarity, aligning teams, and shaping product experiences that genuinely make people’s lives easier? If so, we’d love to meet you!

We build software that takes the stress, chaos, and friction out of managing a health practice. As our newest Product Owner, you’ll play a pivotal role in translating vision into action, turning customer needs into features and driving product outcomes that truly matter.

You’re someone on the rise - intelligent, opinionated (in the best way), and ready to make an impact. You’re not easily swayed, and you’re happy to take a stand when it serves the customer and the product. You connect dots, ask great questions, and care deeply about delivering value. If that sounds like you… read on!

You’re Excited To

•
Be the voice of the customer; advocate for user needs and pain points.

•
Maintain deep customer understanding and share insights with key teams.

•
Translate product priorities into clear, prioritised & actionable items for your team

•
Work closely with engineering to understand constraints, dependencies, and system behaviour

•
Build alignment, trust and collaborate seamlessly across Product, Engineering, and Customer Support

•
Ensure continuous delivery of value; own the lifecycle from discovery to post-launch iteration.

•
Guide product decisions that make a real difference for the people using Zanda every day

•
Communicate clearly across async and real-time channels.

•
Surface risks early and drive grounded, data-informed decisions.

•
Contribute to risk-based analysis of product changes and support identification of potential vulnerabilities

What You Bring to the Team

Experience

•
2+ years of hands-on product ownership experience (SaaS experience an asset)

•
Proven ability to translate customer pains into clear requirements and impactful improvements

•
Strong understanding of agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and product development architecture

•
Experience in another role before moving into product - a Customer Success, Support, or similar background is a real plus

•
Demonstrated experience working with remote, cross-cultural teams across multiple time zones

Skills

•
Customer Insight & Discovery - understands user needs, pain points, and motivations.

•
Strategic Thinking - connects decisions in your product area to customer needs and team priorities

•
Data-Informed Decision Making - uses data to guide choices, even with ambiguity.

•
Clear & Adaptive Communication - complex to simple, and with the audience in mind.

•
Cross-Functional Collaboration - works effectively across teams and builds influence through trust, not title.

•
Prioritisation - confidently prioritises what drives the most impact and eliminates noise.

•
Technical Fluency - understands enough to engage meaningfully with engineering.

•
Risk Identification & Mitigation - surfaces risks early and makes grounded decisions.

•
Problem Solving & Critical Thinking - breaks down complexity into clear, actionable steps.

Traits

•
High Ownership Mindset - proactive and treats the product like a business.

•
Collaborative & Empathetic - builds trust quickly and embraces diverse perspectives.

•
Calm Under Pressure - steady when navigating competing priorities or ambiguity.

•
Adaptable & Curious - thrives in fast-changing environments, shows interest in emerging technologies - particularly AI and automation.

•
Integrity-Driven - transparent, reliable, and grounded in facts, not ego.

•
Opinionated (in the right ways) – advocates confidently for what's right for the customer, and isn't easily swayed.

•
Energetic & Self-Starter - brings momentum, enthusiasm, and a bias for action.

•
Strategic Yet Practical - able to zoom out and zoom in fluidly.

•
Growth Oriented - desire to grow, stretch, take on more responsibility, and help influence direction.

•
Customer-Obsessed - curious, empathetic, and motivated to solve real user problems.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

✅ Work from Anywhere
We’ve been a fully distributed team from the start - no offices, no commute, just great people from all over the world doing meaningful work together.
✅ Flexibility & Autonomy
We care about outcomes, not clock-watching. Outside of agreed core hours that align to your role, your time is yours - whether that’s doing the school run or squeezing in a midday gym class.
✅ Generous Paid Time Off
Balance matters. We offer paid time off and expect you to take it - because rest fuels great work.
✅ High Trust, Results Driven
We strip away red tape so you can focus on impact. No pointless meetings or rigid hierarchies - just space to move fast, solve problems, and make a difference.
✅ Growth & Innovation
You’ll be encouraged to experiment, stretch your skills, and bring YOUR bold ideas to the table. Everyone at Zanda contributes to shaping what’s next.
✅ Inspiring Teammates
You’ll work alongside passionate, curious people who support and cheer each other on - even across time zones. Collaboration is how we win.
✅ Meaningful Impact
Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients. Your work will directly improve lives.
✅ Competitive Pay
We hire the best people - wherever they are - and we make sure they feel valued and well-rewarded for the work they do.

About Zanda

Zanda is a fast-growing, globally loved practice management platform that helps health professionals run smooth, efficient practices - and spend more time caring for their patients. We’re used by thousands of clinics across Australia, New Zealand, the UK, the US, and Canada, and we’re just getting started.

Our mission is simple: make health practice management easy and enjoyable.
To do that, we need brilliant, passionate people who are excited by innovation, love solving complex problems, and thrive in fast-moving environments.

At Zanda, you’ll join a globally distributed team that’s small enough to move fast and think big - and driven enough to deliver work that makes a real impact. We live our values every day:

•
Growth: We stretch ourselves, learn constantly, and support each other’s development.

•
Reliability: We follow through on our commitments and show up for our team and customers.

•
Impact: Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients.

•
Teamwork: We win together - celebrating wins, sharing ideas, and having each other’s backs.

Zanda collects and processes your personal data for the purposes of managing employment candidate application and recruitment-related activities as well as for organisational planning purposes, for further detail, please refer to the Zanda Health Privacy Policy .
